༄/ tshe rtsis 'bras ba blo gsar dga' med//༄ kya ༄kha shog jus 'gong//la sod shel dkar la dbang tshe ring /ta naslog rdul 'phrul dpar du 'jug mkhan/tshe ring bde sid/kyabod gzhung sman rtsis khang dpe skrun sde tshan/52so 8864926smadro ༵ // ṅgi rshasngu sdus/ me tshan gyis dpar nga bsan/kru da mukuganas 'brel gnang yul/ ༷༷༷|55bye/4༷sa

111 dpar bskrun gsal bshad/༈ /tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal dga' skyed zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di ni thog mar 1961 so/ra 11da kyi mthun min rig gnas khag bculharno ya gyal gtsug lag skar nag dbyangs gsum gyi rig gzhung 'di mi nyams thodang spel ched bzhugs sgar du chos don lhan khang khongs rtsis rig slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang /de rjes 1967 'o/ra sman rtsis 17gas bsgril mdzad nas skabs gnyis pa'i slob gnyer ba gsar 'dzugs skabs slob tshan nang skyes bu'i tshe gang gi bde sdug gsal bar dhi na pa'i tshe rtsis kyang mchis par brten de'i 'bras bu rnams gzhung chen khag nas len dbo sa pa 〈〈bee dkar 〉〉lha/gas rtsis gzhung che khag slob grwa bas mkho sgrub bya dkar brten skabs der rtsis dge dam pa brag mthon byams pa rgyal mtshan nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis snyan bskul dang / ma khyi phul te sman rtsis dge che sku gshegs mkhas dbang bar zhi phun tshogs dbang rgyal mchodag nas bi dkar tshe rtsis le'u gzhir mdzad chodag gang nyid kyi gzigs dpe lha/gas nas kha rgyan gyis (tshe rtsis kyi 'bras bu rgyas min ben bder btus pa )zhes phyogs bsgrigs gnang ste dpar thengs dang por deb grangs

17(500)tham pa dpar bskrun gnang ba dang / de rjes slar yang dpar theng gnyis pa bya skabs rtsis dge brag ༄/na byams pa rgyal mtshan de nyid kyis gathoto 'gan dwangs len gyis bdar g.yang dkar chag dbyangs 'char gza' dgu'i rjodad 'bras cung zad rgyas pa 'jug tu dbyangs 'char gza' dgu'i tshe rtsis rgyab tshul rtsisarigs dge che sdu/ bo/sa rgya mcho dam pa'i gsungs bcas gsar du kha bston byas pa dang / skabs der deng dang 'dra ba'i slog klad 'phrul dpar sogs med par yig 'bri ba dag nas sku ngal gang 'tsham lha na pa dang / ma phyi zhu dag kyang sman rtsis drung che rgyal nang sdud bzang cadar bus thugs 'khur chen lnga sa las lha ra du gnang lnga ga dpar thengs gnyis pa bsgrubs pa zhig red/ da lam rtsardzogs kyi slar yang dpar thengs gsum pa 'di nang 'di ga'i rtsis pa 'gas dbo ngas 'char lnga ga rgyun du lag len du mkho ba'i dbyangs 'char rgyud nas gsungs ba'i dus sbyor gnas mal bcu gnyis kyis ngos 'dzin dang 'di dag gi 'brel ba nyung ngu zhig kha gsab dang zhu dag gis sman rtsis dpar bskrun sgotshan nas dpar bskrun zhus pa dge legs 'phel// dpe sgrig pa sa spyi sbarsha 1998 zla 11 tshes 16 la
dkar chag

71 rang skyes lus kyi tshang bstan pa/ 68kha sku/ga sum cu tham pa bshad pa/ 70klung rta'i tshang 'bras bshad pa/ 83gcod 'dral kha dmar/ 85rus chen lnga / 91nang rus spar chen sde brgyad/ 98sme ba gling dgu/ 103lha dpa' tshe bdud/ 122dpal byur brtag pa/ 126rgya ma pha klung 'bras/ 128gza' bzhi ma klung rtsis/ 129rgya phrag gardordog thig kha dmar/ 131ngan klung lhu lnga / 135rde'u spyi yi kha dmar/ 136

511 dar gud 'grel pa bshad pa/ 137skye brtag 'kho ra 'o/ bshad pa/ 144dbyangs 'char rgyud las gza' kun gyi dgra bo/gas dang dus rjodar gnas mal bcu gnyis kyi sngo sa 'dzin bshad pa/ 145legs ldan gza' bdun po gegs dang bcud du gyur ba'i tshul bstan pa/ 169dbyangs 'char tshe rtsis sa ris brgyab tshul/ 175

spyodan 'asprod bdar g.yang /༄༅/ /rtsis kyi skor 'go gang la 'jug kyang thog mar spyi dang bye brag gi bden bdar sngon du 'gro dgos shing de yang bai dkar sogs nas gsungs pa ltar rgyas pa ma 'grub rung gnas khang nyi snyand gsal zhing bag phebs par gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i thodag sku gsung thugs rten rgyas par bzhugs pa'am ma mthar 'jam dpal lam dus 'khe/ra gyi sku dang tshan brtsod dang sher phyin rgyas bsdus gang rigs bzhugs pa'i mdun du lha rab/tshogs 'khor mchod pa rgya gang che dang ma mthar nyer mchod sna lnga ja chang 'o phud gu gul med pa'i spos sbyor dang bsangs rdzas gser skyems sogs gsham nas/ ye/ mkhyen rang nyid skyabs sems 10na du 'bo ba'i thog 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bdag bskyed dang ldan pa'i tshogs mchodad bsangs dang gser skyems sku gas phul nas 'dod gsol spyi dang bye brag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 2gi bden bdar rims bzhin 'donapar bya ba la/ lhadang po skor 'go spyi'i bdar g.yang ni/ 7sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dang/ /snga na gnyis mthar phyin snyu gas sangs rgyas//lung rtogs chos dang dge 'dun bcas/ /'gro la brtse chen rigs gsum mabo na/ /spyi dang khyad par 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /tshangs pa rnam rgyal lha mo dang / /ser skya 'jog po 'phrul len 'chang / /so sku ra bzhi re'i sprul pa bzhi/ /dam can chos khyodangs srung ma dang //phyogs skyongs 'byung ba bzhi yi lha/ /lha klu drang srong mngon shes can//spar sme gza' skar tshes grangs la/ /dbang sku gas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs/ /khyod gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal 'o// /masnu da yon me tog bdug spos dang / /zhal zas rol mo dang bcas pa/ /dkar snu/ lag g.yas mda' dar bcas/ /dag pa'i ma6)da pa 'di dag bzhes//14na nas mi dge ci bsags pa/ /bshags shing dge la rjes yi rang //'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar gsol/ /bdag gi shes rgyud byin rlabs nas/ /skor 'go rtsis rgyud dgongs lam las/ /mi 'jo la

—— martsisa'abras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 3bzang ngan kha smreng gi/ /stangs gathod dpyad rigs ji bzhin par/ /gsal ba'i rten 'brel mthoran shes rtsis/ /ma sgribs gsal sngo/ra bstan du gsol/ /de skad brjod cing slar bdar ba/ /bstan pa'i bdag po thub pa'i dbang / /dgra bcom 'khor bcas der bdar ro/ /rno malnga nga rtsis kyi ma15na shes khyodan/ /bde gshegs mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal kun yab gyur mkhyen rab kyi/ /bdag ༷/ 'phags nga/ 'jam dbyangs bdar/ /swā mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis 'bo kun la/ /skad cig g.yel med spyan gyis gzigs//'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug bdar/ /swā mchodang rtsis kyi masngo na shes ston/ /thugs rje'i dpal gyis bdud bzhi bathodam/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag /bathodam ldan phyag na lda jer bdar//rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /lha rgyal tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa//klu rgyal dga' bo 'jog po dang / /lha mo rnam rgyal bram ze'i rigs//ser skya zhu ba bzhir bdar ro/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston//mtha' med gling dgu'i pha snga la na/ /gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i gling / /shel

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 4 mkhar sum brgya drug cu'i cadag /phyag na ye shes mdang tho cho/ /bsnams pa'i kong tse 'phrul rgyal dang / /ji kong ji nong wang the sogs/ /spyan ldan 'phrul gyi mi bzhir bdar/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /bde dang nye ba kun tu dang / /yang dag len pa'i mi bzhir bdar/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /phur bu rtso mur mur ti dang / /thor cog 'chang ba bzhir bdar ro/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston//khyad par 'thor ba bsdu mdzad pa/ /slob dpon du har nag po dang //ā tsar dmar dang zla ba nag /mkhas pa mi bzhi sku/ tsā ba/ /khams pa khra mo rnams bdar ro/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /khyad par gangs ri'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /rnam dag ma nor tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /so sor ston pa'i slob dpon bar/ /bdar ro rno mthong mngon shes khyodan/ /gtsug lag gzhi mo mahā gser gyi/ /rus sbal chen po khyed bdar ro/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /de yi yan lag mabo mjug la/ /gnas pa'i lha snumag rnams bdar snga / /swā mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /shar phyogs stag yos khri chen la//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 5shing gi lha mo stag skya thod/ /gar byed tshul zhugs der bdar snga / /pha khu mes gsum shing rtsis rnams/ /gtan 'o/ba swā mthodang masngo na shes ston/ /lto phyogs rta sprul khri steng na/ /g.yu 'brug rgyu ba'i tshul bzhugs pa'i/ /me yi lha mo khyed bdar ro/ /me bdag bza' tshang rtsis gtan phob/ /rno mthong ltog gyur mngon shes ston/ /nub phyogs bya sprel gdan steng na/ /bya dmar 'phur ba'i tshul bzhugaso pa'i/ /'byung ba lcags kyi lha mor bdar/ /zhang nye nor grogs lha srung rtsis/ /gtan phob rno mthong mngon shes ston/ /byang phyogs byi phag khri steng na/ /sbal nag nags rgyu'i tshul bzhugs pa/ /chu yi lha sna/ der bdar mo / /phyi nang gnyen lam mtha' bzhi'i rtsis/ /gtan 'o/ba rno mthong masngo na shes lha na/ /mtshams bzhir gshed bzhi'i khri steng na/ /spyad kha sbub pa'i tshul bzhugs pa'i/ /sa yi lha mo mched bzhir bdar/ /ma phyi yul mkhar rtsis gtan 'o/ba/ /swā malnga nga masngo na shes gsal bar ston/ /'o/ rgan drug cu'i lhar bdar ro/ /phyi lo khyim gyi rtsis gtan phob/ /swā malnga nga ma1ran shes ma lus rjodan/ /pha khen rgan

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 6 sngo/ gnam sa bdag /ma khe/na rgan ce/ sa'i sa bdag /bu chen gin ri la sku/gas pa/ /spar kha brgyad kyi lha snurags bdar/ /nang gi rus rtsis gtan phob la/ /rno mthong rtsis kyi mngon shes ston/ /gcig dkar steng na sde thung btsun/ /gnyis nag bdud kyi hal khyi nag /gsum mthing byi lam phag mgo dang / /bzhi ljang ldi rgyal wa ru ṇa/ /lnga ser pra ha ti ser slog drug dkar rgyal po skye 'gro'i dpal/ /bdun dmar btsan dmar chen sngo dang / /brgyud dkar lha chen dbang phyug che/ /dgu dmar ma mo dza mun ti/ /pho brang bzhi lnga'i lha tshogs la//bdar ro sme ba sha rtsis sogs/ /gtan phob rno mthong ngon shes ston//nyi ma la sku gas brgyad dang / /smin drug la sku gas rgyu ba'i skar/ /lhu gas skyong yul lha gzhis bdag la/ /bdar ro rno mthong mngon shes ston//lo ni rgyal po zla ba blon/ /zhag po dmag mi dus tshod mtshon/ /yud tsam rgyu zhing gnas pa yi/ /gza' skar sa bdag rje sdudan dang / /yang 'kho la tshul du bzhugs rnams bdar/ /phyi nang gsang rtsis gtan 14ba la/ /rno mthong mngon shes gsal bar ston/ /de ring rgyu sbyor 'di

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 7dag gi/ /rno ba'i mo 'debs gsal rtsis byed/ /'dzin pa'i cha 'debs steng lha tshogs/ 'og klu bar du mi tshogs par/ /gtsug lag kun gyis ston pa mdzod/ /ma shes slobs la mi mthong ston/ /ma dran skul la the tshoms sel/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bstan du gsol// //bye brag tshe rtsis bdar g.yang ni/ /de yang byis pa'i btsas klung ngam//tshe rabs las rtsis bya ba la/ /tshe yi nyi ma shar ma shar/ /lus rjodabs dpal rtsal rgyas ma rgyas/ /bu nor longs spyod 'du mi 'du/ /bsod nams rgyal ma'argan dza/gas ma dzaXgs/ /pha drin ma drin che :pe che/ /bu tsha rigs brgyud 'phel mi 'phel/ /ma bzhi'i slog pa dro mi dro/ /bu bzhi'i 'khar ba tshugs mi tshugs/ /bo/gas bzhi'i g.yang ra 'khyil ma 'khyil/ /dgra bzhi'i spyang mo langs ma langs/ /pha mes gdan sa 'dzin mi 'dzin/ /yang mes tshang zlar gzan mi gzan/ /lo yi phyi klung bzang mi bzang / /sme ba bar klung ngan mi ngan/ /spar kha rus klung bzang mi bzang / /dar gud rim pa ji ltar yin/ /gnod sbyin ma tshe 'phrog mi 'phrog /srin po pha bdud gcod mi gcod/ /sha

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 8rkyang mda' 'phen byed mi byed/ /klung kyi lam po log mi log /'khor ba skye gnas log mi 'o/ga /klung ngan mna' za byed mi byed/ /gcig mchorgan gcig la thebs mi thebs/ /yas mas dpal byur khyod ma lha/da//gza' bzhi'i ngan kha 'dus ma 'dus/ /rgya ma 'a〉rgams rjod ral ma ral//'jig bde bsad skyabs rabs chad dang / /g.yang sham rim pa byas ma byas/ /me stag chu ru mchongs ma mchongs/ /chu lcags me la rgyab ma rgyab/ /shing gcig sta res bcad ma bcad/ /lcags sbram me yis bzhu ma bzhu/ /sa gzhi shing gis g.yengs ma g.yengs/ /shing snyungacangab ral ma ral/ /spyang bzhis lag gcig bsad ma bsad/ /maro/ra ra ra ra༅na de la sogs pa yis/ /tshe 'dir skyid sdug mthod man rnams/ /ji ltar 'byung bzhin bstan du gasku/la/ /mjug tu dge ba sngo zhing shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par byacad/ /'di rigs la gal chung du bzung na las kyi 'thod nas 'phyugs te skor 'go 'khrug cing kha dmar 'chol bar 'dra bas des na dgos pa gal cher mthong nas bkod pa lags 11//

tshe rtsis 'bras bublogasala'aga'askyed/ 9wa ༄༅༅/ /osu sti/ /ngo mtshar phyi nang gzhan gsum bdag nyid can/ /zung 'jug khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /dngas ba'i yid sngarar gcig tu shar ba'i mgon/ /7rgyal ba'i dbang sngo bstan 'dzin rgya mcho sa skyongs/ /gru dzin gzhal med la dgyes lha mchodag de'i/ /gang 'dul sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas las/ /ma lhanangs rjen par gsal ba'i dbyangs 'char rgyud/ /dris len tshul 'chad thal ba'i dbang de rgyal/ /gang gsung 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag gi /bde dogs ji snyed 'doms pa'i rtsis sgo las/ /tshe rtsis 'bras bu rgyas min go bde bar/ /legs par btus nas bshad kyi rna ba sdu/gas/ /de yang pha lo pa dang / ma 'o/ ma/ gnyis la gnam 'o/ rgyal khrod/ zla tshes/ chu tsho da rjes 'brang / 'das 'di nyin/ sbyor byed nyi ma/ rten 'brel/ zla skar zhib pa/ takri la dus sbyor/ dbyangs 'char tshe chad lo zla/ 'chi blu 'o/ zla/ bcas rnams kyi 'bras bu'i rims pa chu babab tu bstar ba la/

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 10lhathogs mar skye ba brtag pa ni/ /skye brtag 'khor lo bshad kyis thodan/ /de yang skye brtag zla skar ni/ /rkang pa la skyes tshe thung 'gyur// pus sna/ la skyes byes 'khyams shing / /gsang ba la skyes 'khrig pas brlag lte bar skyes pa dbul sngo ra 'gyur/ /snying ga la skyes 'o/ngas ྅ da ldan/ /lag par skyes pa rkun sngo ra 'gyur / /'khrig mar skyes pa sdug bsngal can/ /dpung mthod la skyes khur sngo ba/ /kha la skyes pa chos dang ldan/ /spyi tho'i skar ma la skyes pa/ /rgyal por 'gyur ba the jo ma med/ /༈de nas res gza'i skyes 'bras ni/ (1)/nyi ma la skyes zhag bdun nam/ /zla bdun bsdu/sa na bu tshe ring / /mi chen byams par 'gyur ba dang / /bu mo phyug ste khyim so 'dren/ (2)/zla ba bu skyes phyug la btsan/ /bu mo mdzes dungs yid du coding / (3)/mig dmar sdig spyod spro thung ngan/ /dbyen byed nga rgyal khong khro che/ /bu skyes gasdud dka' bu mo 'chi/ (4)/lhag par skyes pa nad bu can/ /bu skyes ngan te ma la rtsub/ /bu mo skyes ngan pha ma dbul/ /mo rang

tshe rtsis 'brasabulho gsala'aga'adzid/ 11zas nor dbang thang che/ (5)/phur bur skyes pa bzhin ngan zhing / /blo gsal mkhas shing chos kyang byed/ /bu mo tshe ring grogs kyang bzang //pa sangs dme dang mgar ba byed/ /bu skyes tshe ring dbang po rno/ /bu mo nad cadang dpal kyang che/ /spen par gzugs bzang bsku da nams chung / /bu 'bring bu mo tshe thung ngo / /da ni skyes pa'i skar ma la/(0)/dbyug pa la skyes drug cu nas/ /brgyad cu'i bar thub lce bde zhing / /gzugs bzang chos la dkar ba dang / /sman khyodar mkhan nam sman pa'i rigs/ /glu gar 1ril mo'i sgra la mkhas/ /lho lus mi brtan lha/da mi tshugs/ (1)/bra nyer skyes pa sems brtan zhing / /nad med bden smra snying rje chung / /tshe 'o/ sum cu rtsa drug gam/ /ring na dgu bcu rtsa lnga thub/ /lag bag ra mkhas shing bce na 'grus che/ /snying rje shin tu chung bas na/ /phyi ma dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes/ (2)/smin drug bu skyes longs spyod 'phel/ /snyan grags dang ni gzi brjid che//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 12 mkhas shing rab du dpa' ba ste/ /tshe stod ngan yang tshe smad la/ /'gyur zhing bzang por 'gro ba ste/ /tshe tshad ring po nyid du 'gyur/ /bu mo skyes na ngan pacad/ (3)/snar ma la ni skyes pa'i mi/ /tshe tshad ring sngo ra 'gyur ba dang / /gzugs bzang ngag 'jam bde na par smra/ /phyug cing dzadas mthun sbyin la dga'/ /gasku med shes shing mkhas pa ste//rnam pa kun tu mdzes dang ldan/ /dpa' zhing rgyal ba phun sum snurags//dgra rnams rtags par rab tu 'alnga mas/ (4)/mabo la skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /nyer brgyad nas ni re gnyis bar/ /ring na dgu bcu thub pa'ang bshad/ /chos ldan sdom brtson bden par smra/ /dpa' zhing blo gsal longs spyod ldan/ /bu mo skyes pa kha drag zer/ (5)/lag la skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /lo ni sum cu rtsa lnga 'am/ /yang na drug cu rtsa lnga 'tsho/ /chom po'i las kyis 'tsho ba yin/ /gtum po g.yo med lag mi bag / /khro zhing dbul la shin tu blun/ /bya ba bzang po mi byed par/ /ngan pa'i las la rab tu bce na/ /nga rgyal sdig pa'i las la dga'/ /khyad par bu skyes rtsa ra che la/ /bu mo bal gyi las la

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 13skyen/ (6)/rgyal rjodad skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /lnga bcu 'am ni drug cu thub/ /zhing pa 'o/ngas ྅ da ldan pa'am/ /thodas smra tshul khrims ldan pa yin/ /sems ni rab tu bzang ba ste/ /rang bzhin kyang ni glen pa dang / /lho brtan nad med codag shes pas/ /cung zad tsam gyis chodag par 'dzin/ (7)/rgyal smad la ni gang skyes pa/ /tshe tshad brgyad cu thub pa ste/ /chodas smra tshul khrims ldan pa'i mi/ /zhi zhing sbyin pa gtong ba dang // /lce bde gzugs bzang lag pa bzo/ /blo lus mi brtan rjodad mi tshugs/ /mkhas shing chodar ldan skal ba bzang (8)/wa la skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /lo ni lnga bcu tham pa thub/ /ring na drug cu re gsum yin/ /glen pa bu snu/ skyed chung zhing / /mkhas shing byad bzhin mdzes pa dang / / ma dang 'bo/gas yun thung ba yin//khro zhing sdig dang dbyen la dga'/ /sred pa che zhing ster yang phod/ /bya ba bzang po mi byed cing / /ngan pa'i las la shin tu bsnyu na/ (9)/rta chen la ni skyes pa'i mi/ /'o/ dgu dag la ma shi na/ /lnga bcu thod lnga gang rigs 'tsho/ /bu skyes pha la ngan pa yin/ /bu mo skyes na mo

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 14rang 'chi/ /rtag tu rdzun tshig la dga' zhing / /'kho ra mang sku ngas spyod che ldan la/ /yun ring bu skyes bzang pa'i rigs/ /bzo la mkhas shing dge la brtsodan/ /btsun zhing chodas ldan nor dang ldan//(10)/rta chung skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /sku/ brgyad tshun la ma shi na/ /lnga bcu 'am ni bo lnga thub/ /bu mo yin na nad mang ngan/ /khyi'u yin na bu rang 'chi/ /ma shi bar du rang bzhin ngan/ /g.yo dang 'asnga da chags che ba yin/ /bag la mkhas shing ser sna che/ /gtam dang bo/sa rgyan rigs la dga'/ /sbru/ legs kha 'jam zas la yangs//(11)/khra la skyes pa 'o/ brgya 'asnur/ /phyug cing 'o/ngas phyu da tshul khrims ldan/ /rdzun med bden smra sbyin la dga'/ /'gro ba dang ni bsnyen gnas la/ /dga' zhing cung zad blun par 'gyur/ /'chi rkyen dug gis byed pa yin/ (12)/bya ma la ni skyes pa'i mi ma yi tshe la bar chad 'gyur/ /lo 3 brgyad cu tham pa 'tsho/ /lce bde gzugs bzang lag pa bzo/ /spobs pa bzang zhing shed kyang che/ /blo lus mi bde sdod mi tshugs/ /skya zhing g.yo dang sgyu ma che/ /dbang phyug

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 15gtsa ba nar ldan zhing / /sbyin dang mchod sbyin sna tshogs byed/ /chos ldan byang chub yan lag bdun/ /sdud dul drang ldan khrims kun bsrungs//yang na rkun ma sa/ma dad can/ (13)/bya'u la ni gang skyes pa/ /tshe tshad lo ni nyer brgyad 'cho / /glu gar blo la mo'i sgra la mkhas/ /sbyin dga' 'dod spyod mdzes la sdug /lce bde blo lto grags pa ldan/ /bzhin legs mi dga' che bar 'ong / /rdzun med ngag rtsub 'dod chags che//mig dang yan lag dbang wa (megs/ /sna snurags gos khyodan phreng ba thogs//(14)/sa ri la ni gang skyes pa/ /tshe 'o shi shu drug cu 'tsho/ /rtsis pa 'byor rnyed khro bar 'gyur/ /g.yo sgyu sems la nad bu can/ /longs ྅mod ldan zhing gzugs bzhin legs/ /yas byams mas sdang mi kha sdang / /phrag snga ga ser sna che ba yin/ /rang bzhin gnyen la yangs pa dang / /bgrod pa dang ni rtsom la spro/ /blo dul tshong shes de la spyod/ /brtse ldan bden smra chos la spyod/ /bu dang bu mo gnyis ka btsan/(15)/sa ga la skyes bdun cu'i tshe/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing dpal dang ldan/ /mkhas shing ho ra ldan bud med 'du/ /dpa' la dgra thul

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 16 shes rab che/ /dang po ngan yang tshe smad bzang / /phrag dog ser sna gzi brjid che/ (16)/lag sku ra skyes pa tshe yi tshad/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'tsho ba ste/ /tshong pa dbang po dul ba dang / /chos spyod blo gros cher ldan zhing / /tshong ngam chos kyis 'tsho ba yin/ /lce de gzugs bzang tshul khrims ldan/ /cadar phyugs byes 'bo/ rab tu bzang / /byes la dga' zhing byes kyang 'aho da/ /mi gzhan 'di la dga' zhing 'du/ (17)/lde'u la skyes pa sku lnga 'chod/ /tshul khrims 'chal la snying rje med/ /ma〉〉da sbyin la sku gas 'phel bar byed/ /phal cher mi sdug tshe tshad thung / /dbul zhing chog shes 'dod pa chung / /bya ba bzang po mi byed par/ /ngan pa'i las la rab tu bsdo na/ /chodas byas myur du khrims 'chal 'gyur/ (18)/sku/ga pa la skyes sku/ lnga 'am//ring na drug cu re gsum 'tsho/ /skal ldan skyes bu'i rnam pa can/ /khang bzang 'dzin cing zhing pa yin/ /chodar dang 'bras bu'i bdag sngo ste//'jig rten bya byed bu mi skye/ /skyes kyang gso ba dka' ba'o/ /dregs dang nga rgyal che ba yin/ /ngan pa'i las la rab tu bsnyu na/ (19)/bre

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ /7la skyes pa brgyad bcu 'tsho/ /chos dang ldan zhing thos pa che bzo dang bya ba kun la mkhas/ /snu sa rjodad sbyin pa dag la dga'/ /'kho ra la dungs shing kun la dad/ /nga rgyal cung zad che na yang / /tshul khrims ldan pas mtho ris chodab/ (20)/phul la skyes pa brgya phrag 'chorta//yang na brgyad cu cangalnga thub/ /phyug cing sbyin pa gdodang la dga'/ /rgyun du rdzun bral srong por smra/ /bu dang grogs mang shes pa che/ /sems can la byams lho yang dul/ /mkhas shing rig bag nad kyang dato/na//tshad pa'i nad 'byung gasku yang dka'/ (21)/bya zer skyes pa drug cu 'am/ /drug cu re gnyis 'chor ba yin/ /sems ni rab tu bzang ༷ ste/ /rang bzhin mnyen zhing shes pa yangs/ /'bo dang ce ma pa dag la spro/ /blo dul tshong shes de la spyod/ /brtse ldan snyan smra chos la spyod/ /longs spyod rtag cing nad kyang dkon/ /rgyal po dang ni sems can byams/ /dpa' zhing bsran thub bo/gas kyi ma〉〉ga /yul 'a(war khyodang zhing dgra rnams thul/ /mkhas par byed pa'i ma6nyig yin te/ /zab yangs gnyen sbyor dag la ga'/ /dpal dang 'byor ba che

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ /8ba yin/ /grags pa che zhing chung ma mdzangs/ (21)/bya 1tswa la ni skyes pa'i mi/ /lo ni drug cu 'tsho ba ste/ /khro zhing 'dod chags chung ba dang / /thos ldan mkhas shing shes rab che/ /grong khyer rnams kyis ma'ebyed pa'i gnas/ /dgra ྅pe 'dul bcin las la mkhas/ /sems ni bzang zhing gnyen la yangs/ /'byor ldan bgrod dang rtsom la dga'//nad med stobs dang ldan pa yin/ (22)/bya gzhug la skyes nyer lnga 'am/ /drug cu tham pa 'chod ba yin/ /khro zhing sman mkhas bu chodar ldan/ /rang dgar spyod cing bya ba brtson/ /sems bzang rang bzhin mnyen cing yangs// /tho rtsing bag yangs rtsom la dga'/ /ster ho/da dpa' zhing glu gar mkhas/ /blun zhing chu yis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bu sna/ btsas pa mdzes pa yin/ (23)/rjodag la skyes pa myur du 'chi/ /khro zhing lha da ldan 'chad la btsan/ /nang mi byams shing ma33da cing bsrung / /gzugs bzang mchod cing ster yang phod/ /dka' thub la dga' bab 〉〉la che/ /nad med snying yang che ba yin/ (24)/khrum rjodad la skyes thod lnga thub/ /gasku sgyu rku dang gasku da la dga'/ /gshes

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 19ngan dmag dang 〉〉mas la brtsi/ /lag bag mkhas shing rang bzhin ngan/ /blun zhing gzhan la gcadad pa che/ /ster mi 'o/da cing grags pa che/ /rna ba gsang zhing chodar la khyodad/ /gnyen rnams brtse zhing phyi mi sdang / /chung ma dbang dang ldan pa sku nga / (25)/khrums smad lo ni lnga bcu 'am/ /yang na drug cu tham pa thub/ /glu gar rig pa dag mkhas/ /'dis ni chodas kyi sbyin pa byed/ /phyag cing sbyin la dga' ba ste/ /rgyun du rdzun bral srong por smra/ /tshul khrims shes rab snying rje ldan/ /skyid cing 'khor bsten smra ba mkhas/ /'khor mang 'du zhing dgra las rgyal/ /bu snu/ skyes pa sgab rmang ngan/ (26)/shes la skyes nyer brgyad dam/ /dgu bcu tham pa 'asnur ba yin/ /skye thod rab mdzangs nor 'bru ldan/ /'byor la rab brtson dbyig la spyod//mi gzhan kun la dga' ba dang / /rab tu bzang zhing dge bar 'gyur//shing mkhan du yang 'gyur ba 'am/ /dbang tho/ tshang zhing dpa' ba yin//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 20 da ni khyim la skyes pa'i rtsis/takril lam khyim 'bras te/ /lug gi khyim dang takril la/ /khang nang sgron me dang bcas te/ /kha ni 'og tu bltas nas skyes/ /gso dka' kha dog gzugs byad ngan/ /tshe dang bsod nams cung zad chung / /log 'tsho mi 'phrod mi nor 'phrod/ /gos dmar 'phrod cing bco lnga la/ /skeg yod de las thar na/ /bzhi bcu thub cing der ma shi / /tshe tshad mthar thug thub par bshad/ /gzhan yang skyes nas zla zhag cu/ /sku bcu bathe brgyad nyi shu 'am/ /sum cu dag la ma shi na/ /lo mang 'tsho zhing khong khro che/ /smin drug zla ba'i bcu gsum mam/ /res gza' mig mar dag la ni/ /mes 'acirgag nam phyed 'chi bar 'gyur/ rgyal pos mchod cing zhing la dga'/ /bya ba shes shing 6)sa la dkar/ /mthodan la yangs shing tshig kyang gsal//kho ga yangs 'asnga da chags che ba yin/ /kho gtum bsam pa ngan pa cod//༈/glang gi khyim dang takril 'bras/ /'bras sam phye yis snod khengs dus/ kha ni cadag tu bltas nas skyes/ /kha snga ga gzugs byad zhan pa

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 2/dang / /gos dkar zas su dkar sum 'phrod/ /tshe dang bsod nams cung zad chung / /gos ser 'phrod cing sum cu la/ /skeg yod de nas lnga bcu la/ /de las mthar na tshe mthar thug /gzhan yang btsas nas zla zhag grangs/ /nyi shur ma shi dgu bcu thub/ /dgun ra res gza' mig dmar dus/ /bad mkhris nad kyis dbenang snu/ 'chi mig rtsa dmar la le 'o/ che/ /mkhas shing 'kho ra mang snyan grags che/ /༈/'khrig pa'i khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /'bru mang sku da pa'i du sa su ni/ /steng du kha bltas skyes pa yin/ /kha snga ga bzang zhing gzugs byad legs/ /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan/ /gos rigs sngon po rang zas 'phrod/ /lnga bdun bcu gnyis lo la skeg /de las mthar na skeg med do/ /gzhan yang skyes nas zhag lnga dang / /zla ba nyer lngar ma shi na/ /dgu bcu rtsa lnga 'chod ba yin/ /rgyal zla 'am rgyal stod lhag pa dang / /tshes pa bcu drug dag la ni/ /snga dro mtshon gyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'byor ldan 'jam zhing chang dad che/ /bden smra gzhan gyi tshig la mkhas/ /ltad sna/ la dga' chags pa che//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 22༈//rla'i khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /chu ho da chu yis khengs pa'i dus/ /kha ni tso/ga tu bltas nas skyes/ /gasku dka' kha snga ga gzugs byad ngan/ /tshe dang bsod nams cung zad chung / /gos su dkar po legs 'phrod cing / /zhing rmod la sogs zas rnams 'phrod/ /sum cur skeg sku da de las thar/ /de nas skeg ni med par bshad/ /gzhan yang btsas nas so/ zla zhag /lnga bdun bcu drug sum cu la/ /ma shi tshe tshad brgyad cu 'chod/ /rta zla'i dkar phyogs bcu bzhi dang / /rta chen res gza' pa sangs la/ /nyi ma rgas khar dmu chus 'chi/ /sdu/ ldan grags dang shes rab che/ /stobs ldan bzod dang byang sems ldan/ /'bo la dga' zhing dzadas la dkar/ /༈/seng ge'i khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /chu stod phyed song dus su ni/ /steng du kha bltas skyes pa yin/ /kha snga ga gzugs byad ngan mod kyang / /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan/ /zas su bsod nams zas dang ni/ /thodas ljang 'aho da cing 'o/ dgur skeg /gzhan yang bcu gsum zla zhag so/ra/ /ma shi bdun cu rtsa gu 'asnur/ /bya ma

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 23spen pa bcu dgu'i tshes/ /nag phyogs nyen phyed kyi dus su/ /rdib 'og rjodag gis 'chi ba yin/ /lha bas ldan gzugs bzang nga rgyal che//lha ma6wad bla ma la dga' zhing / /nad mang snurang la dga' ba yin//༈/bu mo'i khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /'bru rnams stod byed zad pa'i dus/ /kha ni steng du bltas nas skyes/ /kha snga ga gzugs byad phun sum tshogs/ /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba mi 'phrod zas// gos dkar 'phrod cing lo bcu la/ /skeg sku da der thar med par shes// gzhan yang skyes nas nyer dgu'i zhag zla ba phyed dang bcu dang ni/ /lo ni nyer dgur ma shi na/ /drug cu 'tsho zhing sa ga yi/ /tshes lnga bya'u spen pa'i res/ /mthod nad dag gis mtshan smad 'chi/ /mkhas shing cadar ldan dbang yang che/ /skye thod rnams dang mthun pa dang / /bu mang bu la brtse ba dang / /me lta ga dang ni dri la dga'/ /༈/srang gi khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /'bras dang phye la sku gas pa ni/ /rang gi bza' 'phro phyed zad dus/ /kha ni steng du bltas

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 24nas skyes/ /masnga ga bzang gzugs byad phun sum snurags/ /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan/ /rnal ma'i zas dag 'phrod pa dang //gos dmar gyon cing lo bdun dang / /sum cu drug cu rnas la skeg /gzhan yang skyes nas zla zhag grangs/ /lnga dgu nyi shu'i sku/ra ma shi//brgyad cu 'tsho zhing dpyid tha dang / /dbyar ra nag pa'i tshes brgyad dang / /skar ma lha ga dang mig dmar la/ /'dus pa'i nad kyi mtshan mo 'chi/ /stobs ldan nga rgyal tshig rtsub smra/ /༈/sdig pa'i khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /rim par sgron me thab kyi me/ /mnal ma thag pa'i dus su ni/ /kha ni steng du bstas nas skyes/ /kha dog gzugs byad ngan pa dang / /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan/ /sha dang gos dmar 'phrod pa dang / /bco lnga bzhi bcu brgyad bcu la/ /skeg der thar med pa yin/ /gzhan yang skyes nas zhag cu dang / /zla bcu 'o/ bcur ma shi na/ /lnga bcu 'tsho zhing dbyar 'bring gi /dkar phyogs bcu gcig cu gnyis dang / /lde'u bya sbo mig dmar res/ /skrangs 'bur nad kyis snga dro 'chi/ /mthon

—— martsisa'abras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 25ngo sa bkur te sdig la dga'// kho nga khyodang 'khrug pa'i las la dga'//dbul la bu snu/ mang ba yin//༈/gzhu yi khyim dang taṅgāl 'bras/ /dge sbyong dang ni bram ze'i rigs/ /sngags pa phug na sku da pa'i dus/ /kha ni codig tu bltas nas skyes/ /gasku dka' masnga ga dang gzugs byad ngan/ /tshe dang bsod nams cung zad chung / /rang zas dang ni gos khyodan 'phrod/ /nyi shur skeg sku da de thar med/ /gzhan yang skyes nas 'o/ zla zhag /bco brgyad grangs la ma shi na/ /bdun cu 'askru9 deng dbyar 'bring ngam/ /dgun ra'i bathe lnga skar ma khrums/ /pa sangs res la rims dang ni/ /masnuran gyis dathodang mo 'chi ba yin/ /tshul khrims dang ldan bden par smra//longs spyod che zhing gtong le dga'/ /༈/chu srin khyim dang takri la 'bras/ /khyim na skyes thod phal pa'i rigs/ /sku da pa'i du sa der kha so/ga tu/ /bltas nas skyes pa gasku dka' zhing / /kha dog gzugs byad ngan pa dang / /tshe dang bsod nams cung zad chung / /'bras dang gos rigs dmar po 'phrod/ /nyer

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 26gsum bzhi bcur skeg re sku da/ /de las thar na skeg med snga / /gzhan yang skyes nas ba3) brgyad kyi/ /64 zla zhag la ma shi na/ /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa bdun 'tsho/ /bya sbo'i zla ba skar ma sgrog /tshes pa bco lnga spen pa'i res/ /nyin phyed gong du skran gyis 'chi/ /dpa' zhing chos ldan blta na sdug /dri rjodas glu dang rtse la dga'/ /nyams 'asnur gzi brjid chags pa che/ /༈/bum pa'i khyim dang takril 'bras/ /phyag na phal pa sku da 'aho la/ /phyi ru bon pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /kha ni steng du bltas nas skyes/ /kha dog bsna rnar zhing gzugs byad legs/ /nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan /rang gi nor dang gos sngon 'phrod/ /sum cu lnga cur skeg yod cing / /de las mthar na skeg med snga / /gzhan yang skyes nas sku zla zhag/ /bathe brgyad grangs la ma shi na/ /dbyar 'bring bcu gnyis skar ma khre/ /gza' yang nyi ma shar ba'i dus/ /bad 'khrugs nad kyis 'chi ba yin/ /blo ldan mkhas shing snyan pa che/ /'khor mang 'o/ngas spyod mi rabs dgu/ /nga rgyal che zhing gzhan phan byed//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 27༈/nya yi khyim dang takril 'bras/ /dge slong dge sbyong bram ze dang / /sngags pa sku gas kyis byin brlab dus/ /gachodag ni gang rung codag bcug nas/ /kha ni 'phred la bltas nas skyes/ /kha snga ga gzugs byad zhan pa dang / /tshe dang balha/da nams 'bring tsam yin/ /sku/na tan zhugs pa'i zas dang ni / /gos sngon 'phrod cing sum cur skeg/ /de las mthar na skeg med sngo / /gzhan yang bathod brgyad zhag dang sku / /bcu gnyi sa ma shi bo lnga 'asnum/ /khrums dang dbyug pa zla ba yi/ /dkar ༷ gas bcu gnyis skar ma bre/ /phur bu'i res la rlung nad kyis/ /nyi ma phyed yol dag la 'chi/ /nor ldan ser sna che ba dnge / /nya dang sha dang 'khrig la dga'/ / ༈/rten 'brel bcu gnyis skyes pa'i rtsis/ /ma rig pa la skyes nyi ma dgu/ /zla dgu 'o/ dgur ma shi na/ /cadar ldan smra mang sems sdug cing / /nye du nang brtsodad 'khrig la sred/ /yig rtsis gtsug lag shes pa byung / /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'tsho/ /'du byed nyin mor 'chi bar 'gyur/

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 28༈/'du byed zhag brgyad zla ba brgyad/ /'o/ brgyad dag la ma shi na/ /nad med 'byor zhing tshangs par spyod/ /tshe ring grogs po mang ba dang / /mkhas pa bzo yi rigs rnams shes/ /brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'asnum ba la/ /rnam shes nyi ma dag la 'chi/ /༈/rnam shes zhag lnga lo lnga'i dus/ /slo bur ma shi spro ring zhing //mkhas shing nga rgyal che ba dang / /jig dga' tshig rtsub dpa' zhing dbul//byang sems chung bar 'byung ba yin/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis 'chod ba dang //ming gzugs nyi mar masnuran gyis 'chi/ /༈/ming gzugs nyin drug zla drug dang / /lo ni bcu gnyis ma shi na/ /nad nyung 'tsho dalo na sdang ba mang / /bu yi mi 'tsho rtag 'jigs mang / /gtum zhing nga rgyal tshe smad phyug /chung ma gsum sku/nga snurang gis 'tsho/ /tshe lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig thub/ /skye mched nyi mar gasnyu nga gis 'chi/ /༈/skye mched nyin lnga zla ba gsum/ /'o/ brgyad bcu la ma shi na//ser sna che zhing nad med la/ /dpa' zhing 'phongs la sred pa che/ /ltor

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 29'du drug cu rtsa bzhi 'chod/ /reg par rang nyid khyim du 'chi/༈/reg pa zhag lnga zla ba gsum/ /lnga dgu lo dgur ma shi na/ /dus rnams rtag tu nad kyi 'dzin/ /bshes gnyen che la smra ba mkhas/ /sdud gros ldan zhing nga rgyal che/ /lag rku chodas dga' phrag wa ga che/ /phyug cing 'khrig la sred pa dang / /lo ni drug cu rtsa gsum 'asnung/ /tha ma chodar ba'i nyi ma la/ /mi yi rgyal po'i chad pas 'chi/ /༈/chodar ba nyi ma bcu gnyis dang / /zla ba gnyis brgyad 'o/ brgyad la/ /ma shi gzhan gyi bsnyen bkur dang / /maco〉da pa'i gnas 'gyur g.yo sdig dga'/ /nad ldang 'bru nor phyug pa dang / bzo mkhas chung ma gnyis dang ldan/ /tshe lo drug cu tham pa 'tsho/ /sred pa'i nyi mar 25da pas 'a:bye/ /༈/sred pa zhag po gsum mam cu/ /zla lnga lo dgur ma shi na//grong khyer gyi ni dpon du 'gyur/ /bu tsha mang la longs spyod che/ /nad dkon gzugs bzang dgra grogs mang / /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'tsho//len pa'i nyi mar dus gis 'chi/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 30༈/len pa nyin dgu zla ba gnyis/ /'o/ brgyad dgu la ma shi na//lta bar mi sdug sems chung shing / /gting ring mdza' bo'i gzugs kyi ni/ /gasku byed la dga' 'aro/da chags che/ /tshul khrims 'chodal zhing lo drug cu/ /rtsa bzhir 'tsho zhing tha ma ru/ /srid pa'i nyi mar chu 'am mdzes/ /rang gi yul du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /༈/srid pa nyin dgu zla gnyis sam/ /gsum dang lo dgur ma shi na/ /gzhan gyi chung mar 'khrig pa srid/ /gnyid chung gathoḍa thodar dmag dasngo/na 'gyur/ /btsan phyug bzo yi gnas ma mkhas/ /chung ma gnyis ldan drug cu 'tsho/ /tha ma skye ba'i nyi ma la/ /mtshon gyis gzhan ༷/la dag tu 'chi/ /༈/skye ba nyin dgu zla ba dgu/ /lo 3 bcu la ma shi na/ /rtag par nad bu can du 'gyur/ /phyugs dang yul 'khor mi skyong la/ /gzhan gyi mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /drug cu 'tsho zhing rga shi la/ /chu yi gaho da pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /༈/rga shir skyes pa nyi ma gnyis/ /zla gcig lo dgur ma shi na//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 31chung dus nad mang cher skyes byang / /yid gzhu nga gnyen mdun byams pa dang / /dgra mang drug cu rtsa bzhi 'tsho/ /ma rig nyi mar mtshon gyis 'chi/ /༈/tshes la skyes pa bstan pa ni/ /gcig gsum pho mo gang skyes kyang / /bstud cing skye la shes pa che/ /gnyis gsum bu bzang bu mo ngan/ /gsum gsum gang skyes 'chi 'am ngan/ /bzhi gsum bu skyes ma la ngan/ /bu mo skyes na slar yang bstud/ /lnga gsum bu skyes nor gyis phyug /bu mo skyes na 'chi 'am dbyen/ /drug gsum gang skyes phyis kyang bstud/ /bdun gsum bu skyes rig pa rno/ /bu mo skyes pa khyo 'brang zhing / /brgyad gsum gang skyes gso ba dka'/ /dgu gsum gang skyes byur gyi bu/ /bcu gsum gang skyes dbul ba yin//nyi ma nag chung yi ling dang / /ki yang gza' sgong zas 'tshol dus//gegaza' bdun rnams la ngan par bshad/ /zin phung bu btsas 'chi ba 'am/ /yang na pha ma 'bra la ba'i ngan/ /sme ba gcig dkar spar kha dwa/ /tshes dang dus la skyes pa ngan/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 32ra༅//gsum pa dbyangs 'char gza' dgu'i 'bras/ /de nas tshe yi gnas skabs spyir/ /drang srong rnam dgu'i spyod 'bras ni/ nyanyi mas lo bdag byed pa'i dus/ /rgyal po sogs nas bsnyad pa 'byung / / sar yang nor zad sar med kyi/ /nor rdzas dag kyang 'ong ba srid//15pa/ 15pa/rang gi snying nye'i spun bo gas bral/ /lus la dmar khrag cham rim dang / /tshad mkhris nad kyi ngo che zhing / /'bar gyi me lce gdug pa yis/ /bsreg mnyam tsha bas kun nas gdung / /lhunan yang sgrub dka' the 15ma can/ /bsgrubs kyang phan chodags med pas na/ /der dmigs sbyin bsreg 'bum 'ur 'don/ /'od zer can ma'i gzungs mdo dang / /phyogs cu mun sel sgrol ma 'don/ /rab byung sde 'am sngags 'chang la/ /bsnyen bkur zangs dang dar dmar 'bul/ /yang na nyi ma'i bcos ka la/ /khang steng nyi khyim bcu gnyis gzugs/ /bcos la de steng dar dmar 'dzugs/nyazla bas lo bdag byed ring la/ /gnyid che mdza' grogs gos rgyan to/ba/ /drag las mi dge phyi thal che/ /gzhan ma gang sgrub lhunan rnams

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 33'grub/ /dgra ༷ gas pham zhing rang nyid rgyal/ /chu phran 'dus pa'i rgya masnur dang / /rgya mtsho'i nang gi cadar bu bzhin/ /myu gu rlan pa 'phrad 'dra ba'i/ /longs spyod rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nad med bde zhing chung ma la/ /mngal chags bu snu skye bar 'gyur/ /codan te ma rgyud gnyen nye dang / /bud med ngan pa'i shī ga smra yis/ /'tshe yang de yis gnod mi 'gyur//༈/mig dmar lo bdag bye da ring la/ /rang la rgol ba'i dgra rnams 'byung / /gyod dang gdung ba'i me lce mched/ /mdza' bo dgrar ldang 'khrugs brtsod byed/ /bsam pa'i don la bar chad mang / /nor dang sku ngas rjodad nyams pa dang / /gzhan gyi bud med rnams dang 'bo/gas//rgyal snga'i khrims dang kun mas 'aces/ /de bzhin lus la khrag mkhris kyis//nad dang dmar sngo che ba yin/ /khyim la'ang me yis 'jigs pa che/ /de tshe bzlog rim tog gzungs dang / /gdugs dkar dkon brtsegs sher phyin mdo/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dag tshar 'don/ /dge 'dun sde la mang 'gyed dang / /kha tshar ma nyams dar yugs 'bul/ /gser

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 34sbyang la ni rang gi ming / /bris te shar lho'i khyodags su 'dzugs//༈/sgra gcan lo bdag byed pa'i dus/ /nor zad gzhan gyis lce zug cing / /gnyen bral sdug bsngal chodag babs 'byung / /zla bo gas tsher zan mya ngan dang / /mi bag da nad kyis 'tshe ba cadangs/ /sngo na nyams skal nyams gzhan gying bsnyad/ /de tshe 'dus sder sran ma dang / /'khur bas bsnyen bkur de bzhin du/ /lcags dang rags gan dag kyang 'bul/ /'dul ba lung bzhi dbo na brtsegs dang / /bkra shis brtsegs pa'i masnga rnams 'asnga na/ /bathodas ka skyes par chang sbyin zhing / /rgyal mtshan rtse la rgyan bo sa btags/ /de ltar 'bad na dgra lhu 'pham rang nyid rgyal zhing tshe srid rnyed/ /'dod don ngang gis 'grub pa dang / /rgyal thabs chen wa'i bdag sngo ra 'gyur/ /'kho ra 'bangs snyan grags khyodags //na khyabatra//༈/phur bus lo bdag byed pa'i ring / /gzhan gyi 'khur zhing bu gsar skye/ /chos nor gos sogasasngar yod 'phel/ /sngar na med pa'ang gsar du chodab/ /zhi drag 'dres pas snga na rnams 'grub/ /'bri

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 35khyodag la sku gas rig pa 'phel/ /nyams dang lha gas pa'i sku na tan rgyas//rig sngags 'grub cing mkhas pa dang / /ban btsun sngags pa rnams la bzang / /'on te legs spel lam 'phrang bcos/ /rang bsten srung mar gasku la macodad bya/ /de bzhin sgrub na nad med bde/ /sngan ljon pa'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /༈/spen pas lo bdag byedapa'i ring / /rang la bu dang chung mas rtsod/ /blo gros mi gsal le lo che/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi 'tshe ba mang / /yul gzhan 'a24 dang bye bral byed/ /bo nga mas mnar zhing sdoms pa 'asnu ra/ /yam rims klu nad chodag phyed na/ /der dmigs lam bathe sa sachi gdab/ /lan chags gdodar ma brgya rtsa dang / /klu bsangs klu gtor yang yang thongs/ /phal po che yi mdo 3 dang / /'dul ba lung bzhi brgyad rjodang pa/ /17gas cu mun sel bcas pa 'asnga na/ /bathodas su grong khyer ban bon la/ /nya sha dang ni khur ba drongs/ /lto phyogs chu 'gram zangs kyi sbru da/ /chus bkang sha sna khrag sna dag /der sbyar bya rog rnams la sbyin/ /de bzhin khyodan par chang blud bya/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 36༈/lhag pas so/ bdag byed pa'i ring / /lus la rlung khrag cham rims kyi/ /cung zad 'tshe yang cher mig cadad/ /gnyen bo gas dang mthun chodas la rjodar/ /shes rab 'phel zhing ci bsam 'grub/ /dgra mgo non cing rtsod pa rgyal/ /thob dang go sa je mthor 'gro/ /longs rjodad 'phel kha rgyas pa lha/gas/ /skal bzang phun sum co gas par 'gyur//chu ni mar khur song dang 'dra/ /༈/ke tus lo bdag byed pa'i ring / /bu brlag nor 'dzad spun zla 'chi/ /dgra dang 'phrad cing rgyal sngo sa 'alhu mas/ / bud med ma rung rnams dang rtsodad/ /las dang bya ba gang brtsams kyang / /'grub 'grub 'dra la 'grab rgyu med/ /snga na med sdug bsngal drag sngo sa gzer//de tshe ngan 'bras zhi ba'i thabs/ /gdugs dkar brgya rtsa gza' skar yum/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo gang mang 'asnga na/ /'dus pa'i sde la bsnyen bkur da nga / /rin chen sna snurags 'bul bar bya/ /khyad par dge slong rnam dag la/ /rang lus gos kyi spong thag 'bul / / ri mgor dar 'dzugs klung rta gasku la/ /srung ma'i bskangs gasdud drag tu bya/ /bcos

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 37su chu 'khyodar bcu gnyis ni/ /sa yi codag tu blugs par bya/ /༈/dkar pos lo bdag byed pa'i ring / /dkar gro'i chos dang bud med sngo ba/ /bsam pa'i snga na 'grub dge ba 'phel/ /dbyig sku gas cadar chodab grags pa rgyas/ /phun sum snurags pa thams cad 'byung / /'bru nor bu 'khor rgyas pa dang / /khyad par dga' ba'i grogs kyi brtse// snying la dbang gi dri srung ldang / /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 38gnyis pa gtsug lag lha ra thang las/thog mar gces rdel bzhi yi 'bras/ ༈/gnam lo rgyal po'i rde'u ni//dkar na rgyal po'i bka' mi bkyon/ /skyes pa yin na khrom thog chod//bud med yin na gtam snyan lnga sa/ /nag na rgyal wa'i bka' chad 'aho/ga /skyid sdug mang la sdug shas che/ /lus la na tsha rgyun mi chad//༈/zla ba blon po'i lde'u ni/ /dkar ba blon dzo'i grogs mi 'dzol//lung pa phu thung tsam zhig nas/ /skad ni lag ngar tsam zhig 'asnga na/ /nag na blon ngo'i gral nas yar/ /mthon po byams la dma' mo sdang / /rtag tu dgra dang kha smras mod/ /༈/zhag po dmag mi'i rde'u ni/ /dkar na dmag dpung mtha' nas rgyas/ /nad nyung tshe la bar chad med/ /gdon dang 'dre yis gnod mi 'gyur/ /nag na mi kha gleng gzhi 'ong / /mi stong 'jal lam yang na len/ /rtag tu kha smras rgyun mi chad/ /༈/dus tshod mtshon cha'i rde'u ni/ /dkar na mingaXdel 'phro bzang / /mi cadar mtha' nas rgyas pa 〉〈nga / /nag na masnuran cha btsa'

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 39yis khyer/ /dpa' mdung rked pa chag ces te/ /mi cadar kun la ngan par bshad / /༈/srog gi skyes tshang bzang ngan 'bras/ /stag gi lo la gang skyes pa/ / dpa' rtsal yang rtsal che bas te/ /drag rtsal ldan zhing shes pa bkra//snying khams zhin tu che bas te/ /nga bas lhag pa'i mi med zer/ /gnyen la brtse zhing spyod lam rtsing/ /tshig rtsub brtsol phod che ba se/ /blo tamang tshong dang sho la dga'/ /༈/yos bu'i lo la gang skyes pa/ /nga rang kho rang mo rang ste/ /spang wa'i rtsi do/ga rgyas pas na/ /bra mo'i nas la nga mi re/ /rgyal khams mi lo legs pas na/ /kha gang zas kyis mi 'bor te/ /pha drin che rung mi che rung / /mi 'khyags tsam gyi benas kyis bkab/ /ma drin bo/sa la re ba med/ /da lta 'dra na skyid do zar/ /lto chung g.yo che thabs la mkhas/ /khe/nga ngan phral gang 'dzum kha snyi/ /bad mkhris kha sku/ na ba 'byung / /༈/'brug gi sku la gang skyes pa/ /drag rtsal can yang ma lags

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 40te/ /khyodam dang mnyam zhing phra ma khyodang / /skad sngo che yang ma lags te//mi yis brnyas pa mi sku/nga tsam/ /bsnyu na 'grus can yang ma lags te//las la phyi balha la byed ma snu nga / /dus su babs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /dgos don bsgrubs nas bzhag ces zer/ /spro thung sems dkar ku co che/ /gzhan gtam nyan zhing rang tshod chung / /nad dkon 'byung na nyen kha che/ /༈/sprul gyi 'o/ la gang skyes pa/ /gdug rtsub zhe sdang che ba yis//rang rgyud rang gis bsreg pa ste/ /rtsal stobs snying la yod pa yin/ /rang gis rang nyid ma phung na/ /gzhan gyis phrag wa ga byas gyur kyang / /nga la gnod pa mi yong zer/ /kha lce ro gyong zhe nag la/ /gros kha gcig la bathe sa su med/ ho mchin na zhing gdug pa che/ /༈/rta yis 'o/ la gang skyes pa/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan pa'i lo/ /brtson 'grus shin tu che bas te/ /ngan byed stong gis ded gyur kyang / /dmas su rang nyid ma nyan pas/ /tshe gzhugs dkyus la skyid pa casdong / /mi gtam nyan zhing rta la byams/ /'thod mkhyodags gasnga nga srab

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 41rtsed mor dga'/ /rang don gzhag la mi don gnyer/ /smra rgod gnyid chung dar gud che//༈/lug gi lo la gang skyes pa/ /kha nyung shes pa rmongs pa ste/ /ro khyodang za la dga' ba yin/ /gcadad pa gzhan la mi skyel te/ /phan pa 'alnga gas pa ngas mi nus/ /byas pa'i drin la banod rgyu med/ /spro ring sems ni dkar ba yin/ /sku sa dal sku/ nam phyi bswā la byed/ /dga' dang mi dga' mi ston par/ /blor longs che la zas 'brel bzang / /༈/spre'u'i lo la gang skyes pa/ /spro thung khong grims kha bcos chung / /lus yang sha 'dar snying rjodabs chung / /lho yangs la kha'i bya sgro 'dra/ /gar 'gro ci bya cha yang med/ /rtsed 'jor dga' zhing tshig mi brtan/ /gtam mang rdzun la brtsi ba dang / /gtsang gtsang 'dra la btsog zas za/ /bya byed mang la rang mthodang che /༈/bya lo dag la gang skyes pa/ /pha nor yod pa bor stor byas//ma nor yod pa sa la bsres/ /nga rgyal kha gaho nga che ba ste/ /mi tshod yod de rang snurd med/ /chags pa che ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /mthun

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 42bo gas than bo/gas med thabs med/ /khrus gtsang dga' zhing gnyid kyang chung / /mig zhar 'dzum zhing zor yang che/ /'gro na mgo lus bcos nas 'gro/ /blo ngan grogs dad che ba'i lo/ /༈/khyi yi 'o/ la gang skyes pa/ /nga rgyal lta gtum che ba yis /li nang med par byams pa nyung / /rang gi khyo da sa gcig thad /ra bya lkog nor med kyang 'gyod rgyu chung / /rang sems bzhag sa maX skud pas/ /shes pa lho sna mang ba dang / /skam skam tshig tshig byas gyur kyang / /rang rgyud bsreg pa'i me shing yin/ /dmar dad che zhing rkang pa mkhyodags/ /'asnga da chags che zhing 'thod( hūṃ dba'/ /gzhung bzang 'phral khyodang ya rabs byams/ /༈/phag lo dag la skyes pa ni/ /shes pa rmongs shing ro tshod ngan//zas la dga' zhing brtul zhugs che/ /rtsing du smras kyang gzhan mi 'jigs//zhe phugs 'chal bar sku/nga zhes zer/ /ham che lag drin kha yis gasku da//rang la mi phan rdzun tshig mang / /bzang byams ngan sdang bo da pa che/ /ngo nag khong gyong zhe nag lo/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 43༈/byi ba'i 'o/ la gang skyes pa/ /mi la zhe phugs zhe brnag che/ /lho bder bzhag pa'i sa med kyang / /mtshan 'bo/sa kun ma rem pa ste/ /skyid tshe skyid chos 'grub gyur kyang / /skyid du mi ster sdang dgra mang / /phyi ru lha/la la nang du zhib/ /kha yang snying nye lag chung yin/ /rngams chen yal wa ra rngams chung sgrub/ /nyag nyug ti ti khyodar ba byed/ /༈/glang lo dag la gang skyes pa/ /khong gyong bkol ba bka' ba ste//nyal la dga' zhing rgyun ྅7da ngan/ /bsgyur dka' bo sa kha lci ba dang / /nga dang ci yang mi byed de/ /byas na gnam/ sa 'khrug ces smra/ /sku/sa dal mgu dang ma mgu med/ /spro ring las ngan phyi thal che/ /sta che za dga' glang nyal byed/ /ma rig byi ba dang sbyar ba'i/ /rten 'brel sku bstun 'bras bu yang / /'di dang khyad par med par ston//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 44drug cu'i lor brten 'bras bu yang /3shing āo byi ba'i sku pa ni/ /shes pa gsal zhing bzo rigs mkhas/ /g.yo dang kha po gnyis ka che/ /thabs kyis skye bo slu bar byed/ /zas nor 'bring ste klu nad mang / /tshe tshad bdun cu don lnga ste/ /bu skal lnga 'am yang na gsum/ /bar chad bdun dang bcas pacodi/ /༈/shing mo glang gi lo pa ni/ /mtshan mo cung zad gnyid che zhing / /yid gzhungs ser sna che ba yin/ /tshe tshad drug cu tham pa thub//bar chad drug yin zas cadar 'du/ /dgra bla 'phangs shing 'phung sri dang / /dur sa brus pas sa bdag gcadad/ /yang na shing gi sa bdag gnod/ /༈/me pho stag gi lo pa ni/ /khro gtum che la lus po drag /mig zlum khengs pa che ba yin/ /rang la mi phan bo gas la gcadad/ /rtag tu kho nga gcadang na ba mang / /dad pa chung zhing cad thung sngo / /chung ma gnyis kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /bu yi skal pa bzhi dang ldan/ /tshe tshad don dgu bar chad lnga/ /yon tan can gyi rigs su skye/ /gri dang mdze yis

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 45na ba codang / /nad gzhi klu dang bad gan che/ /༈/me mo sku sa kyi so/ pa ni/ /sems khyodan che zhing ngag mi snyan/ /bden par mi smra g.yo dang ldan/ /gzhan gyi khyodan rnams khyodag byed cing / /rang gi yon tan bstod pa byed/ /bud med dag la rab tu dga'/ /dam pa dag la mi bsten cing / /de ni rang bzhin mkhas pa can/ /bar chad bdun dang bcas pa yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu snga na lnga thub/ /zas cadar longs khyodad che ba yin/ /sa bdag dang ni rgyal sngo gachodad/ /pha mes mdze ro bya khyis jo sa/ /chu ser grang ba'i nad dang ni/ /snying rlung shin tu che ba 'o//༈/sa pho 'brug gi lo pa ni/ /bden par mi smra ngag skyon che/ /le lo che zhing chang la dga'/ /gzhan gyi bud med spyod par byed/ /de ni mgu ba'i sems dang ldan/ /lus la nad kyi gathegad pa nyung / /sems ni yang zhing g.yo sgyu che/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu rtsa lnga thub/ bar chad drug dang ldan pa yin/ /bu skal lnga 'am yang na bdun/ /sku/na tan can gyi rigs su skye/ /zas nor longs spyod dang po che/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 46 ༈/sa mo sprul gyi lo pa ni/ /sems stobs che la rtsal dang ldan//zas sdudar 'o/ngas khyodad che ba yin/ /rku 'a'o/ga dgra yi 'jig pa che/ /mi g.yang nyams la rdzas rdo ra 'byung / /skyes pa byes su shi ba sku nga chu shing gnyan snga'i sa bdag gcadad/ /nga rgyal kho nga lta lus sems nag (/yang na dkar/) /chags sems che la phrag kyang lhunag /le lo sdig pa'i bo/gas la dga'/ (yang na chos la dkar/) /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa dgu thub/ /bar chad bzhi dang ldan pa yin/ /zas cadar skal ba che ba dang / /bu skal drug dang ldan pa yin/ /nal dang lceb grir shi ba yod/ /gri mtshon ngo dang 'bras rdzog 'ong / /༈/lcags ho rta yi 'o/ pa ni/ /le 7 ce zhing gnyen la dga'/ /gzhan skyon blta la rang skyon spangs/ /bza' ba dag la dga' ba byed/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu rtsa bdun thub/ /bar chad dgu dang bu skal bzhi/ /nor god che zhing bu gasku/ dka'/ /mkhar las byas pas sa bdag galhund/ /nad gzhi grang rlung shas cher 'byung / /༈/lcags mo lug gi lo pa zhi/ /lus rgyas dbang po dul ba te/ /dran

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 47rig chung zhing mig nad codang / /tshe tshad brgyad cu gya gcig ste/ /bar chad bzhi dang dgra gasnyad mang / /kha smras mang zhing bu skal nyung / /gdon du klu btsan gathegad pa yin/ /༈/chu pho spre'u'i lo pa ni/ /sgyu rtsal che la dbang po rno/ /dran rig che zhing 'du byed bzang / /tshe tshad lnga bcu nga bdun te/ /bar chad bdun dang ldan pa yin/ /grong khyer lnga yi bdag por 'gyur/ /me phung 'bar 'dra'i sa bdag gis/ /mi gcadad skyodabs pa shin tu che/ /bu yi skal ba gsum tsam yod/ /longs spyod che zhing blo lto ste/ /dme dang skrag rtsub yong dogs yod/ /༈/chu mo bya yi lo pa zhi/ /lus sems gnyis ka g.yeng ba ste /sems ni mi brtan brjed ngas che/ /'gro la dga' zhing grogs po mang / /g.yo la dga' zhing chad mi btsan/ /tshe tshad drug cu tham pa thub/ /bar chad dgu dang bcas pacad/ /mkhas nyen gzhan gyi dbang du 'bo / /shing la gnas pa'i sa bdag gcadad/ /nad gzhi rlung dang tshad pa lhanangs/ /thenags spro khyim mtshes la 11gas pa/ /nye ba dgrar sdang bu skal gnyis/ /chu mig

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 48zhe'u gsing klu sman 'go/ /grong khyer ser skya'i 'gong po gnod/ /༈/shing āo khyi yi lo pa ni/ /sgyu rtsal che la dbang po rno/ /dran rigs che zhing lus byad bzang / /tshe tshad bdun cu don dgu ste/ /bar chad lnga dang ldan pa yin/ /grong khyer bdag po'i rje bo 'ong / /me phung 'bar ba 'dra ba nas/ /kla btsan bzang 14sa thebang bo/gas byed/ /bu gsum 'phral gyi longs spyod che/ /dme dang lag btsog 'ong dogs yod/ /༈/shing snu phag gi lo pa ni/ /lus dang sha dag che ba ste/ /shin tu khro zhing gtum pa la/ /(wang du nga phra yang ba yin/ /zas dang bud med nyal la gcadad/ /bo gas dang mdza' chadas slu bar byed/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ /bar chad lnga dang ldan pa yin/ /mi de ngan par cadang ro/gas yodad/ /rabs chad ho ra gyi phan par 'gyur/ /༈/me āo byi ba'i 'o /pa ni/ /sems bskyed che zhing dran pa mang / /nor dang zas la sred pa che/ /gzhan ༷/ mazurgang codrog smra la mkhas/ /brku dang sku ga ga༄ da las la brtsodan/ /tshe tshad drug cu re brgyad thub/ /bar chad lnga dang ldan pa yin/ /g.yang ri gangs ri'i rtse snu nas/ /klu sman

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 49bzang smad 'thod bar byed/ /'o/ nad 'byams nad tshad pa dang / /snying nad can du 'gyur ba yin/ /kha mang gting ni khyodam par 'gyur/ /༈/me shā glang gi so/ pa ni/ /lus che gnyid che shes pa 'thibs mig gi dbang sngo nyams par 'gyur/ /kha zas 'o/ngas spyodache ba yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa gcig thub/ /bar chad brgyad dang bcas pa cadang / lha khang rgyal wa'i gcadad pa thodang / /'bru dang rkang srin 'phel bar 'gyur//dgra 'dre'i gnod pa shas kyang chung / /bu skal gcig dang bu mo gnyis//nad ni bad gan shas cher 'byung / /༈/sa ho/ stag gi sku pa ni/ /lus rgyas zhe sdang gsod la dga'/ /zas la srid pa che bas te/ /rdzun dang yig mtshang smra la mkhas/ /dgra dang 'dre yi gachodad pa nyung / /zhing sa stag gzhung 'dra ba na/ /sa bdag 'phye'o gnod par 'gyur/ /nad du skran dang dmu chu 'ong / /tshe tshad bdun cu snga na gnyis thub/ /bar chad bdun dang bcas pa cardo/ /brag ri'i rtsa nas klu btsan gcadad/ /bu yi skal ba gnyis tsam sku da//༈/sa mo yos kyi lo pa ni/ /smra ba mang la shes rab che/ /sgra dang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 50bstan bathe sa kun la mkhas/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu tham pa thub/ /bar chad drug dang bu skal gcig /zas nor longs spyod chung ba yin/ /gzhan gyi bud med spyod par byed/ /ku re kyal ka dag la dga'/ /mtha' bzhi'i gnyen la 'phung khyodad mang / /rgyal rigs klu rigs klu 'gras dang / /pha mes mdze yis gnod pa yod/ /slo gcong nad kyis shi ba 'ong //༈/lcags pho 'brug gi lo pa ni/ /lus rgyas stobs dang ldan pa yin//nga rgyal che zhing smra la mkhas/ /nga rgyal sdig pa'i las la bce na/ /dge ba'i las la phyi bshol byed/ /nor ni god kha che ba yin/ /sdig dga' phyi nang gnyis gar rtsub/ /kha 'jam che zhing snying la ngan/ /zas la dga' zhing bden par smra/ /shes pa brtan la gzhan mtshang bakhyodad/ /tshe tshad brgyad cu tham pa thub/ /bar chad gsum dang ldan pa ste/ /bu ni cig gam yang na lnga / /longs spyod shin tu che ba yin/ /spyo 'bog rgyal po la sogs gnod/ / ༈/lcags snu/ sbrul gyi 'o/ pa ni/ /shes pa gsal la bzo rig mkhas//gzhan gyi mtshang tshig brtag la dga'/ /snu ma rkun dgra dang gcadad pa

————— martsisa'abras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 51mang / /pyo bang / ngan dag dang 'bral ba yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu snga na brgyad yin/ /bar chad drug dang bcas patso// /zas canar sngar chung phyis nas che/ /pha ma gnyis dang 'bo/gas yun thung / /gzhan dring che la pha mes sar/ /mdze dang rims kyis shi ba yod/ /lceb gri'i gdon dang gtad phur gnod/ /nad gzhi gag ltog hpho bur dang / /yang na spyo 'thodag yodang ba yin/ /bu skal gsum ni sku nga bar bshad/ /༈/chu pho rta yi so/ pa ni/ /shes rab shin tu che bar bshad/ /gzhan khyodan mi chodag baX la mkhas/ /ma rig 'khrul chung dpal dang ldan/ /sku nam res sku da res med byed/ /kho nga drang sgyu chung gzhan khyodan mkhas// gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'bo/ ste/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa bdun nam/ /yang na lnga bcu lnga bdun thub/ /bar chad brgyad dang bcas pacad/ /zas chodar sku ngas rje/da che ba yin/ /bu yi skal ba gsum mam bzhi /nad gzhi snying rlung 'phyo bar 'gyur/ /sa bdag dang ni phur kha gachodad/ /rabs chad nor gyi 'phungs 'dre gnod/ /dkar dang chodar la rgyal bsen gnod/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 52༈/chu mo lug gi lo pa ni/ /shes rab chung zhing 'gro la dga'//sred pa'i 'du shes che ba yin/ /bar chad lnga dang bu skal nyung / /zas nor longs spyod che ba yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa gsum thub/ /rku 'aho ga dgra yis 'jigs pa 'byung / /g.yang nyams rta phyugs ༄/ra bar cadang / /skyes pa byes su shi ba sku nga / /shing gnyan chu gnyan sa bdag gnod// nad du bad gan che ba yong /༈/shing pho spre'u'i lo pa ni/ /lus rgyas gdung sems shin tu che//bar chad bdun dang ldan pa yin/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bsten la dga'/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa brgyad thub /gnyid chung dgra mang sems g.yo che/ /rang don chung zhing yul gnyis 'dzin/ /nad mang gyod rtsod gzhi ma byed/ /chu klung ri gzar rtse snu/ nas/ /btsan dang sa bdag rgyal sngo gcadad/ /zas kyis skal ba mjo dman che/ /bu yi skal ba lnga 'am gardobyeg /༈/shing mo bya yi la pa ni/ /lus po ljo zhing gcong nad mang / /rgan rim dag la nad gzhis 'khrug /gnyen dang cangab 'khrug par 'gyur/ /tshe

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 53tshad drug cu tham pa thub/ /thodags dang gnyen tshan dgra ru ldang / /'thab rtsod la dga' 'dre mo dang / /dam las 'das pa'i gre mo gnod/ /bu ci) skal ba gardobyeg gam ga//ma/ /༈/me pho khyi yi 64 pa ni/ /nad mang rabs chad gum ma 'dra/ /sems dge spro ring gartsa tho khyed/ /dben gnas sa bdag gnod cing sdig /grong khang mes 'tshig cardong bar 'gyur/ /tshad nad mkhris pa'i na tsha lhanang / /gre bo btsan dang sa bdag gachodad/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa rgyad yin/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gsu/ma/ /༈/me mo phag gi 'o/ pa ni/ /lus ngan nad kyi gnod pa mang / /ya rabs gong ma dgra ru ldang / /grong khang me yis 'tshig pa dang / /tshad nad mkhris pa shas che cadang / /gre thod btsan dang sa bdag galha da/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa brgyad yin/ /bar chad bdun dang bcas pacad/ /bu yi skal ba gsum dang ldan/ /༈/sa pho byi ba'i lo pa ni/ /lus thung srog gcod las la dga'//yid gzhungs sems lha/na che ba yin/ /nad ni bad gan ho/ ba lci/ /ma25na

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 54phog gri ru 'chi ba 'ong / /kha 'jam rang 'dod che ba yin/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa brgyad thub/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gcig /༈/sa mo glang gi lo ba ni/ /lus lci nga rgyal skyon sems che zas chodar 'o/ngas khyodad chung ba yin/ /gzhis la gnas pa'i sa bdag gechodad// mi kha bag tsam sdang ba yin/ /khyod sems rtsub la khyodang zhing gtum/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu tham pa thub/ /bu skal gcig dang bar chad bdun/ /༈/lcags pho stag gi lo pa ni/ /khro gtum gsod cing gtong la dga'/ /lus ྅/ bzang zhing sha yang dkar/ /sha chang chags sems sred pa che/ /tshig rtsub smra yang gri mchosan sngo / /btsan dang rgyal sngo gachodad pa yin/ /tshe yi tshad ni drug cu ste/ /gro bur ye 'drog bar chad lnga / /bu skal gnyis sam yang na bzhi/ /zas cadar sku/ngas ྅7da mi brten cad/ /༈/lcags snu sku sa kyi 'o/ pa ni/ /sems rgya che zhing dad yid gzhungs/ /bsnyu na 'grus che zhing shes rab swā / /mi la byams shing gdodang sems che// gzer zug nad mang sku/na tan che/ /grir ni 'chi ba'i nyen yod de/ /dme dang sa bdag gnod pa 'ong / /mkhar steng lha khang bsen

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 55mo gnod/ /tshe tshad drug cu re gcig ste/ /bar chad lnga dang bu skal lnga // zas nor longs spyod bag tsam yod/ /༈/chu ho 'brug gi lo pa ni/ /lus la sme ba'i mtshan ma sku da /yul mkhar mi rtag yang yang brje/ /mda' lha/gas rtsed mo'i las la dga'// chodar dang bu tshar rabs chad mang / /mi rgyud glen pa'i nye 'brel mang //tshe tshad drug cu re gnyis thub/ /bar chad drug dang ldan pa yin/ /bu yi skal ba lnga 'am gcig /zas chodar gang rjodang che ba yin/ /༈/chu mo sprul gyi lo pa ni/ /snying nas zhe sdang che ba yin/ /grogs la mi yis sku ngas ྅7da che/ /lag bag yid kyis phra ma smra/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa brgyad thub/ /mi rgyud rabs chad mang ba sku nga / /cadar la rgyal wa'i gachodad pa sku da/ /brag dmar la gnas sa bdag gachodad/ /grang rlung nad kyis nyen par 'gyur/ /khar 'asnga na yang la kho nga pa chung / /bu yi skal ba nyung bar bshad/༈/shing pho rta yi lo pa ni/ /g.yo sgyu che la 'grogs mi bde/ /zhe sdang che la blo sna brtul/ /dad pa dang ni dung sems chung / /shed dang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu 11 gsal 'ga' skyed/ 56brtul sdo/gas che ba ci)na/ /bosags la dga' la smra ba mang / /nad gzhi rlung dang bad kun ldang / /rgyal ngo sa bdag gcadad pa yin/ /tshe tshad drug cu bu skal gcig /bar chad gsum gsum dag la 'byung / / ༈/shing mo lug gi lo pa ni/ /lus rgyas dbang po gsal ba ste/ /tshe tshad drug cu bu skal gnyis/ /bar chad gsum dang ldan pa yin/ /shes pa blun la zas la dga' / /༈/me pho spre'u'i lo pa ni/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa bdun thub/ /nad gzhi rlung dang mkhris pa mang / /bonas dang rgyan la dga' ba na/ /bar chad lnga dang ldan pa yin/ /grong khyer lnga yi ded dpon 'gyur/ /zas nor longs spyod che ba yin/ /bu yi skal ba lnga dang ldan/ /kha yang ngo thodad stobs kyang che/ /'dod chags che la gzhan mtshang rtog /nga rgyal che zhing chodar la ngan / /༈/me mo bya yi 'o/ pa ni/ /sems mang g.yo sgyu kha po che/ /lag pa bzo la gdong yang drag /rku dang srog gcod las la brtson/ /brjed ngas che zhang 'dod pa che/ /dur khrod lha khang 'dre mo gnod/ /tshe tshad

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 57drug cu malnga thub/ /bar chad drug dang ldan pa ste/ /gri mtshon nad kyi 'jigs pa che/ /byi la shin tu dga' ba yin/ /༈/sa pho khyi yi lo pa ni/ /spro thung khro zhing blo sems mang / /byed tshig mang la 'dod zhen che/ /mi la 'phya dga' rtse mo rem/ /rlung mkhris nad gzhi shin tu che/ /shi ba'i mi dang 'askra/gas pa rmi/ /snying mi dga' zhing sku ngas ྅7da chung / /bu yi skal ba gsum mam bzhi/ /yang mes za 'dre gachodad par byed/ /tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad bdun/ /༈/sa mo phag gi 'o/ pa ni/ /shes rgya chung zhing dgra gachodad mang //gnyen shes mi la phan chodags nyung / /14na chad bsten pa'i ༄ ༄ dang / /nya 'dra'i zhing nas sa bdag gcadad/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa bdun thub/ /bar chad drug dang bu skal gnyis/ /zas nor longs spyod che ba yin//༈/lcags pho byi ba'i sku pa ni/ /lus rgyas shes pa gsal ba yin//kyal ka dag la rab dga' zhing / /mang po'i gseb na snying ltar mdzes//dad pa che zhang kun la 'jug /phan gachodad nus pa dgra bgegs nyung /'thab mo la dga' nor god che/ /mi don che la rang don chung / /tshe

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 58tshad lnga bcu nga bdun te/ /bu skal lnga dang bar da drug /nor dang 'bru 〉rgags brtan pa yin/ /rgyal po'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing / /mi rnams kun gyis 'khur bar 'gyur//༈/lcags mo glang gi 'o/ pa ni/ /lus yang bzo rigs kun shes shing / /byed pa bzang (ra thod snga na che/ /nad dang dgra yis gcadad pa nyung / /gnyid dang le 'o/ che ba yin/ /bo gas dang rgyal sngo sa dga' bar byed/ /chu la gnas pa'i sa bdag gnod/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu rtsalnga ste/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis/ /gtum zhing shin tu khyodang ba yin//༈/chu bo stag gi lo pa zhi/ /lus rag nyam rtsal dag dang ldan/ /rang lus mthong zhing bstod la dga'/ /sems skyon che zhing bcos pa dka'//kha ru dkar la gting la nag /bud med dag dang rjodar la dga'/ /gzhan gyi bud med rku bar byed/ /tshe tshad snga na gcig bar chad bdun/ /chung ma bye bral bu skal gcig /zas dang nor la gang stong che//༈/chu snu sku sa kyi 'o/ pa ni/ /mi rnams kun la blo mi blta da/ /smra ru ngo sdog sdig grogs che/ /tshong dang gnyid la dga' ba ste/ /pha yi gdon

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 59sa 'phrog pa yin/ /brjed ngas dang ni ser sna che/ /dur khrod lha khang rgyal po gnod/ /g.yang sa chen po rmi bar byed/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa gnyis thub/ /bu skal ya 'ud che ba yin/ /༈/shing pho 'brug gi lo pa ni/ /nga blo yang la bzo rigs mkhas//ngag 'jam smra mkhas 'bo/gas pa bde/ /nad ni mkhris shas che ba yin//'gro 'dug la sdudags 'du byed mang / /tshe tshad drug cu re drug yin/ /bar chad drug dang bu skal nyung / /chu mig chung ngu'i sa bdag gachodad/ /mi ni shin tu phrag thodag che/ /zas cadar dbang thang ldan pa yin/ /༈/shing mo sprul gyi lo pa ni/ /sems chung lus ring nga blo yang //ya rabs byams la ma rabs sdang / /nad nyung bu dang ldan pa yin/ /rang 'dod shin tu che ba'i mi/ /zas nor longs spyod che ba yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu thodan bdun thub/ /bar chad bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ /kha la yangs shing gting la dog /nor la ngan la rang mthong che/ /༈/me pho rta yi lo pa ni/ /khro gtum che la nga blo yang / /kha grags che la 'thab la dag/ /chodar ni phugs su chung ba yin/ /rta dang khyi la

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 60brtse ba ste/ /mi la gnod cing grogs la bakhyodan/ /de ni chung ma ngag dang ldan/ /longs spyod mi rtag 'dod thag nye/ /nad ni gro gzer tshad nad mang / /gre bo dang zhi rgyal po gnod/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis//tshe tshad bdun cu snga na brgyad thub/ /༈/me mo lug gi 'o/ pa ni/ /lus rgyas gzhung bzang phyi thag ring / /sems la bsam pa'i snga na rnams 'grung / /sgra snyan yid codang ngo shes shing / /nor srid che la bar chad bdun/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa bdun te/ /bu dang tsha thod mang ba yin/ /dgra dang gdon gyi gnod pa mang / /zhing sa zur gsum sa bdag gathe/da/ /nad gzhi mkhal ma gcong nad 'ong / /༈/sa pho spre'u'i lo pa ni/ /'grogs la bde zhing spyod lam mdzes//shes pa dal la smra ba mkhas/ /byed pa thams cad snga na sku da 'gyur/ /nga rgyal chung zhing snga na dang ldan/ /mi rnams kun gyis bkur bar codis tshe tshad bdun cu sngo na brgyad yin/ /bar chad tshe 'phrang dgu cod nga zhing / /bu skal dag kyang gsum du 'ong / /nor dang phyugs su ldan pa ste/ /nad

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 61gzhi rlung dang bad gan coding / /zhing sa zlum sngo dag gnas kyi/ /sa bdag rje rigs gnod par byed/ /༈/sa mo bya yi lo dag ni/ /nga blo yang la shes pa gsal/ /mi rnams byams la kha khyod thung / /phrag snga ga ser sna che ba ste/ /nga rgyal che zhing 'asnga da chags che/ /khang zhing dag gi sa bdag gasbyadad/ /mig dang dbang sngo/ nyams pa dang / /nad ni mkhris pa che ba yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad bdun/ /bu skal drug dang ldan pa yin/ /༈/lcags wo khyi yi lo pa ni/ /shes pa gsal zhing spyod lam mdzes//sems dkar dge ba dag la bakhyodan/ /bzo rigs mkhas la smra wa na nyung / /'jig rten rig pa shin tu rmongs/ /gnyid che 'bru nor 'phel bar 9ragyur/ /bu yi skal ba gsum mam bzhi/ /khrel dang thong tsha shes pa'o/ /de la chom po'i 'jigs pa 'ong / /tshe tshad don bdun bar chad bdun//༈/lcags mo phag gi lo pa ni/ /shes pa gsal zhing spyod lam dzes//skyes pa kun gyis 'bul ba'i gnas/ /bud med gnyis dang ldan pa yin//

ljo|sa'abrasabublogasala'aga'askyed/ 62 ————— — —————— —— —dpal yang shin tu che ba yin/ /dang ༷ / 'a(war gyi sa la gachodad/ /bu yi skal ba gnyis sam bzhi/ /bar cha da bdun dang ldan pa yin/ /tshe tshad bdun cu thub nga ra babad/ /༈/chu pho byi ba'i lo pa ni/ /shin tu mdzes la sems phran cha/ /tshe tshad bdun cwa rtsa gnyis 'acokha/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis/ /yang na lnga yang 'byung ba srid/ /zas rā ra bo da yang che ba yin/ /'asnga da chags byi la dga' ba yin/ /〈peng pa gasku dang khram gyis brgyangs/ /zas cadar dag la shin tu brnag /shar nas shing gnyan sa bdag gathe/da/ /༈/chu mo glang gi lo pa ni/rī/dzee rigs shin tu glen pa ste/ /gnyid dang le 'o/ che ba yin/ /lo ni bdun cu bar chad bdun/ /zhe ngan tshig rtsub ngag mi snyan/ /rang malnga nga rang 'asnga da shin tu che/ /gzhan ma rnams la kha mjal byed/ /tha ma/ g.yu yi bya ba mang / bu yi ro ni grangs med mchodang / /pyori bsregs sa nas sa bdag gcadad/ /༈/shing pho stag gi lo pa ni/ /khro gtum 'thab rtsod las la dga' //lo ni drug cu re drug thub/ /bar chad lnga dang bu skal gsum/ /zas nor

ma rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 63skal ba che ba yin/ /'thodad chags che la mig ser tsha/ /gting ni phrag dog rang 'dod che/ /rang min rnams ni lkugs par gtong / /nad ni skran dang dmu chu 'byung / /gri dang mtshon gyis shi ba 'ong / /gag ltog nad 'byung sa bdag gcadad/ /shi khar bud med blangs pa dang / ma yar bu yar sdug pa 'ong / /bus pa nal bu ngos blang 'ong / /byi la dga' zhing mtshan 'gros byed/ /ra dang snga nga bu'i phyir 'brangs pa'i/ /rgyal po dang ni the brang gnod/ /༈/shing mo yos kyi 'o/ pa ni/ /shin tu g.yo dang ldan pa yin /bud med dag la shin tu dag 'a/ /gzhan gyi chung ma rku bar byed/ /mdza' bo dag la dga' bar byed/ /rtsed mo glu gar rtag tu byed/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa bdun thub/ /nad dang dgra yi 'jigs pa mang / /gzhan gyis mi lhag sku nga ba dang / /ma yar bu yar nal byas/ sku da/ /rang mchodang che la blo sna mang / /ra dang bong bu'i phyir 'brangs nas/ /bse rags la sku gas gcadad pa 'byung / /bar chad drug dang bcas pa ste/ /bu tsha snga tshar phyi tshar 'ong //

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 64༈/me pho 'brug gi lo pa ni/ /lus rgyas nor dang ldan par smra//gnyen mthun 'thab ce da byed par 'gyur/ /rkun ma dgra yis gasbyadad pa mang / /khyim mi yug sa ce/ la dbang / /za 'asnga da rgyu ngan lag rtsal che/ /tshe tshad bdun cu rtsa gcig 'chos/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis/ /nad ni rlung mkhris 'dom pa 'ong / /nor phyir the brang 'brangs pa yod/ /zas nor longs spyod che ba yin/ /༈/me mo sprul gyi lo pa ni/ /lus rgyas nad nyung rogs mo mang //bud med lnga 'am bdun la dbang / /phyug cing grong khyer bdag por 'gyur//gzhan kha 'dzin cing kun gyis 'khur/ /bzo rig bstan bsnyu sa kun la mkhas/ /tshe tshad bdun cu sngo na gcig 'asnum/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis/ /nad gzhi rlung dang mkhris pa 'ong / /mkhar stong dang ni phug rdugs nang / /pha mes bkra yi dur gyi sa/ /bya dang khyi yis brus pa nas/ /bgegs rigs klu dang sa bdag galha/da/ /mtha' gzhugs mtshon grir 'chi ba 'ong /lhas ho rta yi sku pa ni/ /dpa' zhing khyod thung tshig mi brtan/ /mkhas

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 65dman kun gyi re sar sku/da/ /bsku da nams dag la bar chad che/ /dgra dang nad kyi gnod pa mang / /tshe tshad bdun cu don lnga ste/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal gnyis/ /'khon dang chos dkor lha 'dres gnod/ /phur kha rgyal 'dres gathegad pa yin/ /zla gam zhing nas sa bdag gasbyand/ /༈/sa mo lug gi 'o/ pa ni/ /nad mang dgra yi 'jigs pa 'byung / /tshe tshad drug cu bar chad bzhi/ /bu sring nor sar dgra ngo sdang / /phur kha dang ni mdze gri gcadad/ /phyi mi byams la nang mis sdang / /thodad kha che zhing gcig brgyud byed/ /skyid sdug spel mar bshad pa yin/ /kha nas the co ma zer la dga' / /yid ni bu mo'i ༷ gas su 'phyo// bud med yin na pho la 'phyo/ /rang 'dod nga rgyal che ba yin/ /༈/lcags pho spre'u'i lo pa ni/ /mthong na skyes bu kun dga' zhing / /shin tu gzugs mdzes yid du 'ong / /nor dang longs spyod che ba yin/ /rtsal che thodad che dme byed srid/ /kun gyi zas 'chortal rgyas khar skyid/ /tshe tshad bdun cu bar chad brgyad/ /bu skal lnga 'am yang na gcig /lha yi phur kha gcadad pa dang / /'kho na dang grib kyis btab

tshephyiga'abrasabablogasala'aga'adzed /— 66pa dang / /pha mes mgo rus gcan zos yod/ /lceb 'dre ma mo'i gnod pa yin/ /dmag dang dgra yis 'jigs pa 'byung / /༈/lcags mo bya yi lo pa zhi/ /dpal dang dbang phyug che ba yi/ /nor dang 'bru yang phel bar 'gyur/ /bza' btung gnyis ka che ba dang //chags sems che zhing dgra la dga' / /skye wa'i gatheb dur 'gyur ba yin//longs spyod dag la rtag tu gnas/ /dme 'dre dang ni mdze 'dre gnod//tshe tshed bdun cu thub pa yin/ /bar chad bdun dang bu skal bzhi/ /nad gzhi rlung dang tshad pa 'ong / /27/chu pho khyi yi lo pa ni/ /skyes bo rtag tu ser sna can/ /nad dang dgra yi 'jigs pa 'byung / /mi sdug mtshan ma mang ba ste/ /lus 14 nad dang maco na gyis nyen/ /gnyen dang bo gas kyis mi shes shing / /sdig dang mi dge las las brtson/ /tshe tshad drug cu rtsa gsum ste/ /'dre gasbyand bgegs dang sa bdag gcadad/ /bse rags dang ni rgyal re sa gnod/ /bu dang nor gyi skal ba chung / /mtshon dang rgyal pos 'jigs pa 'byung / /

da martsisa'abras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 67༈/chu mo phag gi lo pa ni/ /shes rgya che zhing lho gros rtan/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal phrag dog can/ /'byed la dga' zhing nor dang ldan/ /tshe tshad drug cu bar chad lnga / /bu skal bzhi ste ba lang dang / /zas chodar 'bru yi bdag 14ra 'gyur/ /dur btab klu la ho/ga pa'am/ /shing la gnas pa'i sa bdag gcadad/ /yang na zhang nye'i khyodags nas gcadad/ /lceb gri rbab tu song dogs yod/ /

(rtsisa'abrasabu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 68rang skyes lus kyi tshang bstan pa/de yang bsdus pa lus lnga'i 'bras/ /shing ni khog stong kun tu rgyu/ /zas casar 'khyams zhes bya ba ste/ /lhand can sbya/ra rten bye brag gis/rme /rgyal gcand bsris rku bo/gas kha rgyu/ /pha mes lha gswā da las mi 'grub/ /sku/da mi bden la med mi brdzun/ /dri za'i grong khyer bcoms pa 'dra/ /nor la gang stongs 'phar 'bub 'ong / /༈/me ni srid pa sna khyams zhes/ /pho mo yugs sa snga tshar dang //phyir tshar bya ro rlung khyer ba/ /nya ro chur khyer phor chag dang / /gzar chag mda' gzhu chag pa bsdebs/ /༈/sa ni bye ri'i tho thon de/ /khang sa dur sa'i 'khor lo yin/ /mi ni khyed kyi mi rgyud la/ /phu yi dur kha gyed sa ru/ /mda' yi dur kha gyed pa yin/ /rta tshang sbangs bzhin kha ni 'chodar/ /mi sgab dang ni phyugs phyir 'brangs/ /lte ba bcad pa'i rang khyim du/ /nam phyags 'dzin pa dka' bcad/ /yul mkhar lnga ra ram gnyis su 'dzin/ /lung pa skya rer mi res 'dzin/ /lcags ni nam mkha' kho ga yangs te/ /dme dang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 69'thab la dga' zhes bya/ /gnam gyi nyi zla sa la lhung / /rgyab ni zhar nas skam pa dang / /gzhu mo cirgags nas chag pa yin/ /drag spro yin kyang rang tshe thung / /khyed kyi pha tshan gseb nas phar/ /la lung rjodang par gris bsad dam/ /gris ni thod rgal shi ba yod/ /de med khyed la gri ngo 'kho ra/ /mtho na bsrung gdags shing gri sri mnan/ /tshe bsring sku ga skyed mang du bgyis/ /༈/chu bo sdug bsngal 'khyil ba ste/ /nad dang 'dre lo 'khyams zhes bya/ /tshe snga ma yi rum du zad/ /de las thar nas smra gul lam/ /brda ni gul ba byung dogs yod/ /de dag ma byung tshe bar la/ /so khyi sma ra'i ag tshoms sam/ /drug po sho re nyi ma mig /me lce rdo rje ri mo 'am//de lta bu yi mtshan rtags gcig /'char ni dathodas pa yin cho zer/ /ma shar klu mo dalnga sa yin te/ /phyag gnyis pho ba la ni 'jus/ /sgal tshig rtsib grangs btub nyen sku da/ /klu gtor dang ni chu gaho ra la/ /nan tan che ru byas na phan/ /de min lag ngar sngas su 'dzud/ /brla sha byin pa gdan du 'ding / /nyi ma ring thung dag gi nang / /du byed pa 'ong nyen

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 70pa yong /kha sku/ga ༄/ma cu tham pa las/༈/shing pho byi dang shing mo glang / /da ltar rang 'thag 'dre can ni/ /khyim na sku da pa'i rus 'dre sa gnod/ /de yang skyes dus dgu mig gam/ /ma de lcags sam dwa yi steng / /btsas na rkang zhabs ska rags man/ /nad ldang spar sme gso skyed btsas/ /rkang kyog dbang po ma tshang 'byung //༈/me pho stag dang me mo yos/ /da lta ma phyi las 'khris pa'i / / gre mo klu dang bsdongs pa gnod/ /ma de chu 'am kham btsas na/ /phung po drod chung sro ma yi/ /nad kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / /gso bskyed phung po dar zhing rgyas//༈/sa pho 'brug dang sa mo sprul/ /da lta gzhong pa la sogs stod//kha chag pa la chags pa'i/ /'dre dang sa srin bakhyodangs pa gachodad/ /spar kha zin nam ma khrigang la/ /btsas na nam zhig gasdorshang zhugs te/ /ska rags man la nad bu coding/ /gasku/ bskyed la btsas mi 'bru srab/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 71༈/lcags pho rta dang lcags mo lug /da lta zhang nye'i khang zhing gi/klu 'am sa bdag klu btsan gcade/ /kham mam ma chu la btsas na/ /snying ga'i nad dang nam zhig dus/ /snying rlung gi ni nad ldang 'gyur/ /༈/chu pho spre'u chu mo bya/ /da lta khyim phyed zhig pa dang / /zhing la chags pa'i lha 'dre galha da/ /gshed bzhi'am mes ho/ sar btsas na//thams cad snying sdug lir btsas ngan/ / ༈/shing pho khyi dang shing mo phag /da lta klu dang 'gong po gachod/ /khon nam a ma sa par btsas/ /bud med 'alhund chags 6)ga shes med/ /phal cher nad cordong ma'i mthun gsum/ /btsas na bzang zhing bu mang la//'asnga da chags che ba bshad pa yin/ /༈/me pho byi dang me mo glang / /da lta 'khon dang grib chags pas//'gong po be bo gachod pa yin/ /ma de gshed bzhi 'am sa khams la/ /btsas na mig ngan sku/nga lha/gas 'byung / /mthun gsum la btsas mig gsal 'byung / /༈/sa pho stag dang sa mo yos/ /da lta mes dang khu bo yi/ /ring

tshe rtsis 'bras bu 〈sna gsal 'ga' skyed/ 72gi rabs chad 'dre gcadad zer/ /lir btsas ma mgal nad 'ong zhing / /ming 14 la ni ngan par bshad/ /༈/lcags pho 'brug dang lcags mo sprul/ /da lta lto re sa bdag gachod/ /ma de me 'am li thodag btsas/ /mabo la rtag par nad kyis 'dzin //༈/chu pho rta dang chu mo lug /da lta sa srin klu bsdongs sam/ /sa bdag gnyan dang rked cadam la// chags 'dre gcadad pa yin zhes bya/ /ma de lcags sam da thog btsas/ mi de'i skra ni ngan par 'ong / /༈/shing pho sprel dang shing mo bya/ /da lta klu srin sa bdag gnod//ma de sa 'am gin la btsas/ /bu de sna dbyibs mi legs 'byung / /༈/me pho khyi dang me mo phag /da lta lha gdon rgyal po gnod/ /ma de chu 'am kham thodag btsas/ /snying rlung shas cher ldang ba 'byung /༈/sa āo byi ba sa mo glang / da lta btsan gre 'gong po gnod/ /yang na sa bdag gatheṭad pa yin/ /ma de chu 'am kham 11ga btsas/ /mi de'i mthod la drod mi 'byung /༈/lcags sgyu stag dang lcags snu mo sa/ /da lta 'byung 'dre 'bo nga

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 73po gcadad/ /ma de lcags sam dwa chodag skyes/ /sgal tshigs rtag par na 'dod che//༈/chu pho 'brug dang chu mo sprul/ /da lta sa bdag klu 'dre gnod//ma de chu 'am kham chodag btsas// grang ba shas che mkhal nad ldang //༈/shing pho rta dang shing mo lug /da lta 'dre dang gnyan sa nas/ /langs par gyur pa gachod pa yin/ /ma de lcags sam dwa chodag btsas/ /phung sngo ra lha na 'jug rgas kha snyi//༈/me pho sprel dang me mo bya/ /da lta yul bdag gnyan po gnod/ma de chu 'am kham thog skyes/ /lce dig smra ba mi bde 'o//༈/sa pho khyi dang sa snu phag /da lta klu btsan klu bsen gcadad/ /ma de shing ngam zin thog skyes/ /ma de gzi brjid chung bar 'ong //༈/lcags āo byi ba lcags mo glang / /da lta dur 'dre sa bdag gasdud//li lnga ga btsas na ho/ sgang ngan//༈/chu pho stag dang chu mo yos/ /da lta khang gzhis tho skor gyi/ /sa sngo mtshan ma can gnas la/ /chags 'dre gathegad pa yin zhes bya/ /ma

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 74de me 'as li thog skyes/ /so ngan chor so skye ba yin/ /༈/shing pho 'brug dang shing mo sbrul/ /da lta thab 'dre 'og tu gasnyad//zin nam ma shing la btsas na/ /11 mchin nad 〉(nga gre bug ngan/ /༈/me pho rta dang me mo lug /da lta rdzing ngam yul 'dre gnod/ /ma de sa 'am khon thog skyes/ /༈/sa pho sprel dang sa mo bya/ /da lta zhe'u gsing 'go gsum mam//bzhi yi chags 'dre gatshe/da pa yin/ /ma de shing ngam zin chodag skyes/ /rtag par gzugs po rengs par 'ong / /༈/lcags āo khyi dang lcags mo phag /da lta sgab 'dre 'am sa bdag gcadad/ /ma de me 'am li la btsas/ /de yi sku ser ngan pa yin//༈/chu pho byi ba chu mo glang / /da lta lha khang rnying pa dang / /chu mig 'bo/ gsum klu gnyan gcadad/ /ma de lcags sam dwa la btsas/ /sgal cirgags nad can 'byung ba yin//༈/shing pho stag dang shing mo yos/ /da lta 'don du sa srin gnod//ma de sa 'am kho na la btsas/ /mekhal sked nad can sku nga ba yin//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 75༈/me pho 'brug dang me mo sprul/ /da lta klu dang sa bdag gnod//ma de shing ngam zin la btsas/ /lho nad can du 'byung bar 'gyar//༈/sa pho rta dang sa mo lug /da lta rang gi khyim 'dre gasnyad//thab sna ra gachodab kyis nyen langs nas/ /klad nad mjing pa rengs pa 'byung / /ske dang klad par mda' brgyab 'ong /༈/lcags pho sprel dang lcags mo bya/ /da lta klu 'don gasnyad pa yin//ma de lcags sam dwa la skyes/ /de yi kha la spu smad skyes//༈/chu āo khyi dang chu mo phag /dur dang chang sa'i 'don 'dre gnod//ma de gshed bci sa khams sam/ /spar kha zur bzhi la skyes na/ /dmu chu skran cordong mthun gsum dang / /bdun zur la ni skyes pa ngan/ /༈/rang nyid lo yi dbang thang gi /so so'i tshang 'grel bshad pa ni/ /shing gi stag sku sa pha khu yi/ /kha yan yin pas de ring la/ /g.yu 'brug khyod bzhin ma chodas med/ /nyi zla bzhin du ma mchodang med/ /pha mes yul las mi gcig gam/ /dur sa tha dad byas pa sku/da/ /de yis lhaman gyis grir shi 'am/ /dme sna ra cardong nyen sku da pa yin/ /pha khu drag sngo 'byung

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 76'gyur yang / /de dang 'bo gas yun thung ba yin/ /༈/me yi rta sprul bza' tshang gi /kha yan yin te sku/ dang ce// /gang yang rung ste drag por skyes/ /bzang por 'khrungs te bye bral byed/ /mi nor dar gud gang stongs che/ /skyid sdug re mos yong ba yin/ /bu tsha 'phral la 'jug pa dang / /bud med gnyis la gzan pa yin/ /bu tsha gasku ba dka' ba'i sa//༈/chu yi byi phag bu tsha yi/ /kha yan yin te bu tsha la/ /lhag chad mang 'byung gasku/sa pa min/ /phan jo gas thams cad gasku/sa gyur na//dbang po skyon can 'byung dogs yod/ /mi tshe gcig la skyid sdug gsum//pha ma ya bral 'byung snga gas sku da/ /ma phyi mdzangs ma yod gyur kyang / /de dang 'thodags yun thung bar bshad/ /༈/lcags kyi bya sprel gnyen rnams dang / /zhang wa'i kha yan zhes bya ste/ /zhang po bzang po yod pa yin/ /gnyen dang zhang po las 'phros pa'i/ /go khrab mtshon la bsnyad btags nas/ /kha smrasacoding te tshe stod las/ /tshe smad skyid pas dar gud che/ /skyid po bye zhig bye zlos byed//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 77༈/sa yi glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ /ma dang phyi mo'i kha yan te//ma phyi'i ring la longs spyod che/ /tshe ring rang dang 'grogs yun ring //rang nyid smos su rung ba ste/ /ma phyi'i 'dur sa bzhag nyes na/ /gnod par 'gyur ba'i legs par brtag /pha mes g.yang can byung ba ste//yul sa bzung nyes byung nyen yod/ /so nam nor spel rem pa yin/ /yul la 'alhun phyugs mang ba 'byung / /༈/chu yi stag sku sa bu tsha yi/ /kho nga chodang yin te bu tsha la/ /nas dang mi gtsang bsnyad thogs pa'i / /dbang po skyon can 'byung dogs yod/ /rabs chad zhing ngam 'phung khyim 'dzin/ /de 'dra'i nor gyis phan thogs 'ong /༈/shing gi rta sprul pha bu yi/ /kho nga chodang yin pas pha khu ni/ /byes su zhi dang rabs chad 'ong / /yang na grir 'chi dogs/ pa ste/ /bud med yin na khyad par du/ /nor phyed ban bon la 'dur te/ /bsris phyed 'dre yis khyer zhes bya/ /skyes pa mang yang 'dur ba nyung / /khang pa'i rmang na thamyo/ ༷/34 34nga / /
