tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 78༈/sa yi bya sprel ma phyi yi/ /kho nga cadang yin te ma phyi ni/ /las su bye bral byas pa'am/ /nal dang mi gtsang nal bu la/ /snyad btags dbang po skyon can 'ong / /༈/lcags kyi byi phag zhang po yi/ /khong nong yin te zhang po yi/ /sa na dar gud shin tu che / /yang na zhang sngo/ pha dang ma/ /mi gcig spun zlar gyur pa sku da/ /༈/me yi glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ /bdag dang za tshang kho nga nang yin/ /bu tsha rigs 'ga' gasnu ba dang / /yang na mi gcig reng re nga ho// /mi thenar gnyis la mna' za bas/ /phyugs dang 'kho ra la gzan pa yin/ /yo byad gang stongs byed pa'o/ /༈/me yi stag sku sa bzang tshang gi/ /se zhig yin te pha mes ring / /phan dar ldan yang rang gi ring / /gang stongs che zhing 'khor la gzan/ /lug khur spyang ki zhugs pa 'dra/ /khyim zla tshe thung lhu na la 'jug /rang nyid gcig pur bsdad nas kyang / /mgo la skra dkar 'char ba yin/ /kha gang zas za lag gang gi /cadar la rjodad cing mya ngan

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 79dang / /sdug bsngal mang du 'byung ba ste/ /mi stong rta stong 'bab nyen yod/ /༈/sa yi rta sprul ma phyi yi/ /se zhig yin te ma phyi'i sar/ /khyim la bye bral byas pa 'am/ /gri dang gathodang gis shi ba sku da/ /bu che'i dbang thang chung bas na/ /malnga/nga ba mang yang 'dur ba nyung / /na tsha bag tsam mang ba ci)na/ /༈/chu yi bya sprel sdudar rdzas kyi/ /se zhig yin te pha mes rnams//phyug kyang rang nyid ltogs pa yin/ /nor gyi gang stongs 'byung ba'i sar//rang byas sngor lha/ gzhan la 'acesar/ /byas pa'i las la mgu ba nyung / /nal bu blangs bu yong dogs yod/ /༈/shing gi byi phag khu yi/ /se zhig yin pas pha khu'i ring / /gang stongs dar gud rab tu che/ /pha spun ma spun khu tho'i sar rabs chad grir shi 'am sa bdag gcadad/ /pha mes drin bas nga dren che/ /yul gyi mi bas byes mis byams/ /rang sgo drag ste gnya' gathodag mang / /༈/lcags kyi glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ /zhang gro'i se zhig sa yin

che ༷pog 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 80pas / /zhang po dar gud gang stongs che/ /yul sa 'pho skyas byed pa dang / /khyim sa bye bral 'ong ba dang / /mi stong rta stong 'bab pa dang / /gnyen las 'a14sa pa'i kha mchu lhanang / /grir shi dang ni rabs chad dam/ /sa bdag gachodad pa 'byung snga gas sku da//༈/lcags kyi stag yos zhang po dang / /gnyen gyi mdun khur lo zhes bya/ /zhang ngo'i sa na dar gud che/ /gnyen bral dar gud che ba cadang / /rang gi sa na be yags sam/ /byes su khyams dang shi ba sku/nga //rgyal sngo sa bdag gnod pa yis/ /nor rdzas phyug na tshe thung zhing / /tshe ring gyur na dbul ba yin/ /༈/chu yi rta sprul cadar rdzas kyi/ /mdun khur yin pas cadar rdzas la/ /gang stongs dar gud rab tu che/ /nye bar dgra sems dme gre 'khor//bza' tshang mna' za skyid sdug dang / /mya ngan dga' ba re mos byed/ /༈/me yi bya sprel bza' tshang gi /mdun khur yin pas bza' tshang la/ /bye bral shi chad 'ong ba'o/ /yang na pha ma ya bral 'ong / /bu tsha shin tu gso dka' ste/ /rang gi srog la rgyun du za/ /slo bur ye 'brog

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 81'byung dogs yod/ /༈/sa yi byi phag ma phyi yi/ /mdun khur yin te ma dang phyi/ /tshe thung gri 'thabs shi ba 'am/ /gnyan nad kyis shi phan chodags nyung / /de yi phyogs nas 'dre gachodad pas/ /mi kha za ste nor rdzas chags/ /nad med de dag ma byung na/ /tshe tshad thung ba'i nyen du 'gyur/ /༈/shing gi glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ /pha khu'i mdun khur lo yin pas/ /pha khu gnyis dang 'bo gas yun thung / /phan dang gathodang ba chung ba yin/ /mya ngan mang du 'bab pa dang / /pha spun yul sa sku/ sor 'dzin/ /pha khu'i drin gyi kha smras la/ /snyad thug nye ba dgra ru ldang / /lag na 'jor zhags thogs pa yis/ /pha khu brlag pa'i so nam mkhan/ /bus pa gasku/ bar dka' ba yin/ /༈/sa yi stag sku/sa ma phyi yi/ /kha ral yin gyi de dag gi /sa nas phan chodags chung ba dang / /'bo/gas yun thung ba 'byung ba yin/ /pha khu bzang por skye ba dang / /zhang po dar gud che bas te/ /rang gi ring la dgra dug 'aho/ga /yang na 'dre dang 'gras pa yis/ /bsam pa mi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 82 byed ma bsam byed/ /byas pa mi 'grub ma byas 'grub/ /phan pa nyang ste gnod pa mang /༈/lcags kyi rta spru zhang po dang / /gnyen gyi kha ral lo yin te//zhang wa'i gnyen dang 'grogs yun thung / /yang na 'khon nyen yod pa ste//pha khu'i sa na dungs sems che/ /rang la sa bdag rgyal sngo gcadad/ /ma sru gnyis dang 'thodags yun thung / /༈/shing gi bya sprel pha khu yi/ /kha ral yin te pha khu dang / /'bo gas yun thung ngam 'khon nyen yod/ /khu bo dang ni mes khu'i ring / /dme 'am rabs chad grir shi dang / /sa bdag gnod pa byung dogs yod/ /yang na yams nad gathe nga gi 'chi/ /༈/me yi byi phag rang nyid kyi/ /kha ral yin te pho dar nas//nal byas mo daregal phyug 'byung / /mi rgyud dbang ngo khyodan can dang / /nal bas zin pa codang ba yin/ /chodar rdzas phyug kyang phan lnga ga sa dka'/ /༈/chu yi glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi/ /cadar bo gas gnyis kyi khar

tshe rtsis 'brasabublogasala'aga'askyed/—83la yin/ /chodar la gang rdo nga dar gud che/ /gnyen las 'a'o/sa pa'i kha mchu 'am/ /nyes pa med pa'i kha sku/gas kyang / /bsags pa cadar du mi btub cing / /chodang dang so nam byas pa yang / /je chung je chung song ba'i rbab/ /nor rdzas la kha'i bya sgro 'dra/ /dbang thangatshang gi rim pa'o//de nas klung rta'i tshang 'bras bshad/:byi 'brug sprel gsum sku pa zhi/ /rang gi pha khu mes dang gsum/ /dpung btsan drag gro'i btsan dang 'dra/ /phyi nangaganyis su bsku da nams ldan//bdag la khong gi skyabs drin yod/ /mdzangs dang blo gros ldan pa yod//de yi skyabs kyis rang la'ang / /mi kha 'byung yang mi gcadad snga / /gnyen dang zhang sngo la sku gas pa'i/ /'brel ba'i sa nas mi kha za/ /cadan kyang bus pa byar btub pas/ /mi yi rtsonag tu mi 'bo/ tsam/ /༈/stag rta khyi gsum lo pa ni/ /nga nor lcags kyi ri bo la/ /kun pa'i gapo nga gis mi thub ste/ /lha srung bzang ngo'i mthodan skyabs kyis/ /rbab tu lhungs yang lag pas 'dren/ /'phya kha gling rung mi gling rung / /dpag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 84bsam shing gi sdong po la/ /'bras bu lo tog rgyas pa yis/ /gnyen gyi sa na bsku/danams ldan/ /pha khu mes gsum zhan gyur kyang / / rang dbang mi la ma lha ra tsam/ /༈/bya glang sprul gyi 'o/ pa ni/ /rgyal wa rgyal sar byung ba bzhin//'khor dang gnyen kha thams cad kyis/ /lkog kha bsrung zhing bstod pas na/ /gzhan gyi mchod snga gas rngan btang yang / /lha dang srung ma'i mthodan cu bas kyis/ /chu la ri snu bris pa 'dra/ /bus pa'i bsku da nams chung gyur kyang / /nor dang g.yang du ldan pa yis / / nye ba'i gnyen gyi kha zin gyis/ /rang la bstodad pa kha rje yin/ /༈/phag lug yodas kyi 'o/ pa ni/ /ma phyis bsags pa'i chodar rdzas kyis/ /'phral gyi longs spyod byar btub tsam/ /'on kyang bkren 'dre 'thodang po yin/ /bsags pa mthug tu ma sku/nga bas/ /g.yang 'o/na byas kyang phan gachodad med/ /bkres blo ma na la smyug skyes bzhin/ /bu tsha rgyas par gyur pas na / / lkog 'phyas snyan rung mi snyan rung / /rang la ltos pa med ces zer/ /klung rta'i tshang gi rim pa'o/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 85gcadad 'dral kha dmar/gzhan yang gathodad 'dral kha dmar bstan/ /lus sku ga gakhyodad pa'i skyodan rnams ni/ ༈/sku ga gi 'byung bas lus gathe da na/ /pha ma'i drin lan chung ba cardong / /chung dus mi sbru/ 'grims pa yis/ /zhang nye'i drin gyis 'cho ba yin/ /yang na bu sring drin lan 'asnur/ /byin bu skyes nas lus gro theg /lag ngar skyes nas kha yang 'khru/ /kha rje chung zhing sdug bsngal mang / /sems kyis bya byed mang byed kyang / /'grub pa nyung zhing sgyed pu la/ /bye zhig bus nga 'i lhag chad mang / / pha khu sngon shi nye rtsa lag /drin can shi codang de min na/ /snga glang zla spo gas rgan dang phrad//gyos sgyug kha rje chung bar 'ong / /khyim zlos thon bu bu mor 'ong / /kha smras gcig ni rtag tu ldang / /༈/srog gi lus la phar bskyed na/ /de las ldog ste bzang bar bshad//༈/lha/ga gis dbang thang la bcad na/ /pha mes yul zhing mi la 'chor/ /rang gi nor la shor god 'byung / /mi yi nor gyi shor god

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 86la/ /che bzhi dpang du 'dzugs pa bzhin/ /mdzub ris sa la 'dri ba dang / /zhal lce kha gasku gas cadang ba yin /khyim gyi 'aho 'phyugs mang yod cing / /rang nor g.yang can khri khar 'chor/ /nga yi nor la gang lha ngas che/ /rang gi thodas la rang mi mkhas/ /sbur ba bar du tshud pa 'dra/ /༈/srog gis bskyed pa de las ldog /pha mes nor rdzas g.yang can 'ong / /༈/sku ga gi klung rta la bcad na/ /rang gi 'bad nas byas gyur kyang / /gzhan pa ba ni mgu ba dka'/ /zhang nye'i sa ru dar gud che/ /byas te mi yang ma mgu ste/ /ga sa pas rang yang ma 'grangs pas/ /mi tshe gcig la skyid sdug gnyis/ /mchod dman shwa ba khris ded 'dra/ /byis pa phyed bsos bu mo mang / /tshur bskyed gso ba go ldog 'ong /༈/lus kyis srog la gcad pa na/ /dang po spun bzhi'i mi rgyud la/ /da lta gsum gyis mab 'dzin/ /chung dus gso dka' dwa'u byed//bu tsha phyed sku sa phyed shi ste/ /shid kyi tho ke ma zhes bya/ /dur na nad ngan

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 87shi rus dang / /mi gtsang snga chung gshin sngo ga rnams/ /mi dga' dur gral 'khrugs pas na/ /rabs chad dkyil du tshud pa dang / /de yi skyon gyis mabo rgan gum/ /rta phyugs kyis bsad dbang sngo ra khyodan/ /cadangs la yul kha gsum du chad/ /bu gasku sa dgra ru coding ba dang / /rta gri chu grir shi ba dang / /stong med gri sbos glang thabs su/ /shi ba 'ong la slo bur du/ /ye 'brog mang zhing na tsha mod / / skyob na go ldog bzang ngan 'gyur/༈/lus kyis dbang thang la gcod na/ /gzhon dus sgyed spar thogs pa dang / /pha mtshan nye ba dgra ru ldang / /byes su mi 'a'o/da bo da rgyun ldang / /nor la gang stongs khyim sa brje/ /bu tsha lhag chad mang ba dang / / pha tshan zhe 'khe/na ces ba sku/da/༈/lus kyis klung rta la gcod na/ /zhang nye dgrar ni ldang ba dang / /ma bu'i 'phung 'dre gnod pa dang / /lha 'dre gnod pas byis pa yi/ /skab mi 'phel zhing byas pa'i mir/ /drin 〉rgar med pa 'byung ba dang / / gasku/sa pa'i mi la shed nyams med/ /nyi ma gcig la bde sdug

tshe rtsis 'bras bu rā/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 88gnyis/ /byas pas mi mgu hwa sa mi 'grangs/ /de cadag yul gyi 'dun sa 'dzin/ /༈/dbang thang lus gcod mgo rus 'thor/ /nye ba dgrar 'ong nodas dug 'gyur/ /mi ngan pha rabs g.yul sngo dang / /'dre ngan the brang 'gong po gnod/ /bud med sdang zhing na tsha mod / ༈/dbang thang srog gcod zla grogs 'ong / /bdag rigs ngan gnyen mi 'ongs bsdebs// zhing sa srin yod bu tsha lkugs/ /long ba gnyen sku/da dbang lha/na can/ /khyim swā/sa bye bral 'byung ba yin/ /nad ni gzer nad khrag nad dam/ /rgas khar nad ldang bathe sa yun ring // na sku sgang la babs dus su/ /bred dang dngangs yid mi bde zhing / /lan grangs gnyis gsum 'byung ba yin//༈/dbang thang klung rta la gathe da na/ /pha mes las chodab yid tshang 'chodar/ /bu sring khyod mtha' pha ming ngan/ /rā ra la kha smras rtag tu 'ong / / chos la 'bros shing 'khyar ba 'byung / /tshur bskyed go ldog phun sum tshogs/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 89༈/dbang sogs gnyis kyis lus gathod na/ /lus kyi kha rje mi 'ong ste/ /ro yi glang bu byed pa yin/ /bu tsha gasku dka' tha bran byed/ /༈/srog lus gnyis kyis dbang gcod na/ /pha mes lnga brgya'i nor 11gas kyang / /bu tsha dbul ho/ngas dar bas srab/ /zas canar nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /bsngo ru yod la grangs su med/ /tha ma mi yi bran du 'gro/ /༈/dbang srog gnyis kyis klung gcod na/ /bu mang sgyed po so sor 'dzin/ /nad mo da mya ngan sman du byed/ /༈/klung rtas lus bcad nor god che/ /bu che'i ring stong ba yin//༈/rab klung kyis ni klung rtar brgyab/ /byis pa zla rdib 'bo ba cad//༈/sku ga lus dbang thang klung rta bzhi/ /tshur gasku bde skyid ldan par ba41da/ /༈/yang ni 'di ltar shes par bya/ /sku ga lus klung rtas dbang thang gcod/ /'khor lo 'od stong skar ma zhes/ /gnag brgya lug stong yod mod kyang / /tha ma sprang por 'gro ba yin//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 90༈/lus dbang klung rtas srog la gcod/ /phe'u sha ral skar me zhes//mi tshe khyodam sgrub byas mo da kyang / /tha ma gri ru 'chi ba yin/ /༈/srog lus dbang gis klung rta gcod/ /bya dmar me len skar ma zhes/ /bu dang tsha thod mang sku da kyang / /tha ma mi rabs chad nyen yod//༈/lus dbang klung rtas sku ga la skyodab/ /gshin chu rab brgal skar ma zhes/ /drug cu 'o/na pa'i bud med kyang / /tha mar mi rabs mi chad do/ /༈/gzhan yang lo khyims zla zhag dus/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i bajibs tshang ni/ ༈/stag sprel phag sprul ra ba'i lo/ /steng 'og spun dang pha ma la/ /mna' za dwa thodar lus nyen yodad/ /'phar ba gzhug rdum bse ru gcig /cis kyang 'jig pa med pa ste / / bye bral byas sam byes dang phrad/ /pha mes ban ༷/na dang 'gras sam/ /yang na lha srung 'gyangs pa sku1da/ /pha khyim bu yis mi 'acirdon nam/ /yang na zhig ral byas pa sku da/ / ༈/byi rta bya yos 'bring wa'i lo/ /pha drin ma drin chung ba ste/ /rang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 91drin rang la che ba yis/ /mi pho dgo za dgo pho spang / /spang po'i logs la 'dzad dus med/ /tshe sdod gang stongs phugs su bzang / /tshan khungs bu tsha khyodan can nam/ /yang na rigs gnyis gasku ba dang / /gnyen dang 'gras sam kha sku gas 'a'o/ga /dug mtsho na byes su 'khyams pa codang /༈/glang lug khyi 'brug tha chung lo/ /yul mkhar 'pho bskyas byas pa dang / /yang na bshig ral byas pa yis/ /zhing dang khyim phyir kha smras 'ong / /rus mi gcig dang khyim mtshes byed/ /mes khu mo phyir 'brangs ba 'am/ /gnyen gyi phyi la 'brangs pa coding / /pha khyim bu yis mi 'acirdon te/ /tshan khung sa 'am gnyen nang na / / bsam ngan bosags su mi btub 'byung / /las dang bsku/da nams rems pa yin/ /zhag las dus tshod phyung pa ni/ /dus tshod le'u'i nang las gsal/ /༈/ /nus chenalnga ni/khams dang 'o/ gnyis sbyar ba yi/ /mtha' rtsis bzang ngan bshad pa ni//spyi yi rus chen de nang du/ ༈/chad chen 'o/ pa gcig byung na/ /mi chen

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 92bzang drag byung ba ste/ /mi ngas byas shing rta ngas brgyugs/ /kha gang za zhing rgyab gang gi /botos bo/na mig gang gzugs la blta/ /lag gang cadar la spyod pa ste/ /dral ma brgya yi mthorwa ga de/ /phyug ma gcig gis bcings dang mtshungs/ /mi lnga'i dpon dang ra lnga'i rdzi/ /mi 'gro ngan yang lte 'phro bzang / /rdza ma ngan yang lung thag bzang / /cho rigs yon tan can gyi rgyud/ /bo/nga gi dbus su bzhag nas kyang / /g.yang 'chang tshe phur dag la gdags/ /rab tu mi byung khyim pa bya/ /'o/ 'di med na khyod nyid la/ /khyo brgya yod kyang gros gzhan 'dri/ /med du mi rung lo yin chod//༈/chad chung 'o/ pa gcig byung na/ /pha tshan mang la rabs chad mang / /mi tshan gnyis sam dur kha gnyis/ /cho rigs bzang ste dar gud che/ /sku byad rtsa kha'i zil pa 'dra/ /kha snyan sngo yang ma yin te/ /bkra shis ngo yang dka' ba yin/ /rang nyid dbul na pha mes phyug /rang nyid phyug na pha mes dbul/ /dgra la gnyen du bzung bas 'phung / /lo 'di phyugs kyi bang mdzod dang / /mdzangs kyi yid tshang gras 'phong ra /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 93ngag nas rnyed pa'i sa yin cing / /gtam nyid bal skur nang nas 'byung / /khyod kyi ma phyi rgan rim gyi/ /dur sa bzang po zin pa yod//de yi sku na tan pha srid ni/ /zin pas mna' ma bo sa 'phel cadang /'di med dam nyams phugs su zhugs/ /'phung sri nang lī ngas mi chodar dang / /zas gsum rjodangs shing rgan mo yis/ /gra ma thub par 'gyur zhes bshad/ /༈/bskyed pa'i ma lo byung na/ /ma sru bzang po'i bu tsha ste/ /bus pa'i dbang thang che ba yin/ /gnyen las 'a11sa pa'i kha mchu yis/ /rang gi yul dang 'bral du nye/ /pha tshan nang du zhe 'khon 'ong / /mthon po dma' bar byas pa yis/ /gtsang gtsang 'dra yang dme ba ste/ /bzang rdzu byas nas ngan gshoms 'ong / / gang gang 'dra la stong pa ste/ /phyi gzhis che la nang nor chung / /bsags pa'i yo byad gang stongs che/ /dur sa rgas pas len pa yin/ /pha sde la bsten bu sde chags/ /bla sdel bsten mgo sde chags/ /nya chur shi yang kha rlangs de/ /gnam thon rang nor mi la 'chodar/ /mi yi cadar la bya ra byed/ /re ba'i sa nas gtam snyan

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 94coding / /mi rgyud sa na mar la ni / / gzhu mthob rgag pas mnan pa mang / /dgra mgo gyen du mi 'chor ro/ /'di med nga byas che na 'ang //tha ma mi la dbang 'chor ro/ /༈/rang lo dbang lo byung ba na/ /dbang gi dngos grub babs pa ste/ /lho bo sa mi la mi 'dri ste/ /pha tshan nang nas g.yang zas za med du mi rung ba yi sku// /ha cang smra mkhas drags na 'phung / /sems rgya che zhing lta ba mchod/ /dgra cadags rang gsum lhan gcig na/ /bzhag pa za byed mna' mar ngan/ /'bol po gnya' chag sgo khyir ngan/ /bye ma dkar spro zhing sar ngan/ /sngags pa stod nag dgra zlar ngan/ /sngags rgyud yin nam yang na ni/ /phur kha gcand pa sku/da pa'i sa/ /pha mes dur gyi rgyal sa zin/ /ri rab sngas byas rgya mchodar 'thung / /mchod la dar chags gangs stong 'dra/ /lo yi sgo mo rgyab rtan yin/ /'di med khyod kyi pha tshan sar/ /dmag brgya sku/da kyang dasngo/na gzhan byed/ /rgyal kha gzhan la 'acesar ba yin/ /༈ /bu lo pa gcig byung ba na/ /pha sde la brten bu sde chag /rgas

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 95khar zas chodar dbang thang che/ /khyim gyi phugs nas rlung byung bar/ /phyi sgo bcad pas phan mi 'gyur/ /skyer tsher dar gyis btums pa'am/ /phub ma'i codag tu chu ༷dren bzhin/ /pha tshan nang nas ngan gasna mas sku da// ho/ lha gcig pas mi phan te/ /rang nyid btsan sa bzung na legs/ /pha'i bu mes kyi tsha bo yin/ /bo nga gi dbus su bsdad pa bzang / /pha tshan spyi yis khyod la skyob/ /sgro ba ngan kyang lung thag bzang / /ma mo ngan kyang bu bzang ste/ /rgyal ni dmangs su mi 'bab la/ /rus kyi mal sa mi gtong zhing / / rde'u chag pa mi gtong ngo / /pha bas bu drag spang la ni// me mched bu bas tsha drag pa/ /gser la g.yu yis spras pa 'dra/ /stag las ris bkra 'di med na/ /da lta bzang yang tha ma ngan/ /༈/bo/gas 'o/ pa gcig byung ba na/ /khams kyis brgyab pa'i loyin te/ /pha ma'i nor gyis phan mi thogs/ /lag ngar skyes dang byin bu skyes//rang rgyud mtshan ma ngan pa dang / / zhe 'asngo da sred pa che ba yis/ /rtag tu zas nor dgra ru ldang / /'od can nor phyir 'dre 'brangs pas/ /dar gud 'asgyu skyas shin tu mang / /'khyams dang blangs pa'i bu tsha la/ /phyi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 96mi byams la nang mi sdang / /lo 'di nor gyi lo yin la / / g.yang gi lo dang zhag gi lo/ /da lta skud snum mir 'tshol kyang / /tha ma lug lpags gang gi bdag /spyi dur bzang yang sgos dur ngan/ /grod pa rgyab kyi 'dzer pa 'dra/ /pha tshan nang du yeng po byed/ /legs pa bdag gis byas gyur kyang / / ngo sku gzhan gyis byed pa 'byung / /dpa' bo bdag gis byas na yang / /kha snum gzhan gyis byed pa 'byung / /byas la mi khyodam byugs mi sher/ /zas nor g.yang nyams logs khang bzung / /dur du tshud kyang logs su thab/ /rta brgya lug stong bdag po byed/ /zla grogs srog la skyob pa 'tshol/ /lo 'di med na byis mi srin/ /bud med dpal kha byed pa 'byung / /da lta lug lpags gang 'gyed kyang / /tha ma skra skud mi la 'cho la/ /༈/dgra so/ pa gcig byung ba na/ /dgra rnams bsad kyis me langs pa/ /gram pa nang gi jo chung 'dra/ /pha brgya bsad kyang bu brgya ldang / /lan pa med kyang mi rnams sdang / /byas pa med kyang zhe brnag mang / /'gyod pa med kyang mi yis 'phya/ /'dun pa bag tsam bskyungs na legs/ /mi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 97ni nged rang nyid kyang ni/ /smras pas mi nyan mjing pa 'astu/ga /pha tshan nang na gcu log byed/ /pha tshan nang du dme lkugs 'ong / / ga re byas pas mi stu da kyis / /phu nas khus 'debs mdar sa barsha / /mi rgyud nang na dme gri 'ong / /rtag tu dgra dang kha mchu mod/ /mi stong rta stong 'jal ba dang / /smra ba mi nyan mjing pa 'aXrmeg /pha ri'i lngaras la btang na ni/ /tshur ri'i ngos la 'gro yi ze ra/ /rde'u dkar na rang srog chad//rdel nag gnyen dang zla la gnag /yul gyi mtha' bzung grong sgang sdod//pha tshan gseb na mi sdod do/ /lo 'di med na yul srid dang / /byes na dgra med rkun ma ni/ /sa la brku zhing gam 'phra brdeg /med du 'ang ni mi rung lo/ /

tshe 'us/ 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 98ra༅/ /nang nus spar chen sde brgyad las/ /lha'i steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /dkyil che phra ma dag la dga'/ /pha dang khyodas tho'i gdan sa 'a'o/ga /ma nyes kha gasku gos rtag tu codang / /mgo dang dbang po skyon can 'ong / /āo yin dmar ngo khrog ngo yod / / gri dang thab gachodab sa yin te/ /khyed kyi pha dang mes ring nas/ /gri kha chen po bye gyur te/ /de yang mgo gri mang ba yin/ /mo yin zla rdib byis 'jur lhanang / /thab gaho/ba 'kho na gyis rkyen byas nas/ /lha klu 'phangs pas gnyan nad dang / / bu tsha lha na chen codang nyen sku/da/ /pha mes shin tu dar ba'i tshe/ /bzhi dang lngar ni gyes pa ste/ /yul lam dur sa rtsub mo ni/ /lto dang nub tu kha bltas yod/ /lca ni rgyal po btsan bdud 'go/de bzhin gnod byed 'gong pos byed/ /sa bdag gnod na bzlog par dka' /lhakhon steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /dur 'dre dur skyon sa zhes bya// pha mes dur gdab nyes pa ni/ /de yi lha na gyi mi rgyud la/ /glen lkugs klu dang 'gras pa dang / /zha 'theng 'thibs grir shi ba lhanang pha mes nyis brgyud gang lha ngas che/ /sdud brtan gzhan gyis bathe sa par dka'//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 99dasnu da snu rkyen zhing sdug bzhin nag / rtag tu zhe 'kho na na tsha snu/da/ /bu tsha gso dka' bye yugs byed/ /kha 'jam gyog che khro zhing gtum/ /ro bag mi gtsang ba la gzab/ /tshe stod nor che tshe smad dbul/ /yul dang dur ni ser skya ba/ /mdun na lam grog gis chod yod/ /lha ru nag smug klu sman 'go /gdon du sa bdag klu mo gnod/ ༈/dwa steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /dme gri dwa yi sa zhes bya/ /pha mes dme gri 'a〈per ba yis/ /ngan thabs byas nas bsad pa sku/da/ /dwa'u go spru/sos byas pa dang / /dme can dang du blangs pa'o/ /g.yu khrab phyi nas lha/nga ba yi/ /'dre gcadad byes su mi shi sku/da/ /pha mes gsum mam bzhi brgyud yin/ /yul dur ser ram nag pa ni/ /nub bam byang du blta ba yod/ /nor rdzas cung zhig srab pa ste/ /sems dkar spro thrung khong khro 'phel/ /g.yo spogs chung la drag rtsal che/ /snying stobs che zhing yon tan 'asgyu da/ /'o/ snu 'dra bar khyim sa 'dren/stu /zhang nye'i cadags su mna' za la/ /sa dang lha ra ni gang khyodangs che/ /tha ma grir 'chi gzer nad snungad/ /btsan 'bo/ gre tho/ gathegad pa yin/

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 100༈/khen steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /zha 'theng gang stongs sa zhes bya/ /pha mes zha 'theng sgur wa dang / /glen lkugs can dang dal rgyab yod/ /dgra sna cung zad 'byung ba dang / /yul la 'pho 'phyugs 'ong ba dang / /skyid sdug gang lha ngas che ba yin/ /pha mes gnyis sam bzhi brgyud de/ /mi yi gang stongs chung ba 'ong / /yul dur dmar ser nub byang blta/ /nga rgyal che la lta baphang mchod/ /'bad nas byas kyang mgu ba nyung / /thabs mkhas skyid sdug rkyen la brtag /pha dang khu thod dag la gzan/ /'gong po 'go zhing rgyal po gnod /༈/kham steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /btsog mnol skyas nag sa zhes bya/ /pha mes mi lag phar lhanar ram/ /yang na tshur blangs nal byas sam/ /bu sring ma sru rabs chad kyi/ /rdzas nag skyas kyi snyad byas nas//pha ming dma' la bu sring ma༄// /mna' ma bye bral byas 'dus mang / /pha mes lnga 'am bzhi brgyud de/ /pho mo brgyud dar yul dur ni/ /dkar nag byang ngam shar bltas sku da/ /sdug bsngal snu da la byin la byed/ /zhe nag sna rno mthun par dka'/ /nang du nyog che phyi ru 'jam/ /mtho sems

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 101che la rang tshags dam/ /bu tsha nal bu'i ngo yang yod / / lha ru klu btsan dkar mo dang / /ma mo 'go zhing bsen mo gnod/༈/shin steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /sa bdag thab gachodab sa zhes bya/ /pha mes mdze nad gnyan nad kyis/ /shi 'am gzhan gyis bathergag byas shing / /thab galhunab rkyen gyis grir shi mang / /yang na ban ྅pen sku/na tan can/ /tso/nga ste gnyis sam gsum brgyad yin/ /yul dur byang ngam shar bltas sku da / / chod brtan gzhan gyi bathodas par dka'/ /sha lci kha nyung tshig brtan la/ /pha gcig bu gcig rmang sngo ra snyadang phra la zhib cing che la rtsing / /lha ru dgra lha drag po dang / /gshin rje 'go ste sa bdag dang / /sa thel gcadad pa yin zhes bya/༈/zin steng 'di ru gang skyes pa/ /rabs chad rmang 'dre'i sa zhes bya/ /pha mes rabs chad skyon chen dang / /dme dang dwa 'u go gsos dang / /shing gnyan bcad pas 'gag gri 'am/ /shing gri mang ste chig brgyud dam/ /yang na gsum brgyud canang ba yin / / mi dmangs drag po 'byung ba'i sa/ /yul dur ljang sngon shar ltor blta/ /mdog sngo khram

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 102 gasku che ba la/ /thabs mkhas zal che yid snang slu/ /bu dang cadar gyi dbang thang che/ /kha rgod lag 'thor nang du gyong / /lha ru klu bdud yul bdag 'go /gdon du rmang 'dre gnod pa'o/ /༈/zon steng 'di ru grang skyes pa/ /rbad 'dre klu gnyan sa zhes bya//pha mes lho ba dasngo na dang 'gras sam/ /yang na rbad 'dre galta nga ba sku da//klu dang sa bdag gnod pa yis/ /spyo 'thodag lceb grir shi ba dang / /mi 'khyar yang na byes shi sku/da/ /pha mes gnyis sam bzhi yin kyang / /da lta shin tu rmang ba yin/ /yul dur shar lto'am lto phyogs su/ /phu bltas yod de yul lha dang / /'phya 'dod khro la dga' ba ste/ /mtho gnon mnyam gnyis 'gran sems che/ /sems las thor sku gnyis ka che/ /tha ma lho bur nad kyis 'chi/ /sman 'go rgyal po 'gong po gnod/ /de ni spar kha'i skyes tshang yin/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'argo' skyed/ 103༈ /bar pa spe ba gling dgu las/ /lhagacig dkar 'di ru gang skyis pa/ /lha yis byin pa'i bu yin te/ /mang spro mi 'dug chig brgyud yin/ /rkang pa rlung gi 'khor los bskor/ /'gro ba'i las la brtson pa yin/ /pho ni blo sho rgod pa dang / /mo ni srid rgyags mi rme ste/ /khyim so sgyed po bgrang bar 'ong / /'pho skyas dag la rab tu 'ga'/ /gdon du rgyal 〈 be brang dang / / 'gong gro'i gnod pas shes pa tshig /snying du 'bo nga sngo zhugs kyi snga gas/ /lha ru klu lcam dkar mo 'go/bu tsha skye bar dka' ba'i sa/ /rang gi bu tsha phyir ru gso/ /mi g.yang shor ba'i nyes skyon gyis/ /zha bo 'theng po grum po dang / /mig skyon long ba long ma 'am/ /stod dang sna mig na ba 'byung / /snying mi dga' la sems mi gnas/ ge/chodar la gang rdo ngas che ba dang / / khyim sar bye bral byed pa 'am/ /yang na bu tsha rigs gnyis gasku / /khyodad kyi mi brgyud sa nas phar/ /pha re bu re tsha thod re/ /mi rabs gsum du chig rgyud byed/ /khyod thung sems ni dkar ba yin/ /tshe rjodad dar gud gang stongs che/ /mya ngan sems sdug che ba mo nga / /tshe smad skyid par

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sduste gsal 'ga' skyed/ 104'ong ba yin/ /tshe sngon mi yul rgyal po dang / /de nas lhar skyes 'phos pa yin/ /thel skal skyes rag man la 'am/ /rtsib g.yas dpung g.yas sme ba 'am/ /sme ba'i ga sha ldan pa sku da/ /yang na gamo na lag lus smad la/ /ba bur la sku/gas sha mtshan can/ /tshe tshad bdun bcu sngonan gcig ste/ /tshe la bar gathodad tshe 'phrang bzhi / / khrus dang gtsang dga' lha bzang 'bo /mi gtsang ro/ bag dag gis 'phung / /chung dus dwa phrug babs pa 'am/ /mo nye'i 'kho na 'o/ga lha nad kyis/ /lus la dbang po mi bde 'am/ /pha mes byes shi yang na mabo/ /rus pa ma tshang yul gnyis 'dzin/ /rtag tu dbugs thung tshig pa za/ /nor ni dkar zal can 'phrod la/ /dkar dang skyur la 'jug pa 'ong / /skye ba phyi ma ra lus sam/ /'dab chags ngang ngur gang rigs lus / /gachod sbyin brag chags yul mi 'am//klur ru skye bar 'gyur zhes bshad/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bzhengs na/ /phyi ma 'byor ldan pho lus sam/ /lha 'am bram ze'i rigs su skye//༈/gnyis nag 'di la gang skyes pa/ /dmyal ba tshe sku sa bdud kyi bu/ /zer ba'i tshe sngon bdud du skyes/ /pha ma bral ba snga ba yin/ /pha

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 105dang nu la mna' za ste/ /khyim gso sgyid po bgrang ba 'ong / /sngar dusnyan na 'tsho ba sla/ /pha tshan nang nas mthe wa gas sku da/ /de nas (srin ngo ra skyes ba yin/ /de rtags kha 'jam khong khyodang la/ /zhe nag tshig brjodams che ba yin/ /tshe tshad drug cu re gcig la/ /bar gathegad gsum yod gzhon pa yi/ /chung ngu'i dus na na tsha mod/ /pha ma spun zla grogs po dang /zas cadar g.yang la gcand pa yin/ /mya ngan lan mang mig las ni/ /rtag tu mchi ma 'dzags pa yin/ /rang sems dkar 14 byas kyang kyang rung / /mi rnams khyodan du bzung ba mang / /rtsal shugs skyed nas byas kyang rung / /kun gyis mgu ba shin tu dka'/ /ban tho/na yin na mthu rtsal che/ /dmar la dad cing zhe sdang che/ /mi la legs pa'i drin bzhag kyang / / de yis sku ga par blta bar byed/ /dga' bar byas kyang mgu bar nyung / /ro brgya ldan pa'i sa zos kyang / /skyes bu 'grangs dus med ces bya/ /rtsal shugs phyungs nas byas gyur kyang / /byas pa'i las la zin pa med/ /grogs dang bu rab thon bu la/ /gces par bzung yang 'bo gas skal med/ /mi gcig po ni hreng hreng la/ /mdang gcig

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 106shur shur yin zhes bya/ /gachodad 'dre sa bdag gre lnga gachodad/ /'go ba bdud dang dgra lha 'go /phra mo'i gdon gyis mi tshugs te/ /rgyun du na tsha nyung ba la/ /btab na gasku/ rkyen 'chi rkyen canang / /pha tshan dme gri rabs chad brgyud/ /phyis kyang 'ong bas de la gzab/ /snga 'gror so 'debs phyi 'aho 'phen/ /bathodas su mi btub rang kha che/ /pha ma bye bral byas pa sku da/ /mthod rus yar ram chu mig ni/ /nag wa'i nang tshud dar gud che/ /lcags kyi mkhar la sgro med na/ /rgyal po chen po srigo med gnas/ /thal phung gseb tu bya ho bcug /thams cad kun la ster bar byed/ /cis kyang gang stongs che bar 'ong / /skye ba phyi ma srin bu 'am/ /dom sprel yi dwags gang rung skye/ /phyag rdor sku dang mchod rten dang / /tshad ldan chos byas tshangs ris sam/ /zhes jo na pho lus zhig tu skye/ /rtags su rtsib sku ga lag g.yas gasku na/ /snying ga dpung pa ske mjing dang / /rgyab mdun sme ba'am mtshan rtags sku/da/ /ya bdud ma bdud gnod pa yis/ /gong 'og pha ma spun zlar ngan/ /zas nor g.yang nyams chung dus la/ /gasku/ dka' 'kho ra ngan cher sku nga nas/ /zla 15gas

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 107'bral lam bu brgyud rnams/ /gso dka' nor la bdag sngo nyung / /bu tsha gnyis gsum codang bar bshad/ /༈/gsum mthing 'di la gang skyes pa/ /bsen mo klu srin gnyan gyi bu/ /byol song brag srin tshe 'a'o/sa pa/ /zhas de srin por skyes gcig blangs/ /de nas glang sngo che la skyes/ /tshe 'dir bag chags nyal gnyid dga'/ /se mas lha bas che zhing gang rjodangs che/ /rtags su rkang gasku na gsus pa la/ /sme sku gas mtshan ma sku da pa de/ /skyes ma thag tu gre sngo dang / /bsen mo gnod la chodar g.yang nyams/ /ser sna g.yo sgyu che ba ste/ /ban thodan mi shes shes masnga ga kha/ /skyes pa yin na kha lha ga dam / / bud med mya ngan yugs 'ong nyen/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu gegs gsum yod/ /phyi ma srin wa'i bu mo 'am/ /glang chen gong mo'i lus su skye/ /sbyin pa rgya chen yig brgya pa/ /khri 'bum swārshar sems sku bzhengs na/ /nub phyogs skad rigs mi 'dra ba'i / / phyug gro'i bu mor skye ba yin// rtsib logs dpung pa tshang ra la/ /sme ba bur sha mtshan yod/ /'go ba'i lha gcig yod pa de/ /btsog dang mnol gyis 'phangs te btang / /zas

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 108nor g.yang ni dgra 'dres khyer/ /gang stongs sgyu ma chu sbur 'dra/ /che yis ma brnyas chung gis brnyas/ /sgab kyi mi ngan dgra ru ldang / /kha smras bye zhig yong nyen yod/ /mi gtsang grib dang mnol la 'dzems//mi rung gri ru shi ba'am/ /yang na stong med lus pa dang / /rang ni 'gyur ldog rab tu che/ /rang dran byed cing gzhan bsgyur dka'/ /lta ba mtho zhing mgu ba dka'/ /rtag tu 'dre ldang don mi 'grub/ /gdon du sa srin klu srin dang / /thab gachodab khang zhing sa bdag gcadad/ /'bo lha klu srin 'bo nga po yin/ /phar la drin lan che bzhag kyang / /tshur la mi yis 'phyar kha gtong / /sems stobs che zhing g.yo rdzun chung / /mtho ru mi yis mi gtong zhing / /dma' ru rang gis mi sdod de/ /'drid sla smad kyis stod 'drid 'ong / /tshe snga'i las la re ba che lo ma mang yang 'bras bu nyung / /bag ma mang yang mna' ma nyung / /lnga/na ni gri ngan me long ste/ /mi brgyud skyes pas srid zin nam/ /bus pa grir shi stong med skusad/ /pha tshan nang nas galha/na 'khyams sam/ /'khar ba ༄/gas pa 'byung ba'i sa/ /byin pa skyes nas rang lus khyag /rang rkyang lus sam yul

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 109gnyis 'dzin/ /rang drin rang che nor rdzas rnyed/ /'dre gdon sdang zhing lus nad snu/da/ /tha ma gathodang ngam lho bur 'chi/ /mi chen byams la ma rabs sdang / /dpal wa ra che la rang rgyud thung / /zhe brnag kha dam pha ma yi/ /mna' za khyim sku sgyed ༄/ bgrang / /khyed kyi mi brgyud sa na mar/ /rbab tu sna ra dang g.yang du lhung / / bu grir shi dang bsubs nas shi/ /brdabs te shi dang rjodang med la/ /bsad pa sku nga zhing byis pa la/ /lhag chad 'byung dang khong nad dang / /skrangs lhog shu 'bras rgyun mi chad/ /dmu nad galhu/gas skam gza' nad dang / /dmu chu rnams kyi nad ༷)sa 'acodro/ / ༈/bzhi ljang 'di la gang skyes pa/ /klu mo dkar mos byin pa'i bu/ /tshe sngon klu yin de rjes su/ /sha ba dkar po'i lus shig blangs//brla rkang g.yas la sme ba'am/ /sha mtshan nag ngo'i thig le sku da/ /tshe tshad drug cu re lnga la/ /gegs rkyen bzhi yi dus rtag tu/ /1ri bag 'kho na dang mi gtsang gzab/ /klu ma6)da klur 'dzems ma byas na/ /mi gtsang snyad btags klu nad gdodang / /'bo/ la dga' zhing sems las che/ /gting

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 110ring khog pa gdug pa de/ /bu tsha rigs brgyud dbang po la / / skyon 'ong kha mchu 'phung gyod mang / /g.yang can nor phyir shor bas lan/ /tshe 'phos phug ron khu byug gam/ /byol song rigs sam 'on deb can/ /lus len rtags la rked pa dang / /rgyab dang lag g.yas ltag khung masnga mas//sme ba'i mtshan ma gsal bar sku/da/ /yang na sme ba'i ga sha can/ /de min gasku na lag byed pa'am/ /gathodang la sme mdzer gang rigs yod/ phyag rdor sku bzhengs sātstsha khri/ /'bum btab sngags pa mthu bo che/ /las su gtad byed sngags pa'am/ /bajorwa 1 ban thodan yang na ni/ /nub tshulags phyug po'i bu ru skyes/ /khyod kyi zhing ngam khang pa la/ /sa bdag gnas sa yod pa ste / / dreg dang zha grum shu 'bras dang / /thor pa smyo 'bog nad ngo yin/ /mi gtsang thab gachodab snyad btags nas/ /chodar la gang stongs yul la ni/ /'pho 'phyugs 'ong ba'i sa yin te/ /pha spun ma spun zhang nye'i sar/ /'og rta bong bu la byas pa'i / / gzhogs don na ba'i lha na can codang / /zhing sa sngor rtag zla ba 'dra/ /gzhu 'dra sa srin bcas pa sku da/ /khang 'gram klu yi rgyu srang byed/ /zas cadar g.yang nyams mi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 111brgyud mar/ /sa bdag klu yis bzung ba sku/da/ /'bo las mang zhing sdug bsngal mang / /kha smras mang zhing 〈snad la nan/ /legs pa bdag gis byas gyur kyang / /sngor sku gzhan gyi 'khyer ba yin/ /dma' ru rang nyid mi nyan la/ /masngo bar cadang du mis mi ster/ /phyi nas bab pa mi mo da kyang / /nang na sku da pa phyir mi 'a〉〉ra/ /rgyun du mi gtsang ba la gzab/ /lha ru klu mo dkar mo 'go /klu mgon la sogs dus rtag tu//'bru sna klu sman 'o mas mchod/ /tshad ldan byung na dngos grub 'byung //gdon du gnyan dang sa bdag gnod/ /gtsang sbra che zhing khyod mdun na/ /mi skad gcig chodas rgyug pa yi/ /sems chung tshig gsal khe/ ba sla/ /khyim du zas dang ho ma byin kyang / /phyi nas tshur la 'phya kha galta nga / /yag lan nyes kyis 'jal ba mang khri/rtag tu grib kha sdang ba yin/ /bu tsha ming sring bzhi ru bshad/ /nor ni zal po sngo sngo 'phrod/ /lhalnga ser 'dil gang skyes pa/ /dge slong tshe 'phos rgyal rigs bu/ /bdud po yab rjes byin pa'i bu/ /'byung ba'i dwangs ma dad pa che//blo brtan shes che codas la dad/ /pha mes sgo yis 'a25 ba la/ /skyes sar

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 112skyes nas 'khrungs sar bltams/ /de yis pha mes rigs brgyud nas//sa bdag rgyal sngo gasdudad pa yin/ /lha srung g.yel ba ma snumar te/ /gsol kha bskang bshags drag tu bya/ /gri dang rabs chad 'khe/ra ba yin/ /tshe sngon drang srong ban de 'am/ /a tsar dkyus ma'i lus shig blangs/ /yang na rgyal 'thodang skye ba blangs/ /rtags su chod rtab gtam 'chol mang rig pa myur la skye ba 'dir/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu 'phrang dam gnyis/ /brgal la 'chi zhing phyi ma ni/ /spre'u khyim byar skye ro/gas pas/ /thub dbang sku dang rdor gcod bzhengs/ /sngags pa zhig tu skye ba'am/ /pho lus thob nas chos la dkar/ /de nas srin gyi bu ru skye/ /yang na tshong dpon lus kyang len/ /dkor srung ban bon chos skyong gnod/ /skang bshags gtsug tor stong bzlog bya/ /rtag tu lha mi dga' ba dang / /rmi lam rtsab rtsub shinatu mang / /yul bdag pha ming srung ma 'alha/ /ban brgyud thodan brgyud yin na bzang / /min na phur kha dam sri gasbya/da/ /rdib grir shi 'am yul mkhar la/ /dgra yis khyer ram 'aho/ bskyas byas/ /lta ba mtho zhing smra kham che/ /shes rab che zhing mgu ba dka'/ /dwa phrug byams lha nga

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 113na tsha mo da/ /gso/sa pas mi ngan dgra ru ldang / /mi kha drag po 'byung nyen yod/ /las la 'tsher zhing de dga' che/ /bu tsha ming sring lnga ru bshad/ /nor rdzas skam nor sa zhing 'phrod/ /chos la dkar na tshe ring codang / /sku/na tan mkhan gyi brgyud pa 'am/ /khyed rang sku na tan che bar 'ong / / sgo drag sems 'phang dma' ba 'ong / /nor la gang stongs byis pa dka'/ /rang gis byas kyang mi mi mgu /bud med rigs la kha smras dang / /skyes pa dar ma'i dus na 'ang / /klu gnyan sa bdag gaphudad pa yin/ /rims dang dgra sna codam rkun codang / /chu ser mkhris pa che ba ste/ /kha lci phyi thal che ba yin/ /kho sa na bakhyodas sla kho nga drang brtan//rgyal gasnga na snying 'jug gzhan la kho / /rang sems dbang mad shes pa 'phyo/ /mi brgyud sa na smyo 'bog dang / /lceb gri ma mo'i nad kyis 'phung / /༈/drug dkar 'di la gang skyes pa/ /yi dwags tshe 'a'o/sa lha 'gong bu/ /rang gis smras pa ma tshor bar/ /gzhan gyi lto slong 'ong ba'i sa/ /dus rnams rtag tu lha gdon gnod/ /'gong pos 'phung

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 114 dgugs byed pa mo da/ /tshe khyodan lha dang yi dwags sam/ /bram ze sha ba khu byug skyes/ /tshe tshad bdun cu gogs lnga 'byung / /shes rab che zhing ngo mi brtan/ /rkang gasku na lag g.yas byin pa dang / /smad du sme ba'i sha mtshan sku da/ /'bo 'dug dga' la bud med yin/ /kha 'jam gting rtsub lha rgyal dang / /bu grir shi ba mna' mas ni/ /mi gtsang nyal gro'i gnyan 'dre gnod/ /'go ba yul lha bzang po 'go /dbul zhing kha rje bsris mi rme/ /yul kha gnyis su 'dzin dpyad yin/ /lha ma dga' bar snyad btags nas/ /pha ming rgyud pa rabs chad sku/da/ /pha drin ma'i drin chung na yang / /rang lha drag par cadang ba yin/ /'o/ lha dgra lhas skyob pa de / / nad dkon 'byung na tshab chen 'ongs/ /spun zla meng yang bu gcig pu/ /zla rogs mang yang sku reng po/ /phar la drin lan mang / gzhal yang / /tshur la gcadad pa skyel ba mang / /kha bzhin ngan te gting khyodan chung / /bu tsha ming sring lnga 'am gsum/ /cadar ni zal zal 'a'o/da pa yin/ /phyi ma thodan wa'i bu mo/ 'am/ /ban thodan khyodam sgrub byed pa'am // bya yi lus len gtsug tor dang / /bla ma'i sku bzhengs lto phyogs su/ /yon

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 115tan can du skye ba len/ /yang na lha yi rigs su skyes / /gzhan lha la lag drin kha yis gsod/ /ban bon phur gtod gud pa yod/ /zas nor gang stongs zhang nyer 'khon/ /skyes sar skyes dang 'khrungs sar 'khrungs//yul mkhar dgra la sna ra ba dang / /yang na 'aho skyas byas pa 'am/ /dur kha gnyis su chad pa dang / /rtag tu nye ba dgra ru ldang / /pha mes mthod rus ma tshang bas/ /bu tsha glen lkugs mang ba codang / /bse rags dam sri phur kha gnod/ /mi stong rta stong 'jal len byas/ /pha mes byes su shi ba sku da/ /mna' dang dkar mis 'phung ba cadang / /pha tshan nang nas ma11 gcadan byed/ /gcig la gcig mi nyan pa sku(da/ /mi kha byams la gang rjodangs chung / / mi brgyud sa na mar bshad pa/ /ming sring macadal du shor ba 'am/ /mna' ma byi 'o/ bsrel bar 'ong / /lha mgo khyi mjug spel ba yong / /mtshe ma shorare btsal bu dang / /gnyen bu lag pa skyon can cadang / /pha spun mi mthun khang zhing can / / bud med dbang du mo nga ba sku da/ /gsar 'bo gas che la tshig sna thung / /khyodad kyi 'bring brgyud rmang bar 'ong /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sta/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 116༈/bdun dmar 'di la gang skyes pa/ /btsan bu shan pa gri chodags te/ /pha ma gri ru 'chi yang zer/ /rang nyid tha ma grir 'chi nyen/ /mi stong rta stong 'bab pa yin/ /mang nyung lcang kha'i byi'u 'dra/ /skyid sdug dpyid ga'i nyi ma 'dra/ /bu tsha ming sring bdun gyi ngo / /nor ni dkar dmar 'phrod pa yin/ /dme gri rang la 'khor ba'o/ /sdig la mi 'dzem rang 'dod che/ /rang sgo drag ste gnya' gcog mang / /rim gyis 'bar nas thum gyis 'chi/ /tsha grang thab kyi sla nga 'dra/ /'grangs 44gas mgar ba'i sbud pa 'dra/ /tshe sngon btsan dang lha min skyes/ /phyi ma srin 'bu 'phar spyang ngam/ /yi dwags las mkhan gang rung skye/ /cadal ma'i sku bzhengs 'o/ lus thodab/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa zhig kyang 'byung / /rtags su rtsib 'o/gas rgyab brang dang / /lag g.yon gang rung ba la ni/ /sme ba ba bur sha mtshan sku da/ /tshe tshad brgya cu bar gathodad bzhi / / khyod thung brjed skyen dmar dad che/ /bud med yin na gnyid la dga'/ /bye bral byed pa'i sngo sku da wa / /pha tshan nang la dme 'khrug mang / /chung dus rma shul ho/la 'bras cadang / /skyes nas mi dang 'thab la dga'/ /rgyal

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 117dang zhu ba gasdudan rdo nga 'jal/ /mched thodags btsan gyis byed pa yin//lus la dpa' rtsal che ba ste/ /sha mdodag dmar la shes pa kho / /khrag gzer lho bur glang thabs 'byung / /zas la ngan la dmar la batrika /byas pa med kyang mi kha sdang / /las la g.yel la zas la bsdu/ /shod shed che bar cadang ba yin/ /'bo ba btsan 'asgo shen gzugs dang / /rtag mchodad 'dre ru gre btsan gnod/ /bu tsha lhag chad mang bar 'ong / /dmar la snyad btags grir shi nyen/ /stu da kyi sa na mar gyi char/ /skyes pa gri ru shi ba yod/ /yang na byes su shi ba dang / /ro ni byol song bkal ba cadang / /dur gyi dkyil du gri snga tshud/ /gri sri mthu la rkyen byas nas/ /gri btsan bsdongs 'dre gnod pa yin/ /༈/brgyad dkar 'di la gang skyes pa/ /dga' ldan lha yi bu yin te/ /tshe sngon mon yul zhig tu skyes/ /de nas lha la skyes pa yin/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu bar chad gsum/ /rkang g.yas 'gram g.yas sme ba sku/da//phyi ma bud med lus len dogs/ /ston pa'i sku bzhengs lha bzo bar skye 'am yang na chodas pa byed/ /de nas slar yang lha yul skye/ /rtags su

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdus gsal 'ga' skyed/ 118 dpyi gasku/na sme mtshan sku da/ /grib kha ldang zhing mi gtsang 'dzems/ /ngang ring kha gshog gting nas dam/ /yul lha dgra lha rgyal po 'go/ /rtag tu lha la gasku la kha rem/ /'dre ru lha srung kho sa pa dang / /khyim mtshes 'gong 'dre rgyal po gnod/ /gzhis yul gnyis 'dzin lta ba mtho/ /sha dkar sna rno nga rgyal che/ /yongs khur skyid bu 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thab gachodab 'dzems na tshe ring zhing / / bu tsha ming sring gsum du 'ong / /rang nyid ngan g.yang lha bzang 'bo /mi byams large pa bag ba sku da/ /na tsha byung yang 'asnur ba sla/ /rgas pa'i dus su shin tu skyid/ /chu thod chad khar che ba la/ /mar me shi khar gsal ba yin/ /nyi ma rgas khar 4) ba yin//shi yang rang gi bu tshas 'dur/ /mi bas lha bzang rdza bas lung / /bzang ste lha srung bzang ba yi/ /'khon la bdar la yul mi yang/ /khyod dang 'khe na pa mang ba yin/ /rang yang skabs su shes pa tshig /rang gi lha srung mi dga' bas / / kho don med par khro ba dang / /smra sa med par smra ba dang / /bros don med par bros pa 'ong / /brgyag sa med par brgyag par dga'/ /'khon gyis 'phung 'dre byed pa ste/ /ngan pas bzung la

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 119'khe na la gzab/ /rang nyid zhan yang mi kha byams/ /lag bzo rig pa shin tu swā / /skabs su 'kho na dang gtam basbrumal cadang / /sku na tan che la jo sa la dad/ /bu ni bzhi 'am drug tu skye/ /kha chu bu skal mo da pa yin/ /ya rabs byams te ma rabs sdang / 3/gdan khur mi yis byed pa 'ong / /khyed kyi sa na mar gyi char/ /'kho na shing nag po mthodar skyes pa'i/ /phyi 'kho na rlung 'tshub nang 'kho na 'bar/ /pha tshan gcig la cadas kha gnyis/ /mi res dkrugs shing byed pa cadang / /khyodab dasngo na yin na sku na mchodad yang / /mi 'tshengs tsam la 'kho na pa cadang / /༈/dgu dmar 'di la gang skyes pa/ /lha las tshe 'phos sman gyi bu/ /gnam sman chen snu sa byin pa yin/ /tshe khyodan dmu yi yul nas 'phos/ /de nas phyug wa'i sgo khyi dang / /bon wa zhig gi skye ba blangs/ /tshe tshad ro na gsum bar chad lnga/ /phyi ma khyi dang bong bu 'am/ /khyim pa'i bud med dman par skye/ /'jam dbyangs sku dang gzungs 'bungs na//rsā lto phyogs mon yul 'byor can bu/ /yang na 'byor ldan ser sna can//gang rung skye 'am sprin gseb kyi/ /lha la skye ba de'i rtags su/ /gasngo nga

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 120mgo bed mjing rkang g.yon la/ /sme ba ba bur sha mtshan sku da/ /g.yang gi me tog ha lo bdun/ /lag pa g.yas dang g.yon la thogs/ /me tog 'di dang ma bral na/ /nye 'kho ra spyi la rag ma lus/ /pha mes lto gas kyang rang rang phyug /mi pho rang gi rtsal las byung / /gal te 'di dang bral ba na/ /g.yang kha ral te g.yang kha nyams/ / rang la med na nye ba sdang / / bud med yin bzang ban bone ngan/ /blo rgya chags sdang che ba dang / /cadar la brnag cing g.yang gi ru/ /ma skams rgas khar skyid pa codang / /rdzas nag rkyal nag dag gi 'dre/ /byis pa'i sar gachodad g.yang sgrub gyis/ /g.yang gi g.yung drung ma bral na/ /kha gang zas za lag gang gi /nor la spyod par bya ba yin/ /ma bsam pa nas dgrar sdang ste/ /pho brgya'i lag nas mda' ltar gasku ra/ /snu brgya'i lag nas bal ltar g.yeng skyes pa byes su 'khyams pa dang / /pha mes mgo rus phyi shor 'ong / /tshe smad g.yang dang zhag mtsho ༄nal/ /'on kyang nye ba dgra ru sdang / /zos pa dug 'gyur mi kha sdang / / ya rabs byams la ma rabs sdang / /skyes pa byes su 'khyams wa gas sku da/ /ma ming ring la chodar rtags can/ /phyi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 121shor byas pa yod la thang / /bu tsha bu gnyis bu mo mang / /nor rdzas 'bri dang ra lug 'phrod/ /'di la bu btsas rang la ngan / / pha mes mi rgyud gnyis ka la/ /mi dang the/ra gyi g.yang kha nyams/ /mi g.yang nyams pas gasku na 'khyams dang / /mi yi phyi ru 'brengs pa dang / /zhang nye'i rgyab tu sdodapa yod/ /mi chos bor nas rang chos yod/ /sa ma zin gyi chos byed yod / / lag pas 'thor yang ngo dga' che/ /nor rdzas spu rtags can 'ga' yang / /mi yi lag tu sna ra ba coding / /cadar g.yang nyams pa de yis len/ /nor rdzas ba mo'i zil pa 'dra/ /yod pa 'dra la stong pa 'byung / /tshe stod sdug dang tshe smad skyid/ /lha ru btsan dang sman bu 'gogadon du ri sna chu mig gdang / /tshang tshing gnas pa'i 'dre gdon gachodad//lha ra la g.yang chags phyugs ma btub/ /spu rtags can la phya g.yang chags/ /g.yang sku na bya zhing g.yang kha brjodam/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 122༄༅/ /gzhan yang lha dpal tshe bdud 'bras/ /srog ni pha ma lhar btsas pa/ /tshe yi nyi ma shar ba ste/ /lo ni bdun cu mgasum brgal// ༈/srog ni bu dpal sprin bral gyi/ /nyi ma tshe tshad drug cu gcig ༈/sku ga ni mthun pa tsher btsas pa / / nyi ma rlung bskyod tshe skal 'bring / /lo ni bzhi bcu zhe dgu 'da'/ ༈/srog ni thub pa 'drer btsas pa/ /nyi ma sprin bsgribs 'o/ sdud bdun/ ༈/srog ni mi thub bdud btsas pa/ /tshe yi skal chad nyi ma nub/ /btsas ma thag tu 'chi bar bshad/ ༈/de yang lha/ga dbang gcig pa'i lo/ /dgra yar thog tu skyes pali'abras/ /lcags bdud lo ni bco lngar 'chi/ /me bdud bcu gnyis lo la 'chi/ /chu bdud lo 3 dgu la 'chi/ ༈/sa bdud lo ni drug la 'chi/ /shing bdud lo gsum dag la 'chi / / lus ni pha ma lha la btsas pa/ ༈/gzugs bzang byad bzhin legs pa ste/ /lus kyang bde la nyams shed che/ /bu tsha dpal de lus skal rgyas / / chung dus galha/ sla nyams shed bde/ ༈/mthun pa tsher btsas lus skal 'bring / /gzugs bzang byad bzhin legs pa de/ /rang lus rang gi theg pa yin/

tshe rtsis 'bras bu 〈sna gsal 'ga' skyed/ 123༈/thub pa 'dre ni lus skal 'pham/ /chung dus gasku dka' na tsha mod/ /mi thub bdud ni lus skal chad/ /cadan shing chage ste gzugs ngan la/ /chod sha med de gathodang gis zin / / de yang dbye ba 'di bzhin ste gzugs ngan la/ /lcags bdud gro ba gcong can 'ong / ༈/me bdud sku nga na tshad nad dang / /snying nad sha ya'i nad can 'byung / ༈/chu bdud sku/nga na mkhal nad can/ /chu nad dmu chu'i nad kyang 〉〈nga / ༈/sa yi bdud lha/nga mcher nad dang / / gzhang 'brum nad kyis 'tshe bar byed/༈/shing gi bdud sku nga mchin nad can/ /sgur 10 glang thabs can yang 'ong / / dbang thang pha mar skal lhag cing / /mtsho rgyas bu nor dang ldan la/ /spun dang bran 'kho ra hrags pa yin/ ༈/bu tsha dpal ni dbang skal rgyas/ /bu bzang cadar 'bring zas lha ra gyi/ /g.yang so/na rtag tu 'bad pa bzang / ༈/mthun pa tshe ni zas nor gyi/ /skal 'bring nor bzang bu la 'bring / /dpal bskyed srid kyi phur pa thob/ ༈/thub pa 'dre ni dbang skal dman/ /bu tsha lhag chad mang ba dang / /cadar la gang rjodangs rgyun mi chad/ ༈/mi thub bdud ni skal chad kyis/ /mcho skam bu spun

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 124bdun btsas kyang / /tha mar rabs chad ma17 brgya dang / /'bri lha nga ra lug brgya phrag dag / 'jo/ma yang skud pa mi la lho nga / /brgya gsum kha stong ldan na yang / /mtha' ma sprang por 'gro ba yin/ ༈/de yang lcags bdud song ba na/ /bu tsha stag yos med par 'gyur/ ༈/me yi bdud song bu tsha bo/ /bya sprel med cing chu bdud song / /bu tsha rta sbrul med pa yin/ ༈/sa yi bdud sku nga bu tsha ྅ / /byi phag med cing shing bdud sku nga / /bu tsha gshed bzhi med pa yin / / klung rta pha mar yid tshang chodab//'khor lo bskor te lam sna 'dren/ /klung rta'i skal ltag yul bdun glo/sa 'dzin kun gyi re sar 'gyur/ /mi kha dbang 'dus dbo sa rgu tshang /bsam dgu 'grub ste mthu bsgrub dang / /byad kha mi tshugs lcags khyodang 'dra/ ༈/bu tsha dpal ni klung skal rgyas/ /blo rig dbang gsal shes bzhin du/ /mthas rgyas ya rabs malnga/na sngo/ra skyel/ /mi kha byams pa gcig byas kyang / /'gro sman 'tho rwa na phyogs med mdzad/ ༈/mthun pa tshe ni rlung skal 'bring / /thabs dang yid tshang thod pa yi/ /dbang po gsal la thar lam 'dren/ /rang bo snu da pas bo sa mi 'dri/ /sna thag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 125mi la ma thodar te/ /rang kha rang gis bsgyur ba yin/ ༈/thub pa 'dre ni klung skal 'pham/ /byas pas mi ni ma mgu ste/ /'dug pas rang ma dal ba ci)na/ /༷gre :pe byams kyang nang :se sdang / /smras pas ngag ni :pe nyan cing / / kha smras gleng mang sa :pe zin/༈/mi thub bdud ni skal chad cing shing gi 'o/ 'dab bzhin du ni//yar la rgyas kyang 'bras bu rnams/ /sa tso/ga lhung ste yul mkhar la/ /'a24 skyas byed cing skyid sdug mang / /dgos dgu tshang yang 'go lha med/ /sdug bsngal mang zhing bsam pa yi/ /don ni mi 'grub mi kha sdang / /khyodang sde gra sdang ma nyes kyi/ /kha gasku/gas kha smras gling gzhi mang / /bkar ba〉〉ga klad 'byor nye dgrar sdang / ༈/de yang lcags kyi bdud du song / /'khrugs pa'i mtshon kha 'du ba dang / ༈/me bdud yul dang khang khyim 'tshig ༈/chu bdud shwa 'od chu yis gnod/ ༈/sa bdud yul la 'pho 'phyugs 'ong /༈/shing bdud sgrogs dang khang rul 'ong / /srog dang klung rta ngan pa na//tshe la 'o/ngas med shi dogs yod/ /lus dang klung rta ngan pa na/ /rgas khar nad mang sdug bsngal che/ /dbang thang klung rta ngan pa na/ /bu chodar

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 126mtha' ru med por 'gro /༄༅/ /yang gcig dpal byur brtag pa'i 'bras/ /༈/pha yi srog gi dpal 'bab na/ /tshe la hur thum mi 'ong ste/ /tshe srog ri las brtan par 〉〈nga / ༈/ma yi lus kyi dpal babs na/ /nad du chu ser skran nad med/ /lus dar na tsha dkon par 'ong / ༈/ma yi dbang thang dpal babs na/ /ri kha skam phyin zas dang phrad/ /lung pa skam phyin ryā dang phrad/ /zas nor longs spyod che bar 'ongs/ ༈/pha yi klung rta dpal babs na/ /cinag gsum smras na bka' btsan zhing / /nyin gsum phyin na mi yang byams/ /lus la yid tshang 'a|/ra ba'i 'o// /mi kha byams shing bsku da nams che/ ༈/pha yi sku ga gi byur babs na/ /tshe ring dka' ba'i sa yin te/ /lus ni chos kyi 'khor lo skor/ /gser gyi tshe dpag med mgon bzhengs/ /tshe gzungs nyin re tshar re 'don/ /srog phur gdab cing tshe bsnyen bsgrang/ /de ltar byas na tshe ring phan/ ༈/ma yi lus kyi byur babs na/ /lus la na tsha bag tsam sku/nga /pha mes mi tshan gsum du chad/ /tshan gcig dar la tshan gcig 1// /gaskuḥ no thub pa

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 127tsam du sku da/ /mi tshan gcig ni chad la khad/༈/ma yi dbang thang byur babs na/ /kha na sku da pa lce yis 'phul/lag na sku da pa thang la babs/ /phyi nas 'bri mo khrid sku nga pa/ /khyim du ru rgan rgya mor 'gro/ /za thang med pas nor kyang chung / ༈/pha yi klung rta'i byur babs na/ /byas pas rje yi spyan ma khengs/ mo yis phrug phrug sil sil byas/ /15gas kyis zla la lha gas pa dang / /legs pa rang gis byas pas kyang / /sngo sku gzhan gyis 'khyer ba dang / /khyim du zas zos chang 'thung nas/ /sgo ru 'phya kha yod tshad gtong / /lus bsgyur dge bsnyen dasna/na ma6)ga skyabs/ /zhes btags codas lha ra zhugs pa bzang byas pa med par mi kha sdang / ༈/srog shing rang rkang tshugs pa na/ /phur kha byad kha gcadad pa yin/ lhanasku/ga me rang rkang tshugs pa na/ /ba za' mi bye bral bu shi chad/ ༈/sku ga sa rang rkang tshugs pa na/ /yul mkhar 'pho skyas mang du byed/ ༈/srog lcags rang rkang tshugs pa na/ ༈/nor la gang stongs zhang nye gud/ ༈/srog chu rang rkang tshugs pa na/ /rang la pho mchin na tsha 'ong / /gdon du sa bdag klu gnyan gnod/ /bag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 128ma bu sring gcong can yong / ༈/lus ni rang rkang dar rgud 'bring /༈/dbang thang rang rkang zas nor 'bring / ༈/klung rta rang rkang bsod nams 'bring / ༈/lha/ga ni mdangs sku/ra tshe thung zhing / ༈/lus ni mdangs shor na tsha mod/ ༈/dbang thang mdangs shor zas nor chung / ༈/klung rta mdangs shor mi kha sdang / ༈/srog ni tshe len tshe 'bring stod/ ༈/lus ni tshe len nad dkon bzang / ༈/dbang thang tshe len zas nor che/ ༈/klung rta tshe len mi kha byams/ ༈/1/ga gud sku/ga 'asnga na bya ba dang / /gzhan gyi sku ga ni mi gcod cing / ༈/lus gud lus bsgyur mchod rten la/ /na bza' gasku la la dbang thang gud/ ༈/dbang thang gso zhing rab byung macodad/ ༈/klung rta gud na klung rta gasku / /lam 'phrang zhig gasku bathe sa kyang bya/ /ko༅/de nas rgya ma pha klung 'bras/ /rgya ma 'asnumams pa mi 'phel lo/ /rgya stong klung ni bu mor 'gro/sdod pa srid skam skye skab chad/ /ldog pa shi kha bye balhan / 1 rgya ma kha ral shi kha'i sgab/ /mi cesad pa yi 'bras bu bstan/ /'asnumams pa mtsho lha la lta bu'i galta / /gsang ba kun 'dus

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 129btang dang gcig /stong pa gang ba lta bu'i gto/ /'khor lo dgu mgyogs btang dang gnyis/ /khyodad pa lcags gis brabs lta'i galta / /sa bdag gasku 'khrugs tang dang gsum/ /kha ral ba ni bakhyo mas pa'i gdod/ /'kho ra lo lnga mgyogs btang dang bzhi/ /'tshoms 'dre gnan pa gal che'o/ /lha/yang ni gza' bzhi ma klung las/ ༈/phyi nang sprad de bar gza' la/ /kha dmar gdags lugs 'di lta ste / / de yang sku ga klung 'di bzhin yin/ /bar gza'i sku ga ni dgra chodag skyes/ /grir 'chi dur chodag btsas pa na/ /'phral la na tsha snu/da pa yin/ /tha ma grir 'chi bo/gas thog skyes/ /'phar bub gang stongs che ba yin/ /rang thog gong 'og mna' za la/ /ma ༄/ga tshe ring ma byams shing / /pha ma'i drin la brtag pa yin/ /bu thog bu nor 'phel ba dang / /dgra dur skyes pa thams cad ni/ /pha ma'i drin la mi gnas shing / /tha ma gri ru 'chi ba yin/ /rang drin rang la za ba yin / / dbang klung dbang thang dgra dur skyes/ lag tu nor ni mi chags shing / /mi stong rta stong sos 'bab 'gyur/ /byur dang god kha rgyun mi chad/ /grogs thog gang stongs 'phar bub che/ /lag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 130nor mi chags dgra dur skyes/ /ma yi drin ni 'khor mi 'gyur/ /rang lnga ga cung zad bzang ba tsam/ /ma thodag cadar 'phel mi byams la /pha ma'i drin la gnas pa 'byung / /bu lnga ga byes 'aho da mi rnams byams/ /༈/phyi nang gnyis kyis bar sku ga bcad/ /tshe thung grir 'chi phyi nang gi/ /dbang bcad dbul zhing phyi nang gis/ /lus bcad zla rogs bye zhig codang / /kha smras dgra sna mang ba yin/ /klung bcad bsku da nams chung ba dang / /rang jo ga 'phar 'bub gzhan ma bzang / /bar nang gnyis kyis phyi gza' bcad/ /bu tsha lhag chad byed zhig dang / /dgra sna mang zhing dgra bdud ngan/ /ma bur sku nga na bzang ba yin/ /re re ngan la skyon sna re/ /phyi nang shing gi bar dag nas/ /sa rnyed gzer gyi nad kyis 'chi/ /de bzhin me bar lcags rnyed grir/ /lcags bar shing rnyed dme 'og 'chi// chu bar me rnyed gro bur 'chi/ /sa bar chu rnyed gcong nad 'chi/ /༈/phyi gza' nang gza' bar gza' yi/ /bdun zur song na ltas ngan klung / /de ltar ma chodar shes pa gces/ /'dir ni gza' bzhi ma

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 131klungs gathor/ /ma de'i phyi gza' stag sku sa dang / /spar kha zin la babs pa'i dus / / bu tsha gshed bzhi shing bar sa/ /des 'gre kun la sbyar batraṭa thegatraṭa/ /༈/pho yi rabs chad sgo lnga dang / ༈/mo yi g.yang gsham sgo lnga yi/ /rtsi tshul re'u mig sku/gas su gsal/ /galtaste la pho ni rabs chad kyis/ /gri lkugs sa rdib shi ba dang / /brnangs nas shi ba chu grir shi//rta grir shi dang thog gis bsad/ /de lnga'i yugs sa mo blangs na/ /mi yi rgyud pa chad pa yin/ /rabs chad snu/ yis gri lkugs pa/ /chung ma shi ba'i rabs chad phyin/ /mi yi rabs ni 'dzin pa yin/ /ra༅/ /rgya phrag gcig gi kha dmar ni/ 7sku/ga gi rang rdel dkar ba na/ /rin chen tshe yi gter zhes bya/ /chung dus gso sla rgas tshe ring / /pha dang khu ngo kun la gzan/ 7sku ga gi ma rdel dkar ba na// pha khu dar ba'i tsha yug yin/ /rgyab brten mi la mi 'chodal sku///7/sku ga gi bu ni bzang ba na/ /tshe ring tshe yi brten phur tshugs/ /lnga na bu khye'u skyes ba yin/ 7/srog gi grogs ni legs pa na/ /nor ni rmig

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 132pa kha dbrag 'a'o/da/ 7/sku ga gi dgra rdel dkar ba na/ /gajo nga dang nad gzhi rnying pa 'dzems/ /zas ngan dmu chu cadang ba'i lnga / 7/srog rdel ngan la skyes pa ni/ /chung dus gasku dka' tshe yang thung / / tshe sgrub tshe gzungs tshe codag bya/ /sku ga gi ma ni ngan pa ni/ /pha ni rabs chad cad stong 'ong/ /pha gu dar gud che ba yin/ 7/srog gi bu ni ngan pa na/ /bla tshe gnyis kyi rten phur phyung / /rmig pa kha dbrag mi 'phrod do/ 7/srog gi grogs ni ngan pa na/ /bya byed mang la blo sho rgod/ /sdod la mi dga' 'gro la dga'/ /rkang pa rlung gi 'khor lo bskor/ /srog gi dgra ni ngan pa na/ /rgan sri gastu/na sri dar sri med/ /༈/lus dar lus kyi kha rje che/ /gzugs bzang byad legs khyim sa zin/ 7/lus kyi ma rdel dkar ba na/ /ma sru 'bo gas yun ring ba yin/ 7/lus kyi bu ni dkar ba na/ /khye'u bu mo gso ba sla/ 7/lus kyi bo gas ni dar ba na/ /skyes ba bud med rgan dang phrad/ /bud med yin na skyes par rigs/ 7/lus kyi dgra rdel dkar ba na/ /nad sna/da dbang sngo lha na can coding / /ma zhu skran dang dmu chus 'chi/ 7/lus kyi

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdus gsal 'ga' skyed/ 133rang rdel nag pa na/ /nad mod dbang po skyon can 'ong / /lus bsgyur lus bskyed srung ba 'alnga ga 7/lus kyi ma ni ngan pa na/ /ma sru 'bo sa yun thung ba yin/ 7/lus kyi bu rdel nag pa na/ /khye'u bu snu gasku ba dka'// 7lus kyi grogs ni ngan pa na/ /wa ro dur khrod lus pa dang / /mar rgan thang la lhung ba 'dra/ 7/lus kyi dgra ni ngan pa na/ /lus la nad dang gcong med do/ /༈/dbang rdel dar na longs spyod che/ /spu phyugs zas nor 'dod rgu 'phel/ 7/dbang thang ma ni dar ba na/ /zhang nye dar ba'i tsha yug yin/ /zhang sngo tsha thod 'bo gas yun ring / 7/dbang thang bu ni bzang ba na/ /bu mo ma las mdzangs pa cadang / /bu snu sa bo gas kyang mang ba rnyed//7/dbang thang bo gas ni dar ba na/ /'o/ legs bran gasku ga 'o/ snu byams/7/dbang thang dgra rdel dkar ba na//྅/ra nyams dgra lag 'a〉〉ra ba yin/7/dbang thang ce'u nag pa na/ /don med gson 'jal stong so byed//rgas khar cadar phyugs gang thebangs che/ /yul kha gnyis su bzung na legs//7/dbang thang ma ni ngan pa na/ /ra khyi rta lha nga gcig brgyud byed/ /zhang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 134nye dar gud che ba yin/ 7/dbang thang bu rdel nag pa na/ /bu snu grung mo sho re 'ong / 7/dbang thang grogs ni nag pa na/ /'o de)ga spyir bzang theban mi 'du/ /mag pa tsha yug nye ring 'ong / 7 / dbang thang dgra ni nag pa na/ /cadar rnams dgra lag mi 'chodar zhing / /bsags pa rang gis spyod par 'gyur/ /༈/klung rdel dkar na bla ma dang / /ya rabs thodang ma byams pa yin/ /dgra lha dang ni srung ma 'alha / 7/klung rta'i ma ni dkar ba na//rje dang lho na thodas mabo na skyabs mjo da/ /gzhan gyis rang la zhu ba 'ong / 7/klung rta'i bu rdel bzang ba na / / rta dang bong bu sgab 'phel so// 7/klung rta'i bo gas ni bzang ba na/ /khyodan sngo thabs la mkhas pa de/ /long ba'i nor ni mi 'phrod do/ 7/klung rta'i dgra rdel dkar ba na/ /byas pa'i las la mgu ba med/ /ga sa kyang 'grang rgyu med pa yin / 7 1 klung rta'i rang rdel nag pa na/ /rang gis byas kyang 1ra re chung / /pha tshan nang nas ngan gasku/ma sku/da/ /rang nyid btsan sa bzung na legs/7/klung rta'i ma ni ngan pa na/ /khyodab dpon rje bo bkur sti chung / /drin

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 135mi 'a3rig la rgyab brten 'asnunal/ daklung rta'i bu ni ngan pa na/ /nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs pa 'dra/ /bya lha da thang la lhungs pa 'dra/ 7/klung rta'i grogs ni ngan pa na/ /rta dang bong bu sgab mi 'phel/ /tshe grogs khar rje chung ba yin/ 7/klung rta'i dgra rdel nag pa na / / mi yi gnya' gcadan mi yong ngo ༄she/de nas ngan klung sgo lnga ni/ /spar kha dwa zin la skyes shing //sme ba bdun dmar gsum mthing btsas/ /sku ga gud sku ga la dgra dar na/ /mi de tha ma gri ru 'chi/ 7/sme ba dmar nag la btsas shing / /spar kha shin zin la skyes te/ /lus gud lus kyi dgra dar na/ /bu brgya yod kyang mtha' rabs chad/ 7/spar kha zin thodag la skyes shing / /sme ba dkar gsum la btsas te /dbang thang bo/gas gsum nag pa na//da lta phyug kyang tha ma sprang / 7/spar kha li lta na khen la btsas/ /sme ba dmar nag la skyes nas/ /lus gud lus kyi bo gas gud na/ /tha ma sku/ nam zla bral byed / 7 / spar kha sa gzhi la skyes nas / /sme ba bzhi dang lnga la btsas/ /klung gud klung gi dgra dar na/ /da lta nad med bde

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 136skyid kyang / /tha ma bong zhon khyi khrid 'ong / /de las ldog pa bzang po cigan/ /༈/rde'u spyi yi kha dmar ni/ /bu tsha'i dbang thang yod pa de/ /bye'u (bu de'i sar dkar nar gyis byung na)chu la rub pa 'dra / 7 / bu tsha'i dbang thang med pa de/ /phyug phran(zur bzhi nag shas che ba la gcig dkar la gcig nag pa byung na/)zor bas brngas pa 'dra/ 7/mi dang gleng gzhi 'ong tsa na/ /mi rgan(stod dkar smad nag po)so de bud/ 7/tha mar rabs chad 'ong tsa na//mchos nga (zur bzhi nag shas che la gcig dkar gcig nag byung na/)sna thag chag pa 'dra//:sgo yi rngan chen skyodang byurga na/ /|gi rgan (mtha' nag la dkyil dkar ba)mdangs nag lding pa 'dra/ 7/zas nor dbang thang chung ba ni/ /sder stong khyi yis bldags pa (mtha' dkar dkyil nag pa/)'dra/ 7/mi la mdze brgyud sku/da tsa na/ /sprul nag thur la rgyugs pa (nag po 'khyog 'gros byung na)'dra/ /dkar po bzhi gling mang ba na/ /snang srid skyid kyi ra ba yin/ /stod la byung na tshe thebad ni/ /pha ma byams shing skyid pa yin/ /bar du byung na btsan phyug ldan/ /smad du byung na rgas khar skyid/ /nyi ma rgas khar 4) ba yin/ /nam

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 137phug bzang bas shin tu dge/ /7nag ho/ gru bzhi mang ba na/ /rabs chad khyim yin stod nag na/ /dwa'u 'am skyid sdug mang du 'ong / /bar du nag po bzhi gling byung / /khyim du gser gyi lha ma yodad kyang / /dathodas dus sa rdo thodang pa 'dra/ /gsham du byung na bo gas dang g.yang / /kha na sku da pa lce yis 'phul/ /lag na sku da pa mi la lha ra / / bu brgya yod kyang mthar rabs chad/ /༈/de nas dar gud 'grel pa bshad/ /gter chen bzhi dang sku thub bzhi/ /'o/ngas rjodad bzhi dang bde ldan bzhi/ /bsam grub bzhi dang rgyud rims bzhi/ 7/de la gter chen bzhi sngo la/ /1/ga 3 dar na tshe yi gter/ /nywa/na shing gra ma legs pa 'dra/ /bu 'am nu la gzan pa ni//spu gri klad la bskor ba 'dra/ 7/lus ni dar na phung gro'i gter/ /rwa bcu la khar thon pa 'dra/ /bud med khyo la gzan pa ni/ /phyug phran zor gyis btab pa 'dra/ 7/khyim sku/ ma nu 'brang ba ni/ /'kho ra sku/ drag tu balha ra ba 'dra/ 7/dbang thang dar na zas cadar gter/ /btsan dar 'phan phyug 'a༄rdom pa ni/ /mdung la ba dan btags pa 'dra/ /klung rta dar na

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 138yid tshang gter/ /gser g.yu'i phra men lnga gas pa ni/ /gser la g.yu yis spras pa 'dra/ 7/mi kha dbang du sdud pa ni/ /bal 'dab rdo yis mnan pa 'dra/ /kun gyis re sar gyur ba ni/ /byi'u chu la rub pa 'dra/ /dbo sa dgu lus la tshang ba yis/ /sman gyi rjodang sngo rgyas pa 'dra/ /sngags khyodal kha na 'phra ba ni/ /lcags kyi spyil thod phub pa 'dra/ /༈/gos gyon bzhi ni so thub ste/ 7/srog la so thub srog mi 'chad//tshe ni chu wa'i gzhung chen 'dra/ 7/lus kyi sku thub nad rnams sel/ /kha byad zar ma'i me tog 'dra/ 7/dbang thang so thub gter la spyod/ /nor rdzas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'dra/ 7/klung rta sku/ thub bla brgyud 'phel/ /yid tshang gser gyi dra ba 'dra/ / ༈/btsas pa bzhi ni longs spyod de/ 7/srog la longs spyod srog mi 'chad/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ri tho da'adra/ 7/lus la 'o/ngas spyod 'o/ngas spyod rgyas/ /dpag bsam rjodang pa rgyas pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang 'o/ngas spyod yo byad 'phel/ /'bong tshang bsags pa'i 'bong ma 'dra/ 7/klung rta longs spyod yid tshang bsags/ /stag gi ri mo bkra ba 'dra/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 139༈/lus rdzogs bzhi ni bde ldan 'dra/ 7/srog gi bde ldan tshe srog bsra/ 7/lus kyi bde ldan shed mo che/ 7/dbang thang bde ldan longs spyod 'phel/ 7/klung rta bde ldan mdzangs la brtan/ /༈/khrus byed bzhi ni bsam 'grub ste/ 7/lha/ga gi bsam 'grub tshe mi bsdu/ /lcags kyi sran ma bsgril ba 'dra/ 7/lus kyi bsam 'grub sgrin pa ste/ /padma'i me do/ga rgyas pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang bsam pa 'grub pa ni/ /thabs kyi las rnams byed pa ste/ /wa yis stag snying sanas pa 'dra/ 7/klung rta bsam 'grub yid tshang thodab/ /rin chen gser la khyodad pa 'dra/ /༈/las byed bzhi ni brgyud ring ste/ /srog brgyud pha mes bu tsha ring / /chu tho dgazhung chen 'bab pa 'dra/ 7/lus rgyas bu tsha rigs brgyud 'phel/ /sdong po yal ga rgyas pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang rigs brgyud nor dang 'dra/ /rin chen gling du phyin pa 'dra/ /bu tsha 'dab lha ga rgyas pa ni/ /stag la ri snu bris pa 'dra/ /dathodas dgu lus la tshang ba ni/ /mu tig bstar la brgyus pa 'dra/ /klung rta brgyud ring yid tshang 'phel /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 140mdzangs kyi gur khyim phub pa 'dra/ /rgyal khams kha so/ bsgyur ba ni/ /shing rta kha sku/ bsgyur ba 'dra/ /gdags kyi nyi ma spun drug bo/ 7/sribs kyi bu spun drug rjodan pa/ /skal zad bzhi dang byur chen bzhi/ /bye bral bzhi dang 'phung khyodad bzhi/ /phywa nyams bzhi dang rgyun chad bzhi/ /de ltar drug gis bstan pa la/༈/dbugs len bzhi ni skal zad de/ 7/sku ga la de ni skal zad na/ /tshe la hur thum byed pa ni/ /me dodag cho ma bu bathodam pa 'dra/ 7/lus kyi skal zad sdug bsngal mang / /me donag sad kyis bsad pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang skal med 'o/ngas spyod chung / /sha bcu drung nas phyung ba 'dra/ /klung rta skal zad yid tshang stor/ /long ba glang mjug stor ba 'dra/ /༈/mngal zhugs bzhi na byur chen cad/ 7/sku ga la byur chen tshe thung ste/ /ri zar rtse nas rbab btang 'dra/ 7/lus byur chen sngo sa nad kyis 'dzin/ /la phug srin gyis khyer ba 'dra/ 7/dbang thang byur chen cadar dang bral/ /nam mjug zad pa'i sbrang bu 'am/ /sder ma khyi yis bldags pa 'dra/ 7/klung rta byur chen mi kha sdud/ /sbur ba bal gseb 'thums

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 141pa 'dra/ / ༈/rgud pa bzhi ni bye bral te/ 7/sku/ga la bye bral lus sku/ga bral//nam zla zad pa'i 'bang ma 'dra/ 7/lus kyi bye bral sdug bsngal mang / /nya sbal skam la thon pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang bye bral cadar sku gas phyags/ /sgum bu bya yis btus pa 'dra/ 7/klung rta bye bral las thabs 'chodar codag rta sga lha/sa byas pa 'dra/ /༈/na ba bzhi ni 'phung gyod de/ 7/srog la 'phung gyod rang srog gcod/ /rang gi gzu bas rang bkren 'dra/ 7/lus la 'phung gyod gcong gis zin/ /sbrang bu gser rtsis zin pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang 'phung gyod rang la babs/ /sha khyi rang la babs pa 'dra/ /byi ba 'chorwal cadag shi ba 'dra/ 7/klung rta 'phung gyod la babs pa/ /phug ma'i 'og gi chu dong 'dra//snying du bsam pa slo bar song / /gnyen du bsam pa dgra ru sku nga / /slo gtad rgyu ma phus btab 'dra/༈/shi ba bzhi ni phywa nyams te/ 7/rin chen lha/ga gi phywa nyams na//tshe la rlung gis galta ra ba ni/ /'khyag pa'i sho je bcag pa 'dra/ 7/lus

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 142kyi phywa nyams lus shed sna ra/ /kha lhunag nyi mas gdungs pa 'dra/ 7/dbang thang phywa nyams rlung khyer 'dra / / dri za'i grong khyer mthong ba 'dra/ /klung rta phywa nyams yid tshang sna ra/ /'ja' snuran shar nas yal ba 'dra/༈/dur zhugs bzhi ni rgyun chad de/ /lha/ga la rgyun chad bar chad 'byung / /sdong po rtsa ba rul ba 'dra/ 7/lus la rgyun chad kha'i bzhin mdangs/ /khyi ro thal dong bor ba 'dra/ 7/dbang thang rgyun chad nor rdzas brlag /skyi dkar me ler bzhag pa 'dra/ 7/klung rta rgyun chad las las byung / /nyi ma mkha' la nub pa 'dra/ /pha rjes bu yis mi sku/bas te/ /gser dang lcags phye 'dres pa 'dra/ /sribs kyi dwa'u spun drug 05bkatra//༈/yang cig dar gud 'bras bu ci/ 7/klung rta'i rgyab ces bya ba zhi/ /na shi gud pa dag la bya/ /chung dus nad snu da gasku yang dka'/ /gnyen dang mi ngan sdang bar byed / 7 / klung rta stongs pa bya ba ni/ /dur zhugs dbug len mngal nas skyes/ /spo da kha che zhing bdag gis kyang / /'bad nas byas/ kyang mgu ba med/ /klung rta dgra dar ba la skyes/ /mabo chodan

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 143mi sku nga min nam snyam/ /dgra ldang byes su dgra dang phrad/ 7/klung rta mdun zhes bya ba ni/ /lus snyungags btsas pa khrus byed gsum/ /chung dus gasku sla gegs kyis kyang / / mi tshugs thabs dang yid tshang sbru/da /༈/mi rnams kun gyi snying du sdug 7/klung rta'i mdun tshugs bya ba ni//las byed gos gyon dar ba'o/ /god kha med cing ci bsam 'grub/ /kun gyi stod cing ngo so che// //

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsala'aga'askyed/ 144 ——lge//skye brtag 'khor lo bshad kyis nyon/ /khye' gzags mdzes shig bris la//༅ ༄ ༄nyi mas 'khyud pa'i skar ma de/ /spyi i steng du 'dri bar bya/ /kha la gsum dang dpung mgor gnyis/ /ma/khrig mar gnyis dang lag par gnyis / / snying gar lnga dang lte bar gcig /gsang gnas gcig ste pus mor gnyis/ /rkang par brgyad dgod de nyin gyi/ /res 'grogs zla skar gar slebs brtag 7/skyes brtag skar ma sa ri nas/ /rtogs par 'dod na 'di bzhin bya/ /gang rtsi'i nyin gyi zla skar steng / /gzugs sbyin de las nyi skar gyis/ /sbyang la lhag ma gar gnas brtag / ma 'dangs skar ma bsnan la sbyang / /de yi bde slag rtog par 'gyur// bkris dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur cig / //ge ༷khaya /ni rtashā7 15 89 1ci 12 khrarnyishā

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 145༄༅༅/ /mang ku ra chos ston pa'i gza' kun gyi dgra grogs dang dus rjodar gnas mal bcu gnyis kyi lnga sa 'dzin bshad pa/ /nyi ma'i grogs po phur bu ste/ /zla ba'i grogs po phur lhag gnyis/ /mig dmar lhag sangs gnyis kyi bo gas/ /zla mir phur sangs spen pa lnga/ /gza' lhag gi ni bo gas sngo ra grags/ /nyi zla pa sangs spen pa bzhi/ /phur bu'i grogs por shes par bya/ /mir lhag phur spen bzhi po ni/ /pa sangs kyi ni bo gas po yin/ /lhag phur pa sangs gsum pa ni/ /spen pa'i bo gas thodar shes par bya/ /bo/gas las gzhan ni rang rang dgra/ /dgra gcan gza' kun rgyal po yin/ /de phyir 'di las dgra bo/gas med/ /srin wa'i dbang phyug 'di yin pas/ /gza' kun gyi ni dgra bo yin/ /༈/(1)dang sngo taṅgāl lam lus sam skyes pa'i sa/ (2)/gnyis pa nor dang yi tshang sa/ (3)/gsum pa spun zla ste pha spun gyi sa yang zhes/ (4)/bzhi pa bo/gas kyi sa/ (5)/lnga pa bu tsha rigs brgyud kyi sa/ (6)/drug pa dgra sa/ (7)/bdun pa chung ma'am khyim phywa'i sa//(8)/brgyad pa pha mes dur gyi sa'am nad pa 'thoya 'chi brtag pa 1/ga phywa//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 146 (9)dgu pa cesas phya ste bla ma dang 〉〉sa pa'i sa/ (10)/bcu pa las lam bya ba gnad stodangs min gyi sa/ (11)/bcu cig pa rjodar ba rnyed pa'i sa//(12)/bcu gnyis pa gdo)da pa'am las gang byed rnyed pa'i sa'am 'ga' zhig bu sring gi sa bcad bcu gnyis sdu// /༈/de la'ang takril lam/ /gnas mal dang sngo lus sam skyes pa'i sa/ /dang wa'i steng du nyi ma shar/ /lto tsandan nags kyi dkyil rum du/ /mon chu shing sngon po gzhung na sa skam/ /slo bur ye 'phrog 'byung nyen yod / no lda khang mchod rten brgya rtsa la/ /dkar me lha bshos dar lco/ga 'bul/ mi ma bas pa zhig la ston mo bya/ /lha rgyal dang lha gsol mang du bya/ /brag btsan dang brag bdud ma23da pa legs/ / ༈/takril steng du zla ba shar/ /dbus kyi ga'u gser ljongs la/ /khri gdugs nyi ma 'od dang ldan/ /mdo ste bzang bskal tshar gsum sgrogs//༈/taṅgāl steng du mig dmar shar/ /don med 'phrog 'jom byed pa dang / /snga na mi 'grub dgra yis g.yab snu/ g.yabs/ /sngar na med pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung / /dpon gyi log phog 'byung dogs yod / / skyes

tshe rtsis 'brasabublogasala'aga'askyed/047 dar gri ru 'chi nyen yod/ /rgyas pa 'bum gyi 'ur 'don gyis/ /gri bcos rgyas 'bring skabs dang sbyar/ /༈/takril steng du lhag pa shar/ /kha ba nyin mtshan dgu babs kyang / /bya co ga'i gyur skad dgung la thon/ /gong ma'i gnas su 'gro na bzang / /༈/takril steng du phur bu shar/ /shing tsandan sdong po'i yal ga la//nad bzhi brgya 'chodams pa'i gnyen sngo skyes/ /bdud nag wa'i rigs la dug tu 'gyur/ /bdud ngam chen 'dul ba'i sman macesag yin/ /dgra phur bus thebs pa'i bzang ba yin / / khyim dang dgra gshed thug pas na/ /chos skyong srung mar bskang gso byed/ /mchod rten sku dkar dar lcog 'a bul//༈/ta/la steng du pa sangs shar / / lha chen tshangs pa gdong bzhi des/ /sgo yi sde mig phyag na bsnams/ /rin chen sna lnga'i bang mdzod 'byed/ /'bru drug thang la smin pa yin/ /dbul ho ngas dgra thod cham la 'bebs/ /bo nga ma'i gnas su babo/da pa bzang /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 148 lhakarmāl steng du spen pa shar/ /dgung sngon mkhar du babs pa la//sprin dmar btsa' yis gasku/gas pa yin/ /skyes pa'i tshe la bar chad 'byung / /'bum dang rgyal po g.yu phreng bcos/ /lha khang mar me dar lcog 'bul/ /tatāl steng du sdig can shar/ /lha kong tse 'phrul gyi gdan khri la/ /bdud kyi sku ga mda' zug pa yin/ /lho bur nad rkyen drag po 'am/ /yang na bo nga ma'i 'o/ga 'o/ga sku nga / /bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'ur 'aro/na bya/ /bdud kyi bathodas ka skabs dang sbyar/ /bla bslu tshe sgrub tshe chodag bya/ /lhaganyis pa nor sar mo 'bras ni/ /gnyis pa'i steng du nyi ma shar ba na/ /zun phar ba nag po'i tshang khyod ru/ /g.yang mo lug la chodal rgyugs 'byung / /dmar chags phyugs la bo da sngor sku da/ /rbab 'gril g.yang lhung god ngo 'byung / /phyi 'gro yod na de yis thub/ /nyi khri gser 'od bsil gtor gtong / /klu btsan rgyal po mchod na bzang //lhaganyis pa'i steng du zla ba shar / / rta masnga ba gcig gi srab mda' la / ༄/pho rta brgya yis thur mda' zin/ /cadar gcig gnyis su 'phel

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 149bas bzang ༈/gnyis par mig dmar shar ba na/ /lho tsadman nags kyi dkyil rum du/ /snu na kha 'dus jag pa skya bdun gyis / /blo mas chung gi gron po bcom pa yin/ /nor la gang stongs 'ong bas gzab/ /glegs bam g.yang sgrub bo/da sri mnan/ /༈/gnyis par lhag pa shar ba na/ /gangs can chodar gyi bang mjoḍad der/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyi dngos grub 'bab/ /bang mdzod khengs pa'i 'bras bu tshangs/ /༈/gnyis par phur bu shar ba na/ /sa bcud shing gis bsdus pa yin/ /yang na nor la gang stongs 'ong / /rta dang bong bu'i sa ru ngan//g.yang sgrub glegs bam rdul sprug byed/ /thodad srid mnan cing g.yang rten bca'/ /dgra brub mang du byas na bzang / /༈/ gnyis par pa sangs shar ba na/ /rin chen gser gyi bang mdzod du/ /dgos 'dod 'bras bu smin pa yin/ /stong pa bcud kyis khengs pas bzang / /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 150༈/gnyis par spen pa shar ba na/ /gser nya byes ma'i zhib la lha ra//ho ra g.yang can dgra dang bgegs kyis 'jo mas/ /tshe dang g.yang ni ltag sprod sgrubs/ /nor la gang stongs 'ong bas gzabs/ /blo nyams yid mi bde ba 'ong / /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa sgrog / — ༈/gnyis pa'i steng du sdig can shar/ /me stag dmar po khab tsam des/ /ri rab bsreg pa'i rtsa ba byas/ /nor la gang stongs bor ral cadang / / mdun ma ngo sprod sdudar la gzab/ /glegs bam g.yang sgrub gser 'od 'don/ /rnam thos sras kyi gtor sgrub byed/ /༈/gsum pa spun sar 'bras bu ni/ /gsum par nyi ma shar ba na/ /sdud phugs bdud la gtad pa dang / /sa phugs brag la thug pa yin//pha spun phyogs su gyod 'dzer 'ong / /'brug lo pa la shin tu ngan/ /bdud bzlog sdong rgyan chu bzlog bya/ /'byung bzhi'i sātstsha mang du thob/ /༈/gsum par zla ba shar ba na/ /stag dmar yag gra 'dzum sgang la rgyas/ /pha spun gyi ru dar 'phyar bas bzang /༈/gsum par mig dmar shar ba na / / khyim du zas ga sa chang

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 151'thungs nas/ /them pa chodag nas 'phya kha byed/ /pha spun nang du rag kha rjodad/ /'khrugs 'dre nag mo'i khyodal hwa ra gyis/ / ༈/gsum par lhag pa shar ba na/ /stag dmar yag dgra la 'ja' ris sngo ga /pha spun gyi gral sdud tshugs pas bzang / / ༈/gsum pa phur bu shar bas na / / pha dang mes wa'i gral sa der/ /chos skyong srung ma'i bka' chad phog /pha spun dme khrag shor dgos yod / / chos skyong smug mo yang yang mchod/ /'gyod mtshangs dang bshags pa mang du phul/ /༈/gsum par pa sangs shar ba na / / rta lha da ma gcig gi mthur mda' la/ /ho/ rta brgya yi srab nas zin/ /pha spun gral sku/ dar ba yin//༈/gsum par spin pa shar ba na/ /stag dar ma'i gra 'dzum rjo yis khyer/ /nang cha bu dgu rul ba yin/ /rgyal wa'i bcos ka bsil gtor thongs /༈/gsum pa'i steng du sdig can shar / / dog mo sa yi mchin pa gas/ /pha spun gyi 'tsher sa bdud kyis 'a'o/ga /de la phal chen gsung

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 152sgrog byed / / dgra lha'i mthong ka bcu gsum sogs/ /ngan slong gsum la sbyin pa thodangs/༈/bzhi pa bo/gas sa ji ltar na / / bzhi par nyi ma shar ba na/ /shing phran sta res bcad pa dang / /lha phrug thang la yar ba yin/ /snying de gro bar 'gro nyen yod/ /de la kha mchu nag po sogs / / sde lnga mang du sgrog pa bzang / /lha bsangs lha khrus lam 'phrang bsal/ /༈/bzhi par zla ba shar ba na/ /dma' spang ri'i ngos la nyi ma shar / /lha bya gcig gis yar shog zer/ /grogs kyi rdzi'u ma stong bzang / /༈/bzhi par mig dmar shar ba na/ /gatho ku gros kyi rgya mtsho de//'dre mun pa nag ho sa dkrugs pa yin/ /mi snying dang 'dra bas bslu pa sku nga / /jo na gyi khams chen tshar gsum cadags/ /phal chen gsung rā gas rdul sprug bya/ /༈/bzhi par lhag pa shar ba na/ /blo chung rtsol bas rang mgo thogalha to/nga tse 'phrul rgyal dasngo sa grub babs/ /bo sa kyi rgya mchod ma bskams

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 153bzang / /༈/bzhi par phur bu shar ba na/ /'byung ba cing shi pha khang na/ /phur bu shing gi lo 'bras rgyas / / gathor bo bo sa kyi rgya mtsho khengs/ /thodags kyi rdzi'u ma/ stongs bzang / /༈/bzhi par pa sangs shar ba na/ /mi chod lha yis bskul ba yin//lha mkhar rtse la nyi ma shar / / lha bya gcig gis nam 'phang bcad/ /khyung chen nam khar 'gying ba yin/ /lha 'dra'i dmag dpung rdul du swā1ga /gza' mdo mngo sde bskal bzang dang / /yum gyi dbu dum bsgrags par bya//lha/bzhi par spen pa shar ba na/ /seṅge'i kho ga pa 'bu yis khengs//zhag nya mig tsam zhig phyi la thodar/ /yig brgya 'asnga na zhing gzungs bsgrub // //༈/bzhi par sdig can shar ba na/ /dbus kyi ga'u gser ljongs la/ /lha 'dre'i dam ga snurags 'dus pa yin/ /gathor thod thodas kyi rgya mtsho skem/ /chos skyong gtor sgrub mang du byed/ /'gags pa sel zhing lha bsangs galta nga / /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 154༈/lnga pa bu sar bzang ngan ni/ /lnga par nyi ma shar ba na/ /lha phrug thang la yar ba yin / / thab ga'o/ba mi gtsang khe na la gzab/ /lha bsangs lha khrus nyi khri sgrogs/ /bya ston byis ston thab 'don bya/ /chung glud mdo mang snang brgyad sgrogs/ /chung gi bcos ka sna chodags bya/ /'gags pa sel zhing la rdzas galha//༈/lnga par zla ba shar ba na/ /gser mig g.yu yis spras pa dang / /ma〉rga mtha' ngang pas bas ra ba yin/ /chung gsum rtsed ra ma stong bzang / /lnga par mig dmar shar ba na / /the'u rang bdud kyi sprul pa de / / chung gsum rtsed rar rgyu lam byas/ /rims dang lho bur nad la gzab/ /bsil gdodar brul galta ra mang du thodangs/ /ngan lho nga gsum la sbyin pa bya/ /༈/lnga par lhag pa shar ba na/ /lha phrug rtsed 'jo'i ldum ra der//gser mig g.yu yis spras pa dang / /masnur mtha' ngang pas bas/ra ba dang / /dpal gyi me tog rgyas pa ltar/ /mo bzang gzungs bsdus mang du rā gas/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 155༈/lnga par phur bu shar ba na/ /sa bdud shing gis phub pa yin//'byung ba dgu ru 'phrugs pa sku da/ /rims dang 'brum shu skrangs 'bur yong / /byis ston byis pa'i chung glud bya/ /'byung bzhi sātstsha lam 'phrang bcos//༈/lnga par pa sangs shar ba na/ /'dre de mi yul 'khyar ba yin//lha des rang yul zin pa yin / / lha dkar smug gsol mchod byas pa bzang / /༈/lnga par spen pa shar ba na/ /'dre de mi yul slebs pa yin/ /chung sri'i gral so stongs pa yin / / rims dang dal yam 'byung dogs yod//gtsug tor sde lnga rims srung 'dogs/ /bsil gtor cha gsum chung glud thongs//lhalnga pa'i steng du sdig can shar/ /gling bzhi skor ba'i nyi zla gnyis//khyab 'jug gza' yis zin pa yin/ /chung gsum rtsed ra stangs nyen che/ /slo bur nad rkyen drag po yong / /bsil gtor na rag dong sprug bya/ /chung glud yas kyi sri 〉ba gocad/ /chung la dbo sa pa ci 'grub bya//
