tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 156༈/drug pa dgra sa chodag ma ni/ /drug par nyi ma shar ba na/ /ban btsun pa'i dgra sngor langs pa yin/ /dmar chags cadar la kha smras 'ong / /lha khang dkar me dar lcog 'dzugs/ /za 'dre gnod byed kha bsgyur bya/ /༈/drug par zla ba shar ba na/ /snga na ni med pa'i 'aho ga pa dang //sngar med sdug bsngal gsar du 'byung / / dgra brub dgra bapyodag dgra sri casacadacad/ /༈/drug pa mig dmar shar ba na/ /sdang ba'i dgra sngo btson du bzung / /'phar ba nag sngo g.yang du lhung / / dgra mi thub ma yin dro/ba pas bzang / /༈/drug par lhag pa shar ba na/ /shing gra ma'i me de 'bar 'dod yin/ /dgra kha g.yer can de lab 'asnga da yin / / dar zab la rten pa'i rtsod ngo yod/ /dgra brub dang lha bsangs sdong rgyan dang / /kha mchu nag ༷ tshar gsum 〉wags/ /༈/drug par phur bu shar ba na/ /tsadman nags kyi dkyil rum du//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 157stag shar ba gra bsdebs tshogs 'du byed / / sgom chung gi mgron po bcom pa yin/ /dgra 'gran 'asngand cham la 'bebs pa yin/ /༈/drug par pa sangs shar ba na/ /bdud gasnanar ba gcadan nu thang la lhungs/ /don med rku 'phrog 'byung ba dang / /sngar na med pa'i dgra ngo 'byung / / dgra bkā ga dgra brub 'bad pa bya/ /༈/drug par spen pa shar ba na/ /ri de yi sha ba gnya' nas chagakhyi spyang snu/ gnyis la nam langs yin / / dgra thodang rul yin pas mchodag tu bzang / / ༈/drug par sdig can shar ba na/ /dgra mtho brdo bas phur ba yin//dgra pha brgya shi la bu brgya ru la/ /dgra thod cham la 'bebs pa bzang / /༈/bdun nga khyim sa 'am chung ma'i sa/ /bdun par nyi mar shar ba na/ /shing gra ma'i me chen dbus nas 'bar / ka dman sbrum ma'i lus srog dgra la shor/ /tshe mdo tshe sgrub sgrol chog bya/ /lha chen bskang gso nyi khri sgrogs/ /bdud bzlog sri slong gi gto la 'bad/ /༈/bdun par zla ba shar ba na/ /lha kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po de//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu lho gsal 'ga' skyed/ 158dar dkar thu ba dan du btings/ /ma gcig gi phang par bu gsum 'dzin/ /༈/bdun par mig dmar shar ba na/ /dgung khyodan khad du 'grigs la/ /zhwa chodag 'o/da tsam zhig dgung la phud/ /mya ngan gyi bye bral sku nga ba'am/ /bu mo mang zhing thodags la gzab/ /tshe sgrub tshe dbang tshe chog bya/ /nag sngo bcu gsum bsdudag par 'bad/ /༈/bdun pa lhag pa shar ba na/ /ston gyi gangs ri'i sras mo des//bdud rtsi'i chu bo rgya mtshor bskyil/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'bras bu smin//mi nor 'phel ba'i dus sbyor yin/ /srid kyi ljon shing 'bras bu smin/ /༈/bdun par pur bu shar ba na/ /klu tshang rgya mtsho'i gting nas rgyas/ /'byung ba shi gsos bcud skyes 'phrod / / dman bud med lus la 'tshe ba'am/ /srid zhugs skran gyi ngo yin pas/ /rgyal lhu malnga lnga chodas srung mchodad/ /mchod rten sku dkar bsnyen bsgrub bya/ /mdun sngo med pas bzang bar bshad/ /༈/bdun par pa sangs shar ba na/ /srid kyi lha mo sna lnga des/ /dar

—— martsisa'abras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 159dkar thu ba gdan du btings/ /dman gcig gi phang na bu lnga 'dzin//gzhi mi 'gyur brtan pa'i rdzi'u yin/ /bye bral mdun babs med pas bzang / /༈/bdun par spen pa shar ba na/ /dman a phyi rgan dang bu mo/ gzhon/ /'dre mun pa nag po'i rdul sprugs byas/ /bud med kyi sri sgab chad nyen yod/ /so can la stor god 'ong bas gzab/ /gser cad chags pa dgu baho ra bya/ /mi kha drag ngo yang yang brdeg / ༈/bdun par sdig can shar ba na/ /dman mdzangs ma'i sri sgab bdud kyis bcad/ /bdud kyi zhwa nag khyodan pa yin/ /khyim nag khe/la du rdib nyen che/ /mi rabs kyi chu rgyun chad kyi snga gas/ /ho ga gzungs 'bum gyi 'ur 'don byed/ /bdud bcos gshin rji'i bzlog pa dang / /rgyal mo sri slong gto la 'bad/ /༈/brgyad pa 'chi gasku na lha/ga gi sar/ /brgyad par nyi ma shar ba na/ /shing 14nga yal ga bo ga pa dang / /pha mes dur sa 'grams pa yin//gsur dang zas nor mang pos mchod/ /dur lha gsol zhing dur sri mnan//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ /60 ༈/brgyad par zla ba shar ba na/ /yang mes gser gyi ri bo la tsha ༷/ga gi gral sa rgyas pas bzang / /༈/brgyad par mig dmar shar ba na/ /yang mes bkra rgan mi thod des/ /dur sgo 'bor ba'i phram shing thogs/ /shi mig gson la blta bas gzab / / gsur dang zas kyi phud kyis mchod/ /༈/brgyad par lhag pa shar ba na/ /pha mes dur gral ma 'khrugs shing / /shi mig gasku/na la mi gachodad bzang / /༈/brgyad pa phur bu shar ba na/ /pha mes dur sgo 'khrugs pa dang / /dur 'grams yin pas dur lha gsol/ /gsur dang bsil galta ra dur sri mnan/ /༈/brgyad par pa sangs shar ba na/ /ri na bun can la sha rkyang 'a〈per/ /chu rgya ma〉rga can la nya sram 'kho ra / / pha mes dur gral ma 'khrugs shing / /gshin mig gasku na la mi gachodad bzang / /chodar dang bde ba rgyas dpal thob/ /༈/brgyad par spen pa shar ba na/ /gshin rji'i dur sgo bdud kyis

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 161phye/ /shi mig gasku/na la lta ba yin / / dur lha gasku/la zhing dur sri mnan//dur kha tshe yi bzlog pa bya/ /༈/brgyad par sdig can shar ba na/ /mtshun gyi dur sa bdud kyis 'a'o/ga /gasku na la nad rkyen cadang ba yin/ /nor gyi zas bcud cadar ba yin/ /dur lha gsol zhing dur masnga sa dang / /dur kha rgyas 'debs bsil gathodar 'bad/ /༈/dgu pa chos sa ji ltar 'dri / / dgu par nyi ma shar ba na/ /bdud khyab pas lag pa brkyang dusayin/ /dbo na macodag brtsegs pa 'ur 'asnga na bya/ /bdud kyi bkā ga pa mang du gyis/༈/dgu par zla ba shar ba na/ /na mo che yi dkyil steng du/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang zhengs/ /yang dag swā gas pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bskal ba gcig gi bstan pa dar//༈dgu par mig dmar shar ba na/ /gser gyi lda je sked nas chagaban snu sa pa yi tshe tshad rtsodags/ /bka' 'gyur rdul sprug spyodag sku/gas bya//lhadagu par lhag pa shar ba na/ /'dab chags rgod kyi dang sgro de//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu khyod gsal 'ga' skyed/ 162 rno ngar mtshon gyi ngar gcod yin/ /bdud kyi dmag dpung bzlog pas bzang / /༈/dgu par phur bu shar ba na/ /shing tsadman sdong wa'i gdan khri'i steng / /ban de sngags mkhan gyi phur pas sgril/ /chos byed kyi bstan pa dar ba yin / / bya so/ pa yi lus lha/ga rgyas//༈/dgu par pa sangs shar ba na/ /gra ma brgya yi mthob du de/ /lcug ma dag gis bcings pa yin / / codas pa'i 23sa ra tshugs pa dang / /khyodab dalhu/na sku tshe brtan pas bzang /༈/dgu par spen pa shar ba na/ /dam pa chos kyi sgo khang du/ /'dre rdo nga pa pha dgu chags pa yin/ /bka' 'gyur sgrog cing yum sgrub byed//mang ja bskol zhing 'gyed chen gtong //༈/dgu par sdig can shar ba na/ /gser gyi lda je sked nas chagaban chos pa'i bla srog bdud kyis brkus/ /chos skyong gtor sgrub mang du byed/ /yum sgrub tshe sgrub spong thag thongs/ /khyad par bya lo yin na 'dzer//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 163༈/bcu pa bya ba las ༷) sar/ /bcu par nyi ma shar ba na/ /dpal mi mang smon pa'i lha khang du/ /nyi ma me yi khro ༄ra phog /grogs kha nang yod pa lce yis 'phul/ /lag na yod pa thang la shor/ /ban btsun pas thog bshig byas nyen yod/ /'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang zhu//tshulags bcu mun sel mang du khyodags/ /'gags pa sel la la rdzas gasku/la//༈/bcu par zla ba shar ba na/ /dog mo sa yi lte ba na/ /lha kong cetha'aphrul rgyal mkhar gcig ba39kas / / mkhar la ba gam cho/gas pa yin//yul gzhis 'dzin pa'i dus sbyor bzang / /༈/bcu par mig dmar shar ba na/ /btsan du re ba'i brag phug tu/ /kho chus rlabs kyi phug pa phub/ /yul gzhis snyu da pa'i kha smras 'ong / /'bum dang rgyal po'i g.yu phreng bcos/ /bzlog pa'i rigs la 'bad par bya/ /༈/bcu pa'i steng du lhag pa shar/ /pha dang mes po dmangs 'draste/ /rang nyid rgyal po chen po 'dra/ /gra ma brgya yi mgo tho de/ /bal 'dab gcig gis bcings pa yin/ /phar rtsodad bo nga ma'i sar babo da

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 164bzang / /༈/bcu par phur bu shar ba na/ /zhi drag 'dres pas rang snga na 'grub/ /lhanan kyang 'gags nyen che bas na/ /'gags sel 'gags pa gathegad pa dang / /chu phran zam pa btsug pa bzang / /༈/bcu par pa sangs shar ba na/ /srid paci) gzhi ma mtha' nas rgyas/ /bskal ba'i 'bras bu dbus su smin/ /gang 'dod 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / /che btsun gyi bstan pa dar bas bzang / /༈/bcu par spen pa shar ba na/ /dbyar chab gtsang sngo gzhung nas skam/ /sems nyid nya mo skam la thodan/ /khyodad dang kha g.yog rgyun du 'ong / /rgyas pa bcu gsum bzlog pa bya/ /chos skyong gtor sgrub gtor bzlog bya/ /༈/bcu par sdig can shar ba na/ /lha dung skyong dkar mo'i gdan khri la/ /'dre gasnga nga pa phar dgu chags pa yin/ /bya ba'i las la 'khyodad pa dang / /don med kha smras 'byung ngo yod/ /dgra bzlog dgra brub dgra sri mnan/ /dathodan mchodag brtsegs pa 'ur 'aro/na byed/ /lha btsan klu

tshe rtsis 'bras bu chod gsal 'ga' skyed/ /65btsan dgu ba〉war bya/ /༈/bcu gcig rnyed pa ji ltar 'byung / /bcu gcig steng du nyi ma shar/ /swā masnuran ngar gyis brgyan pa des/ /sha yi ri thod bshig pa yin//phyugs la god 'gram sku nga bas gzab/ /bsil galta ra cadar lha cadar gzungs lho gas/ /khang pa'i klu gnyan mchodad na bzang /༈//bcu gcig steng du zla ba shar/ /phyi nas tshe tsher rnyed kyang //nang du sa le sbram du song / /nor la gang stongs mi yong bzang //༈/bcu gcig steng du mig dmar shar/ /byang gyim shang nor gyi rgyal khams de/ /mo/na pha spun bdun gyis bathe ma pa yin/ /dgra char sku da pas dgra bswā/ga bya/ /dgra brub mang du byas na bzang / /༈/bcu gcig steng du lhag pa shar/ /stong pa bcud kyis khengs pa yin/ /ru sde nag po'i dus rjodar yin/ /cadar gcig bzhag gnyis su 'phel bas bzang / /༈/bcu gcig steng du phur bu shar/ /shing phran zor bas brngas pa yin/ /nor la gang stongs yong nyen che/ /glegs bam nor lha nor

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 166rgyun khyodags//༈/bcu gcig steng du pa sangs shar/ /lhu drug lpags nang tshang ba dang / /dus sbyor 'gyur med tshang ba dang / /dus drug 'gyur med brtan pa dang / / 'bru bcud thang la smin pas bzang / /༈/bcu gcig steng du spen pa shar/ /nor 'od can 'dre ru langs pa dang / /dgra khyodang pa sbyadar la chags pa yin/ /'dre 'asnga na yul nas 'bud pa dang / /lan chags galta ra ma mang du lnga ngas//༈/bcu gcig steng du sdig can shar/ /sdudar gyi g.yang kha ral ba dang / /ma sru'i cadar la 'dre galhunan chags / / lan chags gdodar ma ci mang dang / /lha ra lha chodar rgyun g.yang sgrub byed/ /la rdzas dgu la sku dkar gasdu/la/༈/bcu gnyis gtod pa byi ltar 'byung / /bcu gnyis steng du nyi ma shar/ /mi de chu dong lhung ba yin/ /blo bur ye 'phrog 'byung nyen yod// sngar byas las la 'khyodad pa skyes/ /klu bdud klu btsan mchodad pa dang //gdodar bkānag drag wa'i las la 'bad/ /kha mchu nag ho nag smug mchodad//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 167rta lo yod na ngan no gyis//༈/bcu gnyis steng du zla ba shar/ /dgra ru bzung ba gnyen du 'gro//spangs phyer byas kyang gser phyer sku/nga / /sems la ci bsam 'grub pas bzang //༈/bcu gnyis steng du mig dmar shar/ /gser nya bye ma'i sdib la sna ra/ /snga na mi 'grub dgra yi g.yab mo yin//༈/bcu gnyis steng du lhag pa shar/ /sa yas sna chad pa'i mas sna ru/ /sa gser gyi snying sngo chags pa yin/ /mi 'phen po'i khyim nang bo/sa kyi gang / /dus rjodar gnas mal tshugs pas bzang /༈/bcu gnyis steng du phur bu shar/ /'brong gi rus rdog skam pol/ /khyi spyang rgod gsum po rtsod pa shor/ le lan len 'dod yong ba'i ngo / /gdugs sher bzlog pa smug mo mchod/ /༈/bcu gnyis steng du pa sangs shar/ /ri dung ri'i rtse la nyi ma shar/ /mkhar la ba gam jo gas pa yin/ /rjodar ba rnyed la dodar ba 'chodab//sa zhing gnam sa'i dus rje/ra yin/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 168༈/bcu gnyis steng du spen pa shar/ /| cen rlung gis sgrul ba yin//sa srin a thag chad pa yin/ /snang brgyad gzungs phran mang du khyodags//༈/bcu gnyis steng du sdig can shar/ /zom stong kha yi kha char yin/ /yod yod 'dra yang med pa ste/ /kha grogs che la gting grogs chung / /kha gyod phyi thal gnyis su yod/ /rgyal po'i bcos ka mang du byed/ /bdud kyi bcos ka skab sa dang sbyor/ rī/

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 169༄༅/ /gzhan yang legs ldan gza' bdun po/ /yid rtog rlung gi 'du 'aho las/ /brtan g.yo'i rten 'byung gzhir gyur pa/ /khams mang rten 'brel 'du 'phrod kyis/ /gegs dang bcud du gyur pa'i tshul//brtag par bya ba'i taṅgāl/ /rang ngam dpyad gzhir bzung ba la/ /gza' gzhan babo da pa gsar shar ni/ /dgra yis ma10nga na gegs su gyur//thodags mthodang sku na tan bcud du gyur// de yi khyad par brtags pa ni/༈/nyi ma gegs su gyur pa na/ /mi chen bka' 'o/gas rims tshad gzir/ /khams rigs dmar chags rdzas byung ba'i/ /yid la sdug bsngal rnam par gasku / /tshad gdung tshe rtsub zhi las nyams/ /shar du 'gro ba don meda'agyur/ /rgyal rigs dang ni skyes pa rnams/ /gnyen yang 'gyur ram dgra ru ldang / /pha rol stobs kyis zil mnan nas//bsgrub tu mi ster sha thang chad//༈/nyi ma bcud du gyur pa na/ /'dod yon rtsub ma'i las la dbang / /dper na g.yul gyi rgyal kha sku gas/ /rang khyodabs rgyas pas gzhan zil gnon/ /ya rabs grogs rnyed go sa 'thodab/ /thodang las ༷ ga

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 170pa'i bzang 'bras bswā da/༈/zla ba gegs su gyur pa na/ /rje'u rigs bud med dgra ru ldang / /ma zhu gsus nad lus nyams dma'/ /lha/ga chags sam ni dkar masnga ga rdzas/ /gasku/ ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan 'byung / /rdzas nyams shar lhor don mi 'grub/ /rang stobs shin tu nyam chung ba/ /'dod yon rnams kyis lto da par 'gyur/ /༈/zla ba sku na tan gyur na/ /khams rgyas 'asnga da sku na 'jam bur spyod/ /don 'bras rtsol med ngang gis 'du/ /gong las ldog pa'i bzang 'bras brjod/༈/mig dmar gegs su gyur pa na/ /dgra 'tshe 'jigs skrag lho sems rtsub/ /yid lhag mi drag dmag sku/gas sdig /gzhan yid mi 'ong rdzas la rtsod/ /lam rong dogs por zhugs pa 'dra/ /lto ru ngan cing dgug pa 'byer/ /gang yang rtsub la gzugs las ni/ /byung ba'i sdug bsngal gasku bar 'gyur/ /de ni mi sdug yul sku gas yin/༈/mig dmar yon tan gyur pa na/ /rang rgyud snying stobs me ru

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 171 'bar/ /gzhan sder 'jigs pa'i zug rngu gtong / /mthodang ba'i yul skyid drag la swā / /dmar chags rigs sdudags dbang du 'du/ /bo nga las khyodag pa dga' ba'i 'bras/༈/lhag pa gegs su gyur pa na/ /rgyal bu blon dang btang snyoms mi/ /rang gar sdang la blo nor 'khor/ /stobs med 'phel rgyas mi 'byung zhing / /lto nub don nyams zas la sogs/ /myong ba'i tshim pa mi skyi ste//rgun khu bshirgar ba'i snyigs zhabs 'dra/ /mi phyugs bcud nyams 'alhund sku na nyams/ /ma ning bzhin du stur 'phang dma'/ /rtsa ba la 14gas so/ngas khyodad nyams/ /bkres skom dag gis gdung bar byed/༈/lhag pa bcud du gyur pa na/ /bza' btung mo da la bcud g.yang 'phel/ /skom pa chu la 'phrad pa lhar/ /yid kyang sim la 'kho ra chodar rgyas/ /bag phebs 'asnga da rgu'i sgyu rtsal gasku / /bo nga las sgyu ga pa'i bzang 'bras brjod/ /'dod don 'phel zhing ches cher rgyas/ /༈/phur bu gegs su gyur pa na/ /bram ze ban btsun rigs byed pas/ /dgra byed blo mthu rlung rta nyams/ /nor dbul nub tu lhag par

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdu/ gsal 'ga' skyed/ 172ngan/ /dgra 'du bskrad pa mi 'grub cing / /reg bya las byung sdug bsngal gzir/ /sku ga chags la sku/gas so/ngas spyod nyams/ /skad cig snga na 'gyur shes pa 'asdud/ /bab sdodal brtsam pa mang bar 'gyur/ /thodan med bya spu rlung khyer 'dra/ /the cho ma zhe gathe da mya ngan che/༈/phur bu bcud du gyur pa na/ /'dod don 'gyang med myur du 'grub/ / yul 'khor ban btsun grogs bzang rnyed/ /chod la rig pa'i nyi ma 'char/ /lus yang 'bo/ mkhyodags rig pa bde/ /bya ba lus pa med par 'grub/ /gong las bzlog ste bzang por brjod/ /pa sangs gegs su gyur pa na/ /bud med blon dang mdzes ma dang / /snying la 'jug pa gzhan du 'byer/ /nub byang du ngan mi snyan jo sa/ /'asnga da pa'i gnas la mi dbang zhing / /cadar phur gnyen gyi bya bar ngan/ /༈/pa sangs bcud du gyur pa na/ /gang bsam dbanga'adu snga tsar byed/ /snyan pa'i gtam dang dga' ba 'phel/ /thodang las rgyab bakhyodal dge bar brjod/ /༈/spen pa gegs su gyur pa na/ /dmangs garo/la ma rabs dgra

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 173ru ldang / /spyid skyur rmongs bag las byas 'gyang / /byang du don nyams bran cadar dbul/ /sna dri shin tu ngan pa 〉rgar/ /bsad pa mi 'grub mi kha mang/ /ltag par mchod rten brtsegs pa 'dra/ /bya ba gang byas brtsams nas lus/༈/spen pa bcud du gyur pa na/ /yul zhing 'khor tshoskor tshe dpal brtan/ /brtsams pa'i bya ba 'gyur ༷/ga med/ /sa dpal rgyas pas 'bru 'phel zhing / /dogs mo ri rgyal bzhin du brnying / /dgra med dogs pa ga la yod/ /mdo mi 'chor ba'i gting rdo yin/ /gong las ༷ la brtsam bzang 'bras smra/ /༈/sgra gcan bcud du gyur pa ni/ /a haṃ lha/ga gi ka ba tshugs//rgyal srid 'bru sdudar snyan grags 'byung / /rnal 'khyodar grub pa mtha' ru phyin/ gegs gyur tshe mthud dpal thams cad/ /rtsaskam me la btab pa 'dra/ /dus me gegs gyur sdug bsngal mang / /mi bde chod 'khrugs lus nad dang / /sems sdug bsam pa'i bar chad codang / /༈/bcud gyur bsad bskrad dug sbyor las// ngan byed mtha' dag

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 174bsam bzhin 'grub/ /'di gnyis dgra bo/gas med na yang / /nyi zla'i tshul dang mtshungs par sbyar/ /'di tsam rig pa'is bon te/ /de las rnam mang spros pa'i tshogs/ /'phrul te 'dod don mtha' dag ni/ /lag mthil dag tu blta ba bzhin/ /gsal bar gyur la bo mas par mjortod//

tshe rtsis 'bras bu sdud gsal 'ga' skyed/ 175ra༅༅/ /kun gzigs dbyangs 'char rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshe rabs las rtsis nag 'gros su bkod pa la/ ༈/bla ma dang ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang skye bu'i tshe tshad bshad pa la/ /skyes dus skar lha/gas legs brtag nas/ /nam langs pa nas tsas bar gyi/ /'das pa'i chu 〉rgad gang skud pa/ /gnas gnyis bzhag la gcig gi gnas/ /mig gis bsgyur la mkhar ros bgo /thob pa chu tshod lhag ma srang / /gcig shos chu tshod steng nas 'phri/ /de nis skyes nyin zla skar gyi/ /chu tshod steng byin 'khor los bsgril/ /skyes skar dang bcas des rtogs so//skyes skar chu snurd tshes (15)babo sa cadar/ /thig (0)shar cha shas dang por skyes/ /gzugs (1)shar gnyis ba zung (2)gsum pa/ /me (3)shar cha shas bzhi par skyes/ /de yang cha shas dang 14 la/ /skyes pa'i tshad tshed 61 grangs brgya (100)/ /gnyis pa brgyad cu (80)gsum pa la/ /drag cu (60)bzhi ba bzhi bcu'i (40)tshad/ /'di ni rags pa'i tshe tshad yin / / (tshe)re'u mig nang bzhin skye gza' dang / /skyes skar dang bcas des rtogs so/ /

tshe rtsis 'bras bu blo gsal 'ga' skyed/ 176༈/gnyis pa zhib rtsis lam nas ni/ /skyes skar chu snumad mkha' ros (60)bsgyur/ /chu sra yar bsre dus (6)kyi bsgyur/ /dbugs bcug mkha' skar (270)gyis bgos pa'i/ /thob nor lo yin lhag ma ni// khyim gyis (12)bsgyur la babo/sa thenir zla/ /lhag ma mkha' (30)mes bsgyur ba la/ /mkha' skar (270)gyis chodab zhag grangs dang / /lhag sku/da mkha' ro(60/60) dus(6) sku/gas kyis/ /rim bsgyur 'kho ra so/sa (270)bgos lhag dag /'di nyid gnyis bkod gcig gi steng brgya (100)14gas rim par 'phri ba yi/ /lhag ma skye bu'i tshe tshad yin/ /gcig sku sa mdas (5)chodab 'chi bslu'i so/ / / zla zhag rnams ni char bar gyur//re'u mig (8)nang bzhin skyes skar dang / /skyes gza' dngos bzung bdag gza' ni/ /lnga/ga mar btsal nas rim pa bzhin/ /gza' dgu'i ming bkod 'bri bar bya/ /skye bu'i tshe lo mkha' nyis(120)bgom thob nar skal thig le (0)'bri/ /khyim (12)gyis bsgyur la rang cha bcug(120) / babo/sa chodab zla grangs lhag mkha' mes(30)/ /bsgyur nas cha bcug (120)chodab pa zhag /lhag ma mkha' 1ris(60) bsgyur dbyugs
